jobs.title: Open Application: Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Open Application: ICEYE Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO)

Role highlights

  • Location: Across all ICEYE hubs

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Operations (GMO)

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office / Hybrid, depending on the role and site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this application matters

This is not a live vacancy. It is how we meet talented people before the right role exists. We open new roles in GMO all the time, and strong candidates are rarely on the market for long. Apply once, tell us what you do best and what you want next, and when a role matches your profile, we will contact you.

Applying does not guarantee contact. We review applications monthly. Please submit your CV or resume in English, as we cannot review applications in other languages.

Who We Are
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Application Process

  1. Upload your CV or resume in English and fill in a short form

  2. You receive an automatic confirmation

  3. We contact you when a matching role opens and move you into that role’s process

  4. If there is no match yet, your profile stays in our talent pool for 12 months, as long as you gave permission

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.title: Customs Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Customs Specialist

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: Freight Forwarding Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid (first 4-6 months on-site)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Customs Specialist, you’ll keep ICEYE’s goods moving compliantly across the world.

You'll drive the customs compliance and documentation that keeps ICEYE's satellites moving smoothly between Finland, the EU and our sites worldwide. That means classifying goods correctly, applying the right customs procedures, and making sure every shipment clears without unnecessary delay or cost.

You'll work closely with the Freight Forwarding Manager to plan how goods travel by road, air and sea, and use your knowledge of trade agreements and preferential origin rules to reduce duty and landed cost wherever possible.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Own day-to-day customs clearance across the EU: release for circulation, outward/inward processing, transit (T1, T2, TIR), customs warehousing, bonded storage and temporary admission.

  • Maintain HS/Taric classification and customs valuation for both supplier-sourced and in-house manufactured goods.

  • Spot risks in international shipments early and resolve them before they reach destinations.

  • Understand and apply Incoterms with confidence, allocating cost, risk and responsibility correctly across every lane.

  • Prepare for and take part in customs audits, and help strengthen the internal audit and control programme.

  • Run Binding Tariff Information (BTI) applications regularly and keep the resulting rulings current.

  • Write clear SOPs that colleagues can follow without you having to explain them.

  • Pursue free trade agreement benefits (preferential origin, EUR.1, statements on origin, REX registration) and maintain the supplier declaration chain.

  • Track and report the impact of your work: duty avoided, duty recovered and landed cost reduced.

  • Contribute to Freight Forwarding strategy across road, air and sea, flagging where routing, mode or documentation choices affect customs treatment or cost.

  • Recognise dangerous goods shipments (IATA DGR, ADR, IMDG) and check the required documentation.

  • Support material flow between ICEYE's Espoo site and our sites worldwide, reconciling physical goods against ERP, WMS and TMS records.

What we’re looking for (must haves):

  • A track record of reducing duty and landed cost through preferential origin, free trade agreements, relief or suspension regimes, or classification and valuation work, with results you can point to.

  • Working knowledge of rules of origin and the origin documentation regime, including supplier declarations.

  • Solid understanding of freight forwarding across road, air and sea, including how transport is planned in each mode.

  • Professional-level Finnish in addition to English.

  • Curiosity, eagerness to learn more and take full ownership over your scope of work

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with EU and US trade compliance (dual-use Regulation (EU) 2021/821, EAR and ITAR, denied party screening).

  • Hands-on freight forwarding experience earlier in your career.

  • Warehousing, inbound and outbound operations experience.

  • IATA DGR, ADR or IMDG certification.

  • Practical use of the EU free trade agreement network on lanes relevant to the aerospace or aviation industries.

  • Experience with defence and government customers, especially in a fast-scaling manufacturing environment.


Application Process

  • Screening call

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Task / case study

  • Panel interview

  • Offer

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is dependant on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.title: QMS Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights

  • QMS Specialist

  • Location: Spain

  • Department: GMO – Manufacturing Assurance

  • Reports to: Global QMS Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


Why this role matters

The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices.

This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Ensure ICEYE Quality Management System is fully implemented in our Valencia facility

  • Drive ICEYE production framework maturity increase in Valencia - be the subject matter expert for QMS, QA, Support Health and safety and environmental topics.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and industry requirements, serve as the main point of contact for auditors and certification bodies.

  • Act as an internal auditor in our internal process audits covering quality and supporting EHS topics.

  • Ensure controlled documentation rigor in Valencia operations

  • Define and track quality KPIs; prepare and present regular performance reports to leadership.

  • Provide training and coaching on QMS processes, standards, and quality tools; promote a culture of quality throughout the organization.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years in quality, engineering, operations, compliance, or process improvement roles.

  • Strong experience with digital QMS systems and data-driven improvement methods.

  • Strong knowledge of QMS standards (ISO 9001 required; AS9100, AQAP2110, PECAL or similar beneficial)

  • Experience with quality tools and risk management (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments).

  • Audit experience, either as an internal auditor or supporting external certification

  • Adaptability and a real willingness to learn; comfortable in a fast-paced, agile production environment where processes are still taking shape

  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to drive cross-functional alignment and work independently with minimal supervision

  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish

Nice to haves:

  • Degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, or related field.

  • Knowledge of AS9100, AQAP 2110, PECAL, or ISO 27001

  • Multi-site or international corporate experience

  • Background in defence tech, aerospace, advanced manufacturing, or automotive

  • Experience with quality tools and risk management methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments). If you bring the right mindset, we can build these with you.

Application Process

  • TA interview

  • Hiring Manager video interview

  • Home task + task review interview

  • Final onsite interviews

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Product Security

  • Reports to: VP Product Security

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As Senior GRC Engineer (Security), you'll mature ICEYE's Security Governance, Risk and Compliance program across a multi-country, multi-regulator footprint, including Finland, Germany, Spain, Poland, the UK and Greece amongst others. ICEYE operates at the intersection of commercial space technology and sovereign defence, so our compliance posture (ISO 27001, NIS2, NIST, and national frameworks) has to be credible to customers who include governments and defence agencies. You'll be the person who keeps that posture accurate, current and audit-ready, maps client and national requirements to internal ICEYE requirements, as a senior individual contributor. This role will be working closely with all the ICEYE Security team domains, ICEYE IT, ICEYE product management and the Program Management Office, Engineering and Sales.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

The position will evolve according to the needs of the company and the growing team. Initially, the position has two main aspects, which are adjacent and many initiatives will cross both, especially in terms of overlapping requirements and compliance evidence:

  • Product requirements and compliance:

    • Ensure clients’ and their national security requirements are at all times clearly translated accurately to ICEYE internal requirements across product, IT, and other ICEYE functions, and we can clearly communicate those towards existing and new clients.

    • Ensure ICEYE has evidence of fulfilling and complying with the requirements, preferably as compliance-as-code whenever possible.

    • Support ICEYE’s Product, the Missions business line, PMO and Sales on client requirements. Produce material to support accreditation and acceptance requirements.

  • Wider Iceye and regulatory compliance:

    • Continuously improve ICEYE's ISO 27001 ISMS, including risk assessments, the risk register, Statement of Applicability, internal audits and certification/surveillance audit cycles.

    • Track and operationalise NIS2, CRA and other EU product security obligations across ICEYE's in-scope entities, translating regulatory requirements into concrete policies, controls and evidence.

    • Prepare clear, concise compliance and risk reporting for senior leadership, including status against certifications, audits and remediation plans.

    • Maintain information security policies, standards and supporting documentation, ensuring they stay practical and enforceable rather than shelfware.

    • Act as a day-to-day point of contact for external auditors, certification bodies and regulators on GRC matters.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Eligible for being cleared for a Personal Security Clearance as necessary as well as a citizenship or a permanent residency in the European Union.

  • Technical skills that allow you to interpret compliance requirements towards the product function; this includes being able to fluently discuss modern software architecture and development, deployment and release concepts.

  • Proven hands-on experience running ISO 27001 (implementation, internal audit, or certification maintenance) in a real organisation, not just theoretical knowledge or external auditing experience.

  • Working knowledge of NIS2, CRA, and how their obligations translate into practical controls and reporting.

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence product management, engineering, IT, legal and leadership without formal authority.

  • Experience building or maintaining a risk register and running quantified risk assessments.

  • Comfortable operating independently across multiple countries and regulatory regimes.

  • Awareness of emerging AI governance frameworks (ISO 42001, NIST AI Risk Management Framework, EU AI Act) as well as NIST frameworks

 

Nice to haves:

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor.

  • Experience in defence, space, aerospace or another regulated/sovereign-sensitive industry.

  • Exposure to classified information handling frameworks (EUCI, NATO equivalents, or national security clearance regimes).

  • A well-rounded skillset of using language models for automation.

 

Application Process

  • Initial screening call with Talent Acquisition

  • Technical/competency interview with the VP Product Security

  • Scenario-based exercise on requirements discovery, mapping and prioritisation

  • Final interview with senior stakeholders including a behavioural interview

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tasking and Planning
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

• Senior Software Engineer - Tasking and Planning
• Location: Valencia, Spain
• Department: Ground Segment
• Reports to: Engineering Manager
• Employment type: Permanent
• Workplace model: Hybrid (3 days per week in office)
• Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As Senior Software Engineer on the Acquisition Planning team, you will build the software systems that enable ICEYE and its customers to task satellites, plan data acquisitions, and turn orbital mechanics into operational intelligence capability. From pass prediction and coverage computation engines to event-driven backend services and the engineering interfaces that let users visualise and de-conflict collection plans, you will own the stack end-to-end — working directly alongside engineers and product managers with deep operational backgrounds to understand what users need and ship software that delivers it. This is an early-stage, high-autonomy role where you will help define the architecture and direction of a platform that sits at the intersection of software engineering, applied mathematics, and real-world intelligence operations.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Tasking and Planning Engines. Orbit propagation, pass prediction, acquisition geometry, sensor configuration parameters, and coverage footprint computation. Applied science mathematics turned into operational capability via Software.

  • Platform Services. Backend services handling task management. Event-driven workers performing opportunity calculation and synchronising state asynchronously via NATS JetStream. PostgreSQL for persistence. Responsiveness and resilience at the service of the mission.

  • Engineering Interfaces. Robust and evolvable APIs and UIs that enable engineers to visualise passes, compare collection plans, plan tasks, and self-service their access to space.

  • Whatever the future brings. Multi-sensor coordination, processing pipeline integration, new collection strategies, and capabilities that will emerge from close collaboration with users. You will help define the direction, not just execute it.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. You design decoupled, maintainable, resilient, performant systems. You can reason about concurrency and how transactions work. You know about CAP and regularly make deliberate trade-offs between Consistency and Availability. You understand the difference between “At most once”, “At least once” and how to design systems around those guarantees.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted engineering. You treat AI as a standard part of your toolkit, not a novelty or a threat. You use it across the whole of your work (design exploration, code, tests, documentation, debugging, reviewing unfamiliar codebases) and you have a feel for where it accelerates you and where it quietly costs you time. Crucially, you stay accountable for the output: you know how to prompt and scope a task well, how to verify what comes back, and how to keep the guarantees that production demands. You are curious about improving the way you and your team work with these tools, and you help others get better at it.

  • Production experience. You have designed, built, and operated services in production: REST APIs, relational databases, and asynchronous workers. You know how to make your systems observable and resilient. You understand what production demands beyond making things work locally.

  • Fast learner in technical domains. This role involves orbital mechanics, RF physics, and geospatial data. You don’t need to come in knowing these — but you do need to be the kind of engineer who can pick up a new domain quickly, ask sharp questions, and start contributing before you’ve mastered every detail.

  • Ability to work from ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined operational need (e.g. “we need users to de-conflict between competing collection plans”) and turn it into concrete engineering work. You ask the right questions, make well-reasoned decisions, and adjust when new information arrives.

  • Effective communication across domains. You will work alongside people who think in many different ways and work in different contexts. You can listen carefully, ask precise questions, and articulate technical tradeoffs in terms that everybody can understand, and adjust to your audience accordingly.

Nice to haves:

  • Event-driven architecture. Experience with NATS, Kafka, SQS, or similar. Understanding of at-least-once delivery, idempotency, and the practical tradeoffs of asynchronous service communication.

  • Modern frontend engineering. Production experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, particularly for data-intensive or real-time visualisation applications. Experience with CesiumJS or deck.gl is a strong plus.

  • Proficiency with AI development tools. You actively use AI assistants (Cursor, Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, or similar) in your daily engineering work. Not tentatively, but as a primary tool for writing, reviewing, and iterating on code. You understand their strengths and limitations, and you use them to move faster without sacrificing quality.

  • Orbital mechanics background. Experience with TLEs, SGP4 propagation, pass prediction, incidence and squint geometry, and access window computation. Familiarity with tools like Skyfield, GMAT, or STK. This is valuable but learnable on the job.

  • Geospatial engineering. GeoJSON, CZML, WGS84, map projections, coverage polygons, and ground footprints. Experience building systems that process and render geospatial data.

  • Space, defence, or intelligence sector experience. You have worked in an environment where users depend on the software you build, where the physics constrains what is possible, and where the quality of your work has direct operational consequences. You understand what a tasking workflow looks like from a user perspective.

Application Process

• TA Partner Screen Call
• Hiring Manager Interview
• Technical Interview
• Values & Fit Interview
• SVP of Engineering Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

• Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the why behind decisions.
• See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
• Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
• Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
• Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us and we will do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

ROLE HIGHLIGHTS

  • Role: Senior Operations Specialist (Flight Engineer)

  • Department: HAPS

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Working type: On site, with limited remote working

THE MISSION OF THE SENIOR OPERATIONS SPECIALIST (FLIGHT ENGINEER)

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

  • Design board-level electronic systems for satellite radar units and RF boards, focusing on power and control circuits

  • Test and validate electronic designs to ensure functionality, performance, and compliance with requirements

  • Document schematics, PCB layouts, and test procedures throughout development

  • Collaborate with RF, mechanical, and software teams to deliver integrated payload systems

  • Support troubleshooting and iteration during development and testing phases

  • Contribute to improving reliability and performance of electronic subsystems in demanding environments

  • 4+ years of experience in electronics engineering with a focus on practical product development

  • Strong experience in analog electronics design

  • Experience with PCB design tools such as Altium

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering disciplines

• Title: Engineering Operations Manager

  • Department: Spacecraft Hardware

  • Location: Espoo

  • Reports to: Engineering Operations Management Lead

  • Contract: Permanent

  • Working style: Hybrid / Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

Why this role matters

This role ensures complex space system projects are executed with clarity, accountability, and strong cross-functional coordination, reducing risk and enabling high-quality outcomes. By driving disciplined planning, effective decision-making, and consistent Design-to-Build adoption, it strengthens execution while fostering a motivated and collaborative team culture.

Requirements & Expected outcomes

Expected Outcomes

ICEYE’s growing portfolio of high-impact programs requires dedicated leadership for select critical projects. While Directors oversee many initiatives and engineers lead most development work, the Engineering Operations Manager (EOM) will take charge of key efforts such as next-generation satellite designs and major technology upgrades, coordinating subsystem owners and assigned engineers.

The EOM is accountable for project execution and has authority over allocated resources. They propose project timelines aligned with organizational needs, request appropriate resourcing, and then own and manage the schedule across engineering teams.

For other space-system projects, the EOM proactively identifies bottlenecks, escalates challenges with recommended actions to Directors or VPs, and ensures alignment with organizational objectives.

The EOM facilitates efficient technical decision-making by assembling the right experts, resolving most issues directly, and involving Directors or senior leadership when decisions carry major implications.

They use available tools to motivate teams and enable project leads to work effectively. Delivering a project at the cost of team morale or collaboration is considered a failure for the role.

Finally, the EOM owns the implementation of the design-to-build process, ensuring consistent quality and execution across all subsystem owners and project leaders.

Success requires comprehensive planning and foresight across the project lifecycle.

Project/Subsystem Leadership (Critical Planning Tasks)

  • Perform work breakdown (WBS).

  • Build, monitor, and maintain the project timeline.

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate risks proactively.

  • Ensure documentation is in place and aligns with D2B standards.

Enabling Other Project Coordinators & Subsystem Owners

  • Run the project management process, including resource allocation and reporting.

  • Develop ways to share best project management practices.

  • Aligning with the supply chain on prioritization of orders and providing visibility on critical items.

Essential Qualifications and Traits

  • Technical Acumen: Able to understand the technical requirements and complexity of the project and dissect what the main bottlenecks and challenges would be.

  • Hands-on Experience: Possess hands-on experience and knows how long things take because you have done them or worked closely with stakeholders.

  • Risk Management: Able to understand where to take risk and comfortably take that risk when needed for project success.

  • Contingency Thinker: Know that the project needs a Plan A, B, C, D... and is always ready to change direction to succeed.

  • Proactive Drive: High energy and drive; you respond to challenges by saying, "let me take a look," and immediately devise a plan with compromises to achieve success.

These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.




REQUIREMENTS & EXPECTED OUTCOMES


EXPECTED OUTCOMES

ICEYE’s growing portfolio of high-impact programs requires dedicated leadership for select critical projects. While Directors oversee many initiatives and engineers lead most development work, the Engineering Operations Manager (EOM) will take charge of key efforts such as next-generation satellite designs and major technology upgrades, coordinating subsystem owners and assigned engineers.

The EOM is accountable for project execution and has authority over allocated resources. They propose project timelines aligned with organizational needs, request appropriate resourcing, and then own and manage the schedule across engineering teams.

For other space-system projects, the EOM proactively identifies bottlenecks, escalates challenges with recommended actions to Directors or VPs, and ensures alignment with organizational objectives.

The EOM facilitates efficient technical decision-making by assembling the right experts, resolving most issues directly, and involving Directors or senior leadership when decisions carry major implications.

They use available tools to motivate teams and enable project leads to work effectively. Delivering a project at the cost of team morale or collaboration is considered a failure for the role.

Finally, the EOM owns the implementation of the design-to-build process, ensuring consistent quality and execution across all subsystem owners and project leaders.

Success requires comprehensive planning and foresight across the project lifecycle.




PROJECT/SUBSYSTEM LEADERSHIP (CRITICAL PLANNING TASKS)

 - Perform work breakdown (WBS).

 - Build, monitor, and maintain the project timeline.

 - Identify, assess, and mitigate risks proactively.

 - Ensure documentation is in place and aligns with D2B standards.


ENABLING OTHER PROJECT COORDINATORS & SUBSYSTEM OWNERS

 - Run the project management process, including resource allocation and reporting.

 - Develop ways to share best project management practices.

 - Aligning with the supply chain on prioritization of orders and providing visibility on critical items.




ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND TRAITS

 - Technical Acumen: Able to understand the technical requirements and complexity of the project and dissect what the main bottlenecks and challenges would be.

 - Hands-on Experience: Possess hands-on experience and knows how long things take because you have done them or worked closely with stakeholders.

 - Risk Management: Able to understand where to take risk and comfortably take that risk when needed for project success.

 - Contingency Thinker: Know that the project needs a Plan A, B, C, D... and is always ready to change direction to succeed.

 - Proactive Drive: High energy and drive; you respond to challenges by saying, "let me take a look," and immediately devise a plan with compromises to achieve success.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager – Insurance and Banking
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Strategic Account Manager – Insurance and Banking

  • Location: Tokyo

  • Department: Solutions Line of Business

  • Reports to: Head of Re/Insurance, Europe

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

Within ICEYE, the Solutions Team is dedicated to developing and deploying products utilising ICEYE’s unique remote sensing and intelligence capabilities, to support commercial and civil government customers. ICEYE’s natural catastrophe solutions enable customers to respond rapidly, mitigate the impact, and enhance resilience.

As the Strategic Account Manager – Insurance and Banking, you will lead ICEYE’s sales efforts into the insurance and banking sectors across Japan. You will be responsible for sales within the region, including originating new business with new customers, and extending the scope of use of ICEYE solutions within our existing customer base.

This is not a standard sales role; you will contribute to the evolution of the Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy for these sectors in Japan and be the primary driver of ICEYE’s commercial growth in one of our most strategic markets.

Japan will be your core focus and primary revenue responsibility, while you will also support the role of our Japanese business as a strategic hub for broader expansion within Asia. You will collaborate with other teams within the Solutions LoB to help shape our product strategy and service model for this important market.

You will operate at the intersection of ICEYE’s agile, high-growth global culture and the complex, trust-based environment of Japan’s leading enterprises, while selectively contributing to regional growth initiatives across APAC.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees across Poland, Spain, Germany, the UK, Australia, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US.

We’re a growing international team of builders. Join us.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Grow ICEYE’s Solutions business in the Japanese insurance and banking markets by originating and closing new contracts with new customers, and extending the scope of use of ICEYE solutions within our existing customer base.

Develop the end-to-end Go-To-Market strategy for Japan, identifying and capturing new market opportunities with ICEYE’s innovative solutions

Contribute to a regional GTM strategy, grounded in structured market intelligence to inform ICEYE’s global commercial strategy, prioritize target accounts, and guide product development and resource allocation

  • Take full ownership of a designated strategic anchor account within the Japanese insurance market, with end-to-end responsibility for relationship development, revenue growth, and long-term partnership success. This is a long-standing ICEYE customer and account

  • Build and execute account plans that position ICEYE as a mission-critical partner to this anchor client, expanding across business units and use cases

  • Grow and develop a multi-year opportunity pipeline (2026–2028), establishing a sustainable foundation for long-term growth and recurring partnerships across the insurance sector

  • Establish ICEYE as a recognized leader and trusted partner within the Japanese financial services ecosystem through consistent engagement with insurers, reinsurers, brokers and banks, and through industry events

  • Build and nurture long-term, trust-based relationships with C-suite executives and key decision-makers across major Japanese enterprises

  • Act as a bridge between ICEYE’s global teams and local customers, aligning expectations and translating business needs into technical and commercial solutions

  • Drive collaboration with ICEYE’s Missions, Data, and Solutions teams to identify and close integrated opportunities, ensuring coherent positioning and value creation across product lines

  • Support and contribute to GTM strategy and sales execution across APAC, leveraging Japan as a reference market while selectively developing regional opportunities

  • Identify opportunities for disaster-resilience and catastrophe-related solutions, leveraging Japan’s unique risk landscape to pilot and scale new SAR-based offerings

  • Act as an internal advocate to productize locally developed solutions and integrate them into ICEYE’s global roadmap.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 10+ years of sales experience, preferably within the insurance industry

  • Strong experience selling to insurers/reinsurers or banks (ideally both), in Japan

  • Proven track record in complex, consultative, and strategic enterprise sales, including ownership of large, strategic accounts

  • Deep understanding of the Japanese sales cycle, including trust-based relationship building, consensus-driven decision-making, and long-term account development

Role highlights:

  • Role: Forward Deployed AI Engineer

  • Department: Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Location: Germany

  • Reports to: VP, Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time)

  • German security clearance (Sicherheitsüberprüfung Ü1/Ü2/Ü3)

  • Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances

  • Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to.

The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer

In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Day to day responsibilities:

Platform Deployment & Integration

  • Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers).

  • Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters.

  • Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools.

  • Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access.

AI Solution Development & Customization

  • Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context-aware analysis.

  • Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks.

  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language.

  • Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources.

Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows

  • Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT).

  • Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities.

  • Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.

Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping

  • Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems.

  • Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements.

  • Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage.

  • Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams.

What we are looking for

Must have skills:

  • 3+ years hands-on software engineering building and deploying production systems.

  • Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems.

  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases.

  • Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments.

  • Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production,

  • Familiarity with Linux and basic Kubernetes operations.

  • Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritize working solutions over perfect architecture.

  • Strong communication + customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.

  • Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.

Nice to have skills:

  • Experience in defense, intelligence, or government operational environments.

  • Deploying to on-prem data centers and/or air-gapped networks.

  • Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.

  • Experience with MCP integrations, multi-agent systems, or agentic workflows.

  • Deeper Kubernetes, IaC (Terraform/Ansible), and/or offline CI/CD.

  • Understanding of intelligence analysis workflows and defense/government requirements.

  • Experience with data fusion, multi-source intelligence integration, or GIS tools (ArcGIS, QGIS).

  • Background in solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer success.

  • Experience in defense tech (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, Scale AI, similar startups).

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. 



Your day-to-day responsibilities

 - Perform advanced assembly and integration activities including critical torque and bonding operations, subsystem integration, and complex test setups

 - Lead the identification and resolution of build and process issues, collaborating with Specialists, AIT Engineering, and Quality to perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions

 - Review work instructions, travelers, and checklists for accuracy, providing actionable feedback for revision and initiating improvement projects in safety, reliability, tooling, and efficiency

 - Act as a coach and role model for junior and standard technicians, providing on-the-job training and transferring best practices across the team

 - Support Production Line Owners and Team Leaders by preparing test environments, verifying configurations, and contributing technical insight during line meetings

 - Maintain a clean, organised, and audit-ready work environment compliant with ESD, safety, and cleanliness standards




What we’re looking for

Must haves:

 - Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience

 - 3+ years of practical experience in mechanical assembly or integration, ideally in aerospace or another high-reliability environment

 - Strong understanding of structural assembly techniques including torqueing, alignment, and thermal hardware application (panels, structures, deployables, pads, pastes, tapes)

 - Familiarity with aerospace standards (ECSS, IPC, ISO) and cleanroom practices

 - Proven ability to interpret engineering documentation and translate it into practical work instructions

 - Strong attention to detail, structured problem-solving, and clear communication skills on the production floor



Nice to haves:

 - Experience with satellite mechanical subsystems and thermal hardware integration

 - Exposure to environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum)

 - Experience supporting design-for-manufacturing (DfM) initiatives

 - Familiarity with ERP or MES systems in a production environment

 - Knowledge of deployable mechanisms

Role highlights:

  • Location: Espoo, Uusimaa, Finland

  • Department: Product Management

  • Reports to: Product Design Director

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid (3 days / week in office)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

This is the kind of project designers wait years for. You'll be the design lead and hands-on builder on one of the most exciting products we're working on: a largely greenfield space where AI and LLMs meet serious data intelligence and where the problems are genuinely hard, the kind nobody has solved before, because the product itself is new territory. We can't say much more here (some things we build, we keep quiet about) but if the idea of turning cutting-edge intelligence into something people can actually use makes your fingers itch, this is it. You won't inherit a design system or a roadmap but you'll shape both. And you won't do it alone: we're building a world-class design team from a small core and early hires like you set the bar for everyone who comes after. This role is for a builder, an IC who gets their energy from making things, not managing them


Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.


Your day-to-day responsibilities:

  • Own design end to end for the product: from fuzzy problem to research to concept to polished, shipped UI. No handoffs, no "that's another team's job."

  • Get out of the building (or into the ground station). Talk to users regularly, watch how they work and turn what you learn into design decisions everyone can get behind.

  • Make the complex feel simple. Take AI, LLM and data-heavy workflows and turn them into experiences that feel obvious in hindsight.

  • Prototype fast and often. Test ideas with real users and real data before we commit engineering time and kill your darlings when the evidence says so.

  • Work elbow to elbow with engineers, data scientists and product. You're in the room when problems get framed, not just when screens get requested.

  • Set the design foundations. As one of the first designers on this product, you'll shape the patterns, quality bar and ways of working that everyone after you builds on.

  • Push the craft. Sweat the details, raise the bar on every release and give (and take) sharp design feedback.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Your craft is genuinely top-tier and your portfolio proves it. Sharp UX thinking, beautiful execution, obsessive attention to detail. We'll look closely so bring work you're proud of down to the last pixel.

  • You've designed for data products, ML or AI, and you have opinions about it. You know what makes these experiences tricky and you've wrestled with at least some of it in real work.

  • You've shipped design work that actually changed something. Adoption went up, churn went down, customers stopped swearing at the product. You can tell us what happened after you hit publish, ideally with numbers.

  • You're a bit obsessed with users. Nobody has to send you to talk to customers; you're already there, asking awkward questions and coming back with your assumptions rearranged.

  • You get a kick out of messy, ambiguous problems. There's no playbook here, half the time nobody knows what the answer is yet, and that's exactly where you do your best work.

  • You own your stuff. The wins, sure, but also the faceplants. You'll tell us what went sideways, what you learned and what you'd do differently, without us having to drag it out of you.

  • You make things happen without being asked. No design ops, no ticket queue, no waiting for permission. You spot what's needed, rally the right people, and ship.

Nice to haves:

  • You've designed in a properly technical environment, elbow to elbow with engineers or scientists, on systems with real complexity under the hood.

  • Satellites genuinely excite you. If you've ever fallen down a Wikipedia rabbit hole about Earth observation at 1am, we should talk.

  • Department: Space Systems

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Reports to: Engineering Manager, Space Systems

  • Working type: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


The Mission of the Senior Radio Frequency Engineer

As Senior RF Engineer, you will be at the heart of designing and advancing the next generation of ICEYE's satellites — pushing the boundaries of what small sensing satellites can achieve. Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams, you will own the design, testing, and continuous improvement of satellite RF and microwave hardware, from PCB design and component selection to link budget analysis and advanced measurements. When things go wrong, you will be the one to diagnose why — conducting root-cause analysis and providing hands-on technical support for an ever-expanding fleet of operational satellites in orbit.

Who are we?

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Day to day responsibilities:

  • You will work closely with engineers from other domains to design a new generation of satellites and ensure continuous improvements of them.

  • Your responsibilities will include designing and testing satellite RF hardware, tackling the challenges inherent in the new space engineering approach, and pushing the boundaries of what small sensing satellites can achieve.

  • You will also be involved in the design of both passive and active microwave systems, and provide technical support for our expanding fleet of satellites. If you're ready to take on these exciting challenges, we’d love to have you on board.

Requirements:

Must have skills

  • Master's degree in Radio/RF/Communications/Signal/Electrical engineering.

  • 5 years+ of experience in RF and microwave engineering (including PCB board design, link budget, component selection).

  • Familiar how to use common measurement equipment and skilled to do advanced measurements.

  • Proficient problem-solving and debugging skills. Capability to tackle unconventional tasks and problems.

  • Ability to perform root-cause analysis on failures.

  • Ability to communicate clearly in English (written and spoken).

  • Ability to work independently, but also a co-operative team player.

  • Suits well in a multicultural environment.

  • Capability to drive a new project from the technical side, facing unknown issues and collaborating with people from different domains to solve it.

  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Willingness to be involved in the whole life cycle of the satellite

Nice to have skills

  • Prior experience in aerospace systems.

  • Prior experience with high frequency (5+ GHz) systems.

  • Capability to manage basic projects.

  • Prior experience in Altium, CST, Python.


Application process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge

  • Hiring Team Interview

  • Offer Decision

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

Role highlights:

  • Smart Manufacturing, Software

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Smart Manufacturing Engineer, Team Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

A mid‑level software engineer focused on production test automation. This person will work first on RAVEN (our in-house production test automation and procedure framework project), then expand to broader Smart Manufacturing Engineering (SME) work integrating software with electronic test equipment and stations.

This is a role for someone who’s Strong in Advanced Python, Linux, automation frameworks and lab instruments, and who is motivated by keeping real hardware tests reliable for operators on the production floor.

In the near term, a significant part of the role involves supporting and stabilizing production test stations, diagnosing failures, and improving operator reliability. Over time, the role shifts toward more proactive development of reusable automation, tooling, and test infrastructure.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Requirements

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Initially, the balance is roughly 40% Python/test-automation development, 10% documentation, and 50% production support - shifting toward more proactive development over time.

    • Develop and review RAVEN procedures and libraries in Python/Robot Framework.

    • Investigate intermittent test failures using logs, measurements and systematic debugging.

    • Support operators on test stations when something breaks or is unclear.

    • Improve CI/test pipelines and reporting for production tests.

    • Write and update documentation so that stations and procedures are easier to use and maintain.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

• Location: Warsaw, Poland
• Department: Engineering
• Reports to: Engineering Lead, AOCS Software
• Employment type: Permanent

Why this role matters:

As a Senior C++ Engineer – Satellite Real-Time Control Systems, you’ll develop and operate real-time embedded software that powers ICEYE’s growing SAR satellite constellation. Every radar image, collision-avoidance manoeuvre, and customer mission relies on deterministic, high-performance software deployed continuously to satellites operating in unforgiving orbital dynamics.

Your work will directly enable first responders to map floods, insurers to assess damage, and scientists to measure a changing planet. In this role, microseconds matter and every line of code has a direct, global impact from space.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. Your day-to-day responsibilities

• Write and optimize modern C++ code that meets strict determinism and latency budgets for safe and precise on-orbit execution
• Build and own the software layer that bridges sensors, actuators, and control algorithms including deterministic loops, telemetry pipelines, and on-orbit autonomy
• Drive quality across the full development lifecycle from requirements and design to HIL and MIL testing, launch, and on-orbit support
• Collaborate with GNC, electronics, ground segment, and mission operations engineers to debug, iterate, and improve system performance
• Lead architecture evolution as the fleet and use cases grow by refactoring, optimizing, and introducing new technologies where they add value
• Investigate anomalies by deep-diving into flight telemetry, reproducing issues on the ground, and rolling out fixes that keep the constellation healthy

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

• Strong experience writing modern C++ with a clear understanding of production-quality code
• Proven track record of delivering real-time control software for autonomous or safety-critical systems such as satellites, drones, robotics, or automotive systems
• Solid understanding of hard real-time constraints, latency budgeting, and deterministic behaviour
• Experience interfacing with sensors and actuators in embedded Linux environments
• Strong engineering practices including rigorous testing, CI/CD, and clear documentation
• Ownership mindset across the full software lifecycle from concept to on-orbit maintenance
• Clear communicator who collaborates effectively across multidisciplinary teams

Nice to haves:

• Experience with hardware-in-the-loop and model-in-the-loop testing
• Experience supporting software in operational or mission-critical environments
• Familiarity with satellite GNC or space systems

jobs.title: Senior Operations Specialist (Solar Stratospheric Aircraft Mission Planning)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ROLE HIGHLIGHTS

  • Role: Senior Operations Specialist (Solar Stratospheric Aircraft Mission Planning)

  • Department: HAPS

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Working type: On site, with limited remote working

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

THE MISSION OF THE SENIOR OPERATIONS SPECIALIST (HAPS MISSION PLANNING)

As Senior Operations Specialist (HAPS Mission Planning), you will shape where, when and how ICEYE's stratospheric, solar-powered electric aircraft flies. You will build and maintain the operational weather picture before and during each flight, identify the right windows to launch, fly and recover, and turn weather, airspace, aircraft performance and energy constraints into a safe and achievable mission plan that you keep up to date as conditions evolve.

The role is deliberately broad. Beyond mission planning, you will contribute across the Operations team: preparing and executing flight test campaigns, supporting ground control station operations, assessing flight results and feeding them back into the aircraft's development, and helping build the procedures and tools of an operations capability that will scale as the program grows.

WHO ARE WE?

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Flight operations

  • Build and maintain the operational meteorological picture before and during the flight, using the available tools (forecast models, radiosondes, lidar and aircraft data), drift planning, and identify weather and terrain-related hazards relevant to the flight profile.

  • Identify suitable launch, flight and recovery windows and communicate them to the flight crew.

  • Develop and maintain the mission plan (route, altitude, speed profile and timing), customer mission goals, integrating weather, airspace, aircraft performance, aircraft health and energy constraints.

  • Continuously assess predicted cut-down and debris impact zones to keep the planned trajectory within the permitted ground impact area.

  • Maintain readiness for degraded operations for a return-to-home mission profile in case re-planning of a return is necessary or in case of the plane entering a degraded operational mode due to a mechanical or electrical servicing need.

  • Monitor aircraft progress against the plan, update it when required, and coordinate mission planning and meteorological decisions with the flight crew and engineering teams.

Wider operations support

  • Contribute to the planning, preparation and execution of flight test campaigns, including site preparation, pre-flight checks, launch and recovery activities.

  • Take on other crew positions or ground control station duties as operational needs require, building versatility across the Operations team.

  • Analyse flight data after each flight, report results and translate findings into improvements for the aircraft, its systems and operating procedures.

  • Develop and maintain operational procedures, checklists, emergency procedures and operations documentation.

  • Develop and improve monitoring, analysis and planning tools used by the flight crew, such as telemetry dashboards and energy or thermal estimation tools.

  • Support aircraft integration, ground testing and simulation activities, and contribute to the training and qualification of crew members.

  • Support safety and risk assessments for operations and, when needed, coordination with aviation authorities and external partners.

REQUIREMENTS

Must have skills

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in UAS or aircraft testing and operations.

  • Good knowledge of meteorology (wind profiles, convection, turbulence, icing, thermal activity, etc.) and the ability to interpret forecast models, synoptic charts and upper-air data.

  • Experience in flight or mission planning, including route, altitude and timing under weather and airspace constraints.

  • Understanding of aircraft performance and of how weather affects flight safety and endurance.

  • Clear communication and the ability to work as part of a flight crew, including during long-endurance operations.

  • Programming or scripting skills for data analysis and tooling (e.g. Python; C/C++) a plus.

  • Ability to drive large vehicles or convoys (within limits of B license).

  • Good command of the English language, both oral and written.

Nice to have skills

  • Aviation meteorology qualification, or experience as a forecaster or weather briefer for flight operations.

  • Hands-on experience with radiosonde launches, lidar or other atmospheric measurement systems.

  • Experience with airspace management and coordination with ATC.

  • Experience with trajectory, cut-down or debris impact modelling.

  • Experience with solar-powered, electric or long-endurance aircraft, or with high-altitude platforms and balloons.

  • Experience with safety analysis in the SORA framework.

  • Familiarity with GIS tools, autopilot mission planning and ground software like QGroundControl.

  • EASA-valid remote pilot license up to specific category standard scenarios.

  • Proactive can-do attitude and love for aerospace are expected.

APPLICATION PROCESS

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge

  • Hiring Team Interview

  • Offer Decision
