Role Highlights:

  • Title: AIT Engineer – Optical Systems

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

About the role

ICEYE is seeking an AIT Engineer to support the assembly, integration, and testing of satellite systems, including the integration of optical payloads into the spacecraft platform.

This is a hands-on technical role in an early-stage production environment, where systems are still evolving and processes are not yet fully defined. You will work directly with flight hardware in cleanroom conditions, supporting the assembly, integration, and testing of the satellite bus, as well as the integration and validation of optical payloads provided by external suppliers.

You will contribute to bringing the full satellite system from design into production, ensuring that optical payloads are successfully integrated with the satellite platform (bus), and that the system can be built, tested, and scaled reliably. This includes supporting troubleshooting and continuous improvement during production ramp-up.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

What you will do

  • Execute assembly, integration, and testing (AIT) of satellite subsystems and optical payloads

  • Perform optical alignment and integration activities (focus, tilt, centering, boresight) using precision equipment

  • Conduct hands-on inspection, assembly, and verification of satellite hardware in cleanroom environments

  • Support integration of externally supplied optical payloads into the satellite system

  • Identify, contain, and drive root cause analysis of non-conformances; implement corrective actions and feedback into design and production processes

  • Define and execute test and verification activities, including integration and acceptance testing at subsystem and system level

  • Support optical and system-level performance validation

  • Define, develop, and maintain process plans, procedures, and technical documentation, supporting implementation and continuous improvement of manufacturing and integration processes

  • Contribute to AIT process definition and improvement, enabling scalable production

  • Interface with optical, mechanical, and electrical engineering teams to ensure system-level integration

  • Collaborate with external suppliers during payload integration and validation

  • Support setup of tooling, fixtures, and test setups (GSE) required for production

  • Apply system-level understanding to anticipate integration risks across subsystems and ensure successful builds

What we’re looking for

Must have

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in integration, testing, or production of complex hardware systems, with relevant experience in optical systems, optomechanics, physics, or other high-precision hardware

  • Hands-on experience with optical systems integration and alignment (focus, tilt, centering, boresight)

  • Experience working with optical payloads or Earth Observation systems

  • Familiarity with optical metrology tools (e.g. interferometers, collimators, optical benches, MTF setups)

  • Good system-level understanding across multiple disciplines (optical, mechanical, electrical)

  • Experience working with precision hardware in cleanroom environments

  • Experience working in structured production environments (e.g. MES or similar systems)

  • Strong troubleshooting skills with structured root cause analysis

  • Ability to analyze and interpret test data to support integration and validation activities

  • Experience developing or working with process plans and technical documentation

  • Ability to work in fast-paced and evolving production environments

  • Proactive, hands-on approach to problem-solving

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting environmental testing (e.g. thermal vacuum, vibration)

  • Experience working with external suppliers or partners

  • Experience supporting systems from prototype through production ramp-up

  • Experience working in lean manufacturing or continuous improvement environments

  • Hiring Manager General Interview

  • Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge

  • Hiring Team + Director-level Interview

  • Offer Decision

jobs.title: Configuration Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Configuration Manager

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Department: Manufacturing Assurance; Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: Configuration and Change Team Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

We are looking for a highly skilled Configuration Manager to join our Configuration Management and Change Control team within the Global Manufacturing Organization (GMO). In this role, you will play a crucial part in executing our CM functions across multi-domain environments and ensuring flawless product data integrity for multi-site manufacturing.

As a Configuration Manager, your mission is to actively bridge engineering and manufacturing by capturing product information, structuring it effectively, and managing changes throughout the product lifecycle for the local production site. Reporting to the global CM Team, you will act as a subject matter expert, driving configuration consistency and ensuring changes are rigorously controlled and documented within the local site.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Execute and support the continuous improvement of the Configuration Management Standard Operating Procedures (CM SOPs).

  • Establish and manage product baselines for assigned segments, ensuring absolute data consistency across PLM, ERP and MES systems.

  • Independently manage the day-to-day change management process for assigned projects; process ECRs, ECOs, RFDs, and RFWs, and actively participate in or facilitate Change Control Boards (CCB).

  • Structure and maintain EBOM/MBOM as well as CIDL/ABCL configurations, ensuring seamless transitions and accurate product breakdowns.

  • Apply and enforce item classification schemes, part numbering conventions, and product breakdown structures across hardware and software.

  • Ensure that all relevant personnel at the site are trained on CM processes, workflows, and system usage, and maintain awareness of updates or changes to established procedures.

  • Act as an ambassador for the PLM and MES platforms, proactively guiding cross-functional teams on CM best practices and effective system utilization to drive adoption, streamline workflows, and protect data integrity.

  • Collaborate closely with program managers, engineers, supply chain, and quality assurance to resolve configuration issues and maintain integrity.

  • Track and compile CM metrics, KPIs, and configuration status reports for your assigned projects, identifying risks and proposing solutions.

  • Adapt CM practices to suit a rapid-paced environment, balancing prototype cycles, design iterations, and multi-program concurrency.


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Engineering background (Bachelor’s in electrical, electronics, mechanical, aerospace, or a relevant engineering discipline).

  • 4 to 6 years of experience in configuration management or a closely related engineering discipline within the aerospace, defense, or automotive industry.

  • Working knowledge of configuration management standards (e.g., ECSS-M-ST-40, EIA-649, or MIL-STD-973).

  • Experience with hardware and/or software configuration management within a multi-domain product environment.

  • Demonstrated experience processing change documentation and actively contributing to a CCB.

  • Strong understanding of the distinction between EBOM and MBOM, product breakdown structures, and item classification methodologies.

  • Hands-on experience with at least one PLM system (e.g., Arena, Windchill, Teamcenter, Enovia, Aras) and familiarity with an MES or ERP system.

  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment where processes are still maturing.

  • Fluent in English. Spanish is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Telemetry)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
• Senior Software Engineer (Telemetry)

  • Fleet Automation, Engineering

  • Espoo, Finland

  • Permanent

  • Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

The Mission of the Senior Software Engineer (Telemetry)

Satellite telemetry does not forgive gaps. Build the systems that make sure there are none.

ICEYE's SAR constellation generates a continuous stream of data that fleet operations depend on to function. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Fleet Automation team, you will be a key contributor to the infrastructure that makes that data usable: the pipelines, parsers, and time-series stores that translate raw satellite signals into operational state in near real-time. The scope is expanding, the ownership is real, and the engineering problems are ones you will not find anywhere else.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.


Expected Outcomes and Requirements

Outcomes:

  • Telemetry pipelines ingest, transform, and store satellite data from across the fleet reliably and in near real-time, with minimal manual intervention

  • Telemetry data stores are performant and well-maintained, including schema design, query optimisation, capacity planning, and zero-downtime production migrations

  • Anomaly detection and automated recovery systems reduce operational load on the mission operations team

  • TTC gateway telemetry integration is delivered as a production-grade component ready for customer deployment

  • Engineering quality across the team is actively raised through code reviews, testing standards, and support of less experienced engineers


Role-specific Competences

  • Strong Python proficiency in production backend systems; experience with Go or Rust is a plus

  • Proven experience building and operating telemetry systems, data pipelines, and distributed systems in production

  • Strong working knowledge of PostgreSQL and at least one time-series database such as InfluxDB or Prometheus

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes-native environments, Docker, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and Helm

  • Actively uses AI and LLM tooling as part of their engineering workflow

  • AWS or equivalent cloud platform experience is a plus


Key Competences

In addition to the requirements above, we evaluate candidates on these key qualities throughout the hiring process:

Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.

Passion and Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.

Ownership and Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.

Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.

Integrity and Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.


Application Process

  • TA Partner Screen

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Interview

  • Values and Fit Interview

  • Final Interview with SVP of Engineering


What We Offer at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you will join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. We know that we will succeed only through exceptional people in our team, which is why your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority.

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. You will benefit from continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and integrity. ICEYE is a place where your contributions have a visible impact, and where we celebrate success together.


Benefits

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defense Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment

  • Occupational healthcare, occupational, and accident insurance

  • A yearly benefit budget to spend as you wish (sport, transport, bike benefit, wellness, lunch, etc.)

  • Phone subscription with iPhone of choice

  • Relocation support (flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support)

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes

  • Inspiring and collaborative offices and silent workspaces to enable focus

Base salary range for this position is 6 000 to 8 500 EUR per month (gross), contingent on your experience level, and will be negotiated individually.


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, we believe that diversity is not just a buzzword, it is our greatest asset.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. We know that diverse perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we actively seek out individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and experiences.

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. Join us and be part of a team where differences are not only embraced but cherished, because together, we are stronger.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who may need workplace adjustments. If you require any specific accommodations or assistance during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

  • Perform advanced electronic assembly and integration activities including subsystem integration (power, command, data handling), critical soldering and bonding operations, and complex test setups

  • Operate mechanical and electrical ground support equipment (power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes) to support smooth test operations

  • Act as a coach and role model for junior and standard technicians, providing on-the-job training and transferring best practices across the team

  • Maintain a clean, organised, and audit-ready work environment compliant with ESD, safety, and cleanliness standards

  • Experience using lab equipment including power supplies, multimeters, and oscilloscopes

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and wiring diagrams

  • Proven ability to lead troubleshooting efforts and mentor junior staff effectively

  • Proficient English (written and spoken) for cross-functional collaboration

  • User-level Python and Linux: able to run test scripts, interpret error output and make small adjustments safely

  • Experience with satellite avionics, power subsystems, and flight-critical command handling

  • Advanced IPC certifications (IPC-A-610, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum)

  • Experience with Atlassian Cloud tools (Jira, Confluence)

  • Aerospace or space industry background

  • Lean and Six Sigma experience

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

Staff Optical Engineer

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Engineering / Optical Systems

  • Reports to: Engineering Manager, Optical Systems

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As Staff Optical Engineer, you will be a senior member of the tiger team shaping ICEYE's next generation of spaceborne imaging systems. Drawing on deep, hands-on experience across imaging optics, from telescopes to full camera systems, you will define how these instruments are architected, resolving the trade-offs between detector performance and optical design that determine what the system can ultimately achieve. Beyond the design work itself, you will act as a technical anchor for the wider engineering group, mentoring engineers and raising the ceiling of what the team is able to build as it takes on more ambitious optical systems.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Steer the architecture and technical direction of the team's imaging systems as a senior member of the team, staying involved from initial concept through manufacturing, assembly, alignment, and qualification.

  • Shape how imaging systems come together end to end, connecting optical design decisions with detector-side elements such as focal plane assembly, and applying your experience with large optics to current and future instrument generations.

  • Mentor engineers across the team day to day, passing on the optical judgement and system-level thinking that will let the group take on larger, more demanding designs.


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Extensive experience in imaging optics, ideally including cameras, space telescopes, and other imaging systems, gained across the full product lifecycle from concept and design through manufacturing, quality control, assembly, alignment, and qualification.

  • Knowledge of optical system design together with the detector side of the system, including focal plane and detector assemblies.

  • Experience working as an imaging systems architect, familiar with the trade-offs and typical architectures for imaging systems,

  • Ability to assess designs and requirements and own the technical trade-offs for the system, with a focus on current and future designs.

  • Strong mentoring skills, comfortable working with a group of engineers on a daily basis.

  • Degree in optical engineering, applied physics, or a related field, with 10+ years of relevant experience.

Nice to haves:

Role highlights:

Engineering Lead, Electronics

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Engineering / Optical Systems

  • Reports to: Director of Engineering

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

Acting as the satellite's main electronics authority, you will drive the architecture and hands-on engineering decisions behind the payload while also building and managing a small, growing team of electronics engineers. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Customer Excellence Specialist

  • Location: Seoul, Korea OR Singapore OR New Delhi, India

  • Department: Customer Excellence – Data

  • Reports to: Customer Excellence Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Work model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

 

Why this role matters

Deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order-to-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.

 

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. You will work closely with our satellite operations, product, and analytics teams to make sure every delivery meets ICEYE’s world-class standards and customer expectations.

 

Who We Are

 

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data-driven decisions.

 

Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

 

Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management:

  • Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.

  • Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.

Satellite Resource Planning:

  • Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.

  • Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.

Customer Interaction:

  • Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.

  • Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.

Process Improvement:

  • Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.

  • Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.

Product Knowledge:

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:

  • Serve as the point of contact for APAC governmental contracts and commercial clients.

  • Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.

Relationship Building:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.

Training and Progress Monitoring:

  • Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.

  • Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues

Reporting:

  • Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

 

Requirements

Must haves:

  • Proven experience in customer excellence or account management roles.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Bachelor's degree or practical experience in geography, remote sensing, or aerospace domains.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindu/Mandarin/Korean (depending on the location).

 

Key Competences

  • Intellectual Firepower: Quickly grasps complex operational and technical information, translating it into clear customer communication.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Demonstrates consistent motivation, reliability, and ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Ownership & Action: Takes accountability for order performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Team Player: Collaborates effectively with global colleagues and cross-functional teams.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Acts transparently, learns from challenges, and seeks continuous improvement.

 

Application Process

  • TA Screen Interview

  • HM interview

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

     

Working at ICEYE

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: AIT Engineering Team Manager

Why this role matters:

The Senior AIT Engineer, Electronics is the integration readiness authority for all electronics and power-related subsystems in ICEYE's satellite. You own the discipline from early design review through Production Readiness Review (PRR), production support, and system verification — ensuring that the entire electronics chain is manufacturable, testable, and takt-compatible at scale.

This is not a production execution role. You are the engineer who ensures production can execute: you own the integration logic, the procedures, the technical escalation path, and the feedback loop back to Engineering. You work in a "2-in-a-box" model with subsystem designers, they own the design, you own how it integrates.

  • Act as the satellite-wide electronics expert, the person engineering and production both turn to when electrical behaviour during integration is unclear, unexpected, or blocking

  • Work in a "2-in-a-box" partnership with Engineering subsystem owners: co-own the PRR package for your discipline, assess manufacturability and testability of design changes early, and ensure no electrical design reaches production without your integration sign-off

  • Develop, maintain, and continuously improve procedures, flows, and troubleshooting guides for your subsystems by ensuring documentation is technically correct, version-controlled, and production-executable without interpretation

  • Own Tier-2 technical support for electronics-related non-conformances and integration anomalies: triage, root cause, corrective action, and closure protecting production time and preventing recurrence

  • Participate in Engineering projects, ensuring that lessons learned translate directly into production-ready documentation and PRR

  • Train and mentor production technicians on electronics integration steps, building floor-level competence that reduces dependence on engineering escalation

  • Drive subsystem manufacturing readiness level (MRL) maturity, maintaining an improvement roadmap

Must haves:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in electronics integration, assembly, or test engineering in a hardware-intensive environment

  • Demonstrated experience owning a subsystem or discipline end-to-end from design review through integration and verification, not just executing procedures someone else wrote

  • Proficiency with electronics lab equipment: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes, data acquisition systems, and protocol analysers

  • Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, ICDs, and system-level documentation, and to translate them into practical integration and test procedures

  • Experience identifying and resolving electronics integration anomalies under time pressure, with clear root cause documentation

  • Excellent communication skills in English written and verbal, across both engineering and production audiences

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in spacecraft, aerospace, defence, or other high-reliability electronics environments

  • Familiarity with satellite power subsystems or embedded power management firmware behaviour

  • Experience writing and owning integration procedures for a production environment at scale

  • Experience with ESD-controlled and cleanroom work environments

  • Proficiency with Jira or equivalent engineering tracking and NC management systems

  • Exposure to production readiness reviews (PRR), design reviews (PDR/CDR), or equivalent formal engineering gate processes

  • Knowledge of IPC standards or equivalent electronics assembly and inspection standards

  • Python or scripting experience for test automation or diagnostic tooling

jobs.title: Senior AOCS System Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Senior AOCS System Engineer

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Engineering

  • Reports to: Jakub Lisowski, Engineering Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid ( 2- 3 days onsite at our Warsaw office)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

The Mission of the AOCS Systems Engineer

 

You ensure that our satellites always point towards the right direction enabling high-quality images.

This role is within AOCS Domain where we are responsible for maintaining attitude and orbit. Your job will be to work closely with production teams, operation teams and software teams to ensure smooth and performant operation of our ADCS and propulsion systems in orbit and on ground. Expect to be involved in the complete lifecycle of the system - from design phases of future ICEYE satellite generations to maintenance of existing systems we, and our customers operate.

You will have a chance to have a direct impact on our mission success as performance and reliability of the AOCS system directly affects the amount and quality of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data we deliver to our customers.

 
 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Expected Outcomes:

    1. Increased Imaging Performance and Mission Success. You will help driving the performance of our AOCS systems by:
      - Driving selection of future AOCS hardware components.
      - Characterizing and validating existing AOCS performance by designing and executing in-orbit experiments and analyzing telemetry data with the help of analysis software you develop.
      - Developing software tools to predict performance of our future AOCS systems.

    2. Maximized AOCS Availability. You will ensure that our systems perform as expected within their design envelope by:
      - Maintaining verification procedures and working closely with production and testing teams in implementing process improvements and new test jigs.
      - Debugging on-orbit anomalies requiring deep system system understanding and systematic approach towards pinning the root-cause. Understanding an anomaly is a first step towards preventing it in the future.
      - Supporting software teams in implementing changes to software to prevent repetition of known issues.
      - Work on software tools helping debug AOCS anomalies as they happen.

     

    1. Robust and Predictable AOCS Operations. You will help the team establish and evolve internal processes for anomaly handling and resolution.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Thinking from a first-principles mindset - your work will often involve resolving in-orbit anomalies, which you will need to tackle in a systematic manner to understand their root-cause and propose solutions to mitigate those in the future.

  • Strong understanding of AOCS fundamentals: rigid body motion, differential equations, coordinate transformations, 3d geometry, feedback loops, state estimation. Basic understanding of orbital dynamics.

  • Strong understanding of underlying principles of operation and failure modes of sensors and actuators used in AOCS: reaction wheels, magnetorquers, star trackers, gyroscopes, magnetometers, GNSS.

  • Strong understanding of performance drivers of AOCS systems.

  • Proven track record of owning cross-domain systems involving feedback control loops over their complete lifecycle including maintenance and operations.

  • Demonstrated broad knowledge across multiple engineering disciplines including controls, mechanical and electronics. AOCS is an electromechanical system in the and requires broad perspective to understand it fully

  • Proficiency in Python, C++ or Matlab.

 

Application Process

You ensure that our satellites always point towards the right direction enabling high-quality images.

This role is within AOCS Domain where we are responsible for maintaining attitude and orbit. Your job will be to work closely with production teams, operation teams and software teams to ensure smooth and performant operation of our ADCS and propulsion systems in orbit and on ground. Expect to be involved in the complete lifecycle of the system - from design phases of future ICEYE satellite generations to maintenance of existing systems we, and our customers operate.

You will have a chance to have a direct impact on our mission success as performance and reliability of the AOCS system directly affects the amount and quality of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data we deliver to our customers.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

      - Driving selection of future AOCS hardware components.
      - Characterizing and validating existing AOCS performance by designing and executing in-orbit experiments and analyzing telemetry data with the help of analysis software you develop.
      - Developing software tools to predict performance of our future AOCS systems.

      - Maintaining verification procedures and working closely with production and testing teams in implementing process improvements and new test jigs.
      - Debugging on-orbit anomalies requiring deep system system understanding and systematic approach towards pinning the root-cause. Understanding an anomaly is a first step towards preventing it in the future.
      - Supporting software teams in implementing changes to software to prevent repetition of known issues.
      - Work on software tools helping debug AOCS anomalies as they happen.
    
   
   3. Robust and Predictable AOCS Operations. You will help the team establish and evolve internal processes for anomaly handling and resolution.

Role highlights:

  • Security Officer

  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal

  • Department: Security

  • Reports to: CEO of ICEYE Portugal

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site (our office is located at Av. Defensores de Chaves 4, 1000-117 Lisboa)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

ICEYE Portugal turns sovereign intelligence from space into an operational capability built in Lisbon. This role keeps that capability secure. As ICEYE Portugal's named Local Security Officer, you are the formal interface to GNS / ANS and the CEO's trusted partner on every clearance, audit and facility question, accountable for our people, our facility and our information meeting ICEYE's global security standards and Portugal's national and NATO sovereignty requirements.

It is a hybrid role, modelled on how ICEYE runs its other international sites, and it sits at the centre of everything ICEYE Portugal does.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

Facility and physical security

  • Own ICEYE Portugal's facility security programme: physical access control, secure-room build-out, visitor management, alarms, CCTV and key management.

  • Drive the office's NATO Restricted readiness audit with GNS and prepare for higher classifications as the customer mission evolves.

  • Run the secure handling of classified material in line with Portuguese national rules and ICEYE policy.

  • Partner with the CEO, Head of People & Operations, and the local IT Site Engineer on the Class A office fit-out, specifically on secure-area readiness for clearance-restricted workflows.

Personnel security and clearances

  • Coordinate national security clearance applications (GNS / ANS) for the CEO, FDEs and other cleared roles, and maintain the cleared-personnel register (levels, expirations, briefings and debriefings).

  • Run security on-boarding and off-boarding for every employee and visitor: NDAs, security awareness, classified-handling training and access provisioning.

Information and cyber security

  • Partner with ICEYE Oy Security leadership and HQ IT to translate the global cyber baseline (endpoint, MDM, network, identity) into local controls.

  • Lead local incident-response coordination: classified leaks, lost devices, social engineering and suspicious foreign-contact reporting.

Vendor and supply-chain security

  • Vet and onboard local vendors against ICEYE security standards (cleaning, IT, real estate, broker, legal, accounting).

  • Run periodic security audits on key suppliers.

Programme and customer security interface

  • Be the named security interface to the Portuguese Air Force, GNS / ANS, NATO and the Portuguese Space Agency on ICEYE Portugal matters.

  • Support the FDEs on customer-site security questions during the SAR / SIP deployment, maintain the local security policy library, run the annual security training programme, and contribute to ICEYE's global security community of practice.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Formal Facility Security Officer (FSO) or Security Manager experience in defence, aerospace or critical infrastructure.

  • Working knowledge of physical security standards (locks, alarms, access control, CCTV, secure rooms) and information security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, NIS2).

  • Hands-on experience running or actively supporting national clearance processes (GNS / ANS) and NATO classification frameworks (NATO RESTRICTED minimum).

  • Active or recently held Portuguese national security clearance, or unambiguous eligibility to obtain one quickly.

  • Excellent written and spoken English and Portuguese.

  • Pragmatic, calm under pressure, comfortable with ambiguity and matrix reporting (Security, CEO).

  • Basic IT literacy sufficient to coordinate with the local IT Site Engineer on secure-area technical requirements (network segmentation, air-gapped systems).

 

Nice to haves:

  • Prior background as a non-commissioned or commissioned officer in the Portuguese Armed Forces, GNR, PSP, or SIS / SIED.

  • Experience with sovereign or accredited cloud (NATO RESTRICTED, EU RESTRICTED) and export-control regimes (Wassenaar, dual-use EU 2021/821).

  • Familiarity with Portugal's cyber regulator (CNCS) and NIS2 implementation.

Role highlights:

  • Senior Satellite Industrialization Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Industrialization Systems / Global Manufacturing Organization (GMO)

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office / Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Senior Satellite Industrialization Engineer, you'll do the hands-on technical work that moves satellite designs toward industrial maturity (MRL 8-9). You'll contribute to the DFM/DFX design standard, act as a technical reviewer at design-review gates, and help define the production line, automation, and facility requirements behind them. Your depth in RF, optical, or broader satellite systems keeps that work grounded in what a real satellite design actually requires.

Who We Are
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Contribute to the DFM/DFX standard: help develop and maintain design rules, tolerancing guidance, and material/process selection criteria.

  • Support the design-review gates your team is involved in: help define gate criteria and participate as a technical reviewer.

  • Support the definition of industrialization requirements beyond the design standard: production line design requirements, automation requirements, and facility requirements for satellite and subsystem manufacturing.

  • Work with Engineering, AIT, and Production teams to gather the input needed to define these requirements against real design and production constraints.

  • Support coordination with ICEYE's Global Manufacturing Infrastructure team on the detail needed to implement line, automation, and facility requirements at each site.

  • Build and maintain manufacturability and industrialization tooling: checklists, scorecards, and templates that design and production teams actually use.

  • Help track the target metrics that satellite and subsystem designs are measured against as they move through MRL stages.

  • Support the interface with the Manufacturing Engineering function, helping capture field and design friction and translate it into standard updates.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Hands-on design or systems engineering background in satellite hardware, with depth in RF, optical, or broader satellite subsystems.

  • Solid understanding of how design decisions affect manufacturability, tolerancing, integration, and test outcomes.

  • Comfortable doing the technical work of building and maintaining standards, gate criteria, and tooling, under the direction of the function's lead.

  • Experience working alongside Engineering, AIT, or Production teams to gather technical input.

  • Strong communication skills, able to translate technical design detail into clear standard and tooling content.

Nice to haves:

  • Prior exposure to DFM/DFX practices, design-review gates, or producibility standards in aerospace or comparable hardware environments.

  • Experience contributing to production line, automation, or facility requirements for hardware manufacturing.

  • Familiarity with cleanroom environments and EGSE/MGSE.

  • Experience in a multi-site or scale-up manufacturing environment.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Interview + Task

  • Final interview

jobs.descriptionHtml:
• Job title: Senior Accountant

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Team: Group Accounting

  • Employment Type: Permanent

  • Working Arrangement: Hybrid (3 days per week on-site)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

 

Who are we?

 

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy - day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

 

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

 

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, India, Portugal, the Netherlands, Germany and the US. The company has more than 1600 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

 

About the role

As ICEYE continues its rapid global expansion, our Finance organization is scaling to match the pace and ambition of the company. We are now seeking a Senior Accountant to join our Group Accounting team and play a central role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and efficiency of our financial operations. Based in Warsaw or Espoo, and reporting to the Group Accounting Senior Manager, you will be a key contributor in our monthly group closing and consolidation process, taking ownership of journal entries, accruals, reconciliations, and subsidiary oversight.

In this role, you will work at the heart of a fast-moving, international environment where accounting plays a critical role in enabling confident decision-making and supporting ICEYE’s growth trajectory. The position offers significant opportunities for professional development, exposure to complex and evolving accounting topics, and the ability to help shape and optimize our financial processes as the company scales. You will join a motivated and collaborative team that values continuous improvement, ownership, and a proactive mindset.

What you will do


Execute day-to-day general ledger and controlling activities, including timely and accurate booking of journal entries, accruals, and balance sheet reconciliations. In addition, you will:

  • Identify potential for and apply AI and automation tools to scale output and drive efficiency.

  • Support the monthly group closing, ensuring the completeness, accuracy, and consistency of group and subsidiary financial data.

  • Oversight of subsidiaries, acting as a point of contact to ensure adherence to group policies, reporting timelines, and quality requirements.

  • Contribute to the preparation of financial reporting deliverables, including IFRS footnotes for consolidated statements and FAS reporting for the parent.

  • Collaborate closely with Business Finance, Engineering, Global Manufacturing, and other teams to ensure accurate financial data, alignment on business activities, and timely information flow.

  • Drive standardisation and scalability of general ledger processes in a rapidly expanding multinational environment, promoting consistency, efficiency, and quality across entities.

  • Identify, recommend, and implement process improvements that enhance efficiency, strengthen controls, and mitigate risks before they materialise.

  • Support the development and optimisation of NetSuite by contributing to design requirements, configuration improvements, workflow enhancements, and testing activities.

  • Assist with year-end audit activities, providing accurate documentation and timely explanations.

Role-specific Competences

  • You have at least 4-5 years of experience in general ledger accounting, ideally in a high-growth, multinational environment.

  • Minimum of bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance.

  • Tangible, hands-on experience with AI and automation, demonstrated through concrete examples (beyond prompting).

  • Strong knowledge of financial reporting, including IFRS, and tax compliance.

  • Exposure to and experience in financial transformation, including process and ERP development initiatives.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, with the ability to see the bigger picture.

  • Demonstrated proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite tools and infrastructure.

  • You have excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).

  • You are based in Warsaw, Poland

In addition to the above, the following are considered advantageous:

  • In the process of obtaining or in possession of a professional accounting qualification e.g. CA, ACCA, CPA, or similar.

  • Experience working within the Big 4 .

  • Knowledge of Finnish Accounting Standards

Application Process

  • TA screening

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Take-home assignment (1 week to complete)

  • Assignment review with VP of Global Corporate Controlling and Accounting Manager

  • Final interview with CFO

 

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

 

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

 

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. • Senior Backend Software Engineer (Tactical Access)

  • Business Automation - Engineering

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Reports to: Engineering Lead of Tactical Access squad

  • Contract type: Permanent

  • Hybrid, 3 days per week in the Espoo office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)


The Mission of the Senior Backend Software Engineer


You will own the backend systems that let customers plan and manage satellite tasking through Tactical Access, ICEYE's tactical customer access product.

Tactical Access is customer-facing on two fronts, API and web, so this role sits at the intersection of backend engineering rigor and product ownership. You will design and operate the services and data models that power satellite tasking for real customers, and you will be trusted to make API design and reliability decisions that customers depend on directly, not just internal consumers.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.



Expected Outcomes & Requirements

Outcomes

  • Own end-to-end delivery of at least one significant Tactical Access backend capability, from API design through production operation, with documented tradeoffs

  • Reduce production risk in owned services through improved observability (metrics, traces, alerting) and demonstrated root-cause fixes, not just symptom patches

  • Ship API changes that account for client/customer impact (versioning, backwards compatibility) with no unplanned breaking changes to integrators

  • Collaborate directly with product managers, customers, and other engineering teams to turn business needs into the right technical tradeoffs

  • Contribute full-stack when end-to-end delivery requires it, without backend ownership slipping as a result

  • Actively raise the engineering bar in code review and architecture discussions for the team, not just their own PRs

Role-specific Competences

  • Production backend engineering experience in Go (or a closely comparable typed language) building and operating APIs and backend systems in production

  • API design and lifecycle ownership: versioning, backwards compatibility, and reasoning about customer impact of changes

  • Cloud (AWS) and container/orchestration experience (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform); on-prem environment awareness is a plus

  • Data and messaging experience: PostgreSQL for storage, NATS for event-driven communication

  • Observability experience: building and maintaining dashboards and alerting with Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry; comfortable distinguishing metrics, logs, and traces during a live incident

  • Treats testing, documentation, and code review as core engineering practice, not overhead

  • Applies security and quality best practices in a production, customer-facing system

  • Good experience in AI-assisted engineering tools (Cursor, Devin, or similar)

  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization standards (OAuth, OpenID Connect, JWT) and geospatial data (PostGIS, GeoJSON)

Key Competences

In addition to the requirements above, we evaluate candidates on these key qualities throughout the hiring process:

Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.

Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.

Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.

Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.

Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Application Process

  • TA Partner Screen

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Interview

  • Values & Fit Interview

What We Offer at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you will join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. We know that we will succeed only through exceptional people in our team, which is why your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority.

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. You will benefit from continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and integrity. ICEYE is a place where your contributions have a visible impact, and where we celebrate success together.

Benefits (Finland)

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment

  • Occupational healthcare, occupational, and accident insurance

  • A yearly benefit budget to spend as you wish (sport, transport, bike benefit, wellness, lunch, etc.)

  • Phone subscription with iPhone of choice

  • Relocation support (flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support)

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes

  • Inspiring and collaborating offices and silent workspaces enable you to focus

Base salary range for this position is 6,000-8,000 EUR per month (gross), contingent on your experience level, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, we believe that diversity isn't just a buzzword, it's our greatest asset.

We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. We know that diverse perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we actively seek out individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and experiences.

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. Join us and be part of a team where differences are not only embraced but cherished, because together, we're stronger.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who may need workplace adjustments. If you require any specific accommodations or assistance during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Type: Permanent

  • Hiring Model: On-site / Hybrid

Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions; owning and operating the world's largest SAR constellation. ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates from five international locations with more than 600 employees from nearly 60 countries, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Our satellites acquire images of Earth at any time – even when it’s cloudy or dark – providing commercial and government partners with unmatched persistent monitoring capabilities. Information derived from our SAR images helps customers make data-driven decisions to address time-critical challenges in various sectors, such as maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance.

Our team is a tight-knit group of experts across many disciplines (e.g., engineering, software development, radar technology, etc.). We’re innovative, driven people who strive for excellence in everything we do. Teamwork, curiosity, and having fun are core values at ICEYE, and contribute to Making the Impossible possible!!

Why should you work for us?

ICEYE is at the cutting edge of new technology and we are continuing to build and operate our commercial constellation of SAR satellites. Working with ICEYE, you will be part of making the impossible possible, whilst shaping the Earth Observation industry. You will work with varied, diverse and engaged colleagues to further the ICEYE mission. At ICEYE we realise that without great people we can not succeed, therefore you will be an integral, valued and appreciated colleague, with the ability to directly shape the vision and direction of the business.

We actively support Continuous Professional Development, and will provide access to a range of avenues to allow you to succeed, including courses, training and attendance at conferences. ICEYE is a place where your development, your growth and your success is a priority.

What will you do in this role?

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for the Engineering Lab and related spaces.

  • Manage lab stock, consumables, and inventory, ensuring availability for development projects.

  • Keep lab documentation current and compliant with health & safety standards.

  • Oversee lab cleanliness, organization, and adherence to ESD protocols.

  • Track schedules and perform preventive maintenance and calibration of instruments.

  • Ensure proper storage and handling of chemicals and equipment.

  • Administer lab access and coordinate training on instrument handling.

  • Support engineering projects by:

    • Building test setups

    • Reworking boards

    • Making cable harnesses for testing

  • B.Sc. degree (or equivalent practical experience).

  • 1+ year of experience in an electronics lab environment.

  • Hands-on skills with electronic and RF lab equipment (oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, RF signal generators, thermal chambers, etc.).

  • Familiarity with mechanical lab tools (3D printer, hand tools, precision measurement tools).

  • Comfortable using Jira and Confluence.

  • Strong communication skills in English (written & spoken).

  • Positive attitude, eagerness to learn, and ability to thrive in a multicultural environment.

In addition to the above, it would be beneficial if you had the below attributes and skills:

  • Experience in an R&D lab.

  • Basic soldering or PCBA rework/repair certifications.

  • Harnessing skills or certification.

  • Awareness of 6S standards for lab organization.

jobs.title: State and Local Strategic Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • State and Local Strategic Account Manager

  • Location: US (Remote)

  • Department: Solutions Sales

  • Reports to: Head of Government Solutions, North America

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Remote

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As a State and Local Strategic Account Manager, you will own relationships with state and local government agencies and sell our full portfolio of natural disaster solutions. You will also be uniquely positioned to bring our flood predictive insights to emergency managers, public safety leaders, and resilience planners who need better information before, during, and after an event.

You will develop and manage your own pipeline, from prospecting and discovery through procurement and close, while serving as a trusted partner to your customers. Your work will directly shape how states and communities anticipate risk, protect residents, and recover faster.

 
 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Sell a solution that helps government organizations better prepare for, respond to, and recover from natural disasters, with a focus on emergency management agencies, public safety, and water resource and floodplain management organizations

  • Run consultative discovery conversations to understand each agency’s operational challenges, such as flood preparedness, response, and recovery, and map them to our solutions, applying outside-the-box thinking to complex sales processes

  • While you will work closely at ICEYE with sales development representatives, solution engineers, and customer success managers, you’ll also need to be able to lead the full sales cycle from first contact through close, including demos, technical discussions, proposals, pricing, and contract negotiation

  • Navigate government procurement, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, grant funding, and budget cycles

  • Translate geospatial and water resources concepts into clear, outcome-focused value for both technical users and executive decision makers

  • Develop key relationships with multiple stakeholders across state and local government, including emergency managers, GIS teams, floodplain managers, procurement officers, and elected or appointed officials

  • Work closely with the Head of North America to develop and execute short and long term sales strategy

  • Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and account plans in the CRM

  • Travel occasionally to meet customers and prospects in person, attend state and regional emergency management events and industry conferences, and conduct on-site demos and workshops, while sharing market feedback with internal teams

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Proven experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to state and local government

  • Demonstrated consultative sales approach, with the ability to diagnose needs and tie solutions to operational outcomes

  • A track record of self-sourcing pipeline, closing your own deals and meeting or exceeding quota, working independently without close supervision

  • Working knowledge of geospatial concepts and technology (e.g., GIS, remote sensing, mapping, or spatial analytics)

  • Water resources background, in either engineering (e.g., hydrology, hydraulics, flood modeling, stormwater) or water resources sales

  • Familiarity with government procurement processes and funding mechanisms

  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to speak credibly to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites, agency meetings, and industry conferences

 

Nice to haves:

  • Direct experience working with or within emergency management, public safety, or disaster response organizations

  • Existing relationships with state and local emergency management agencies or associations

  • Familiarity with FEMA grant programs (e.g., BRIC, HMGP) and how agencies fund resilience and mitigation projects

  • Knowledge of flood risk, floodplain management, or earth observation data (e.g., satellite imagery, SAR)

  • Experience with CRM and sales tools such as Salesforce

 

Application Process

  • TA Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Take Home Task

  • Panel Interview

  • Raise the bar Interview

  • Final Interview with SVP of Solutions

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.


How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.
