WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS:

 

As a State and Local Strategic Account Manager, you will own relationships with state and local government agencies and sell our full portfolio of natural disaster solutions. You will also be uniquely positioned to bring our flood predictive insights to emergency managers, public safety leaders, and resilience planners who need better information before, during, and after an event.

You will develop and manage your own pipeline, from prospecting and discovery through procurement and close, while serving as a trusted partner to your customers. Your work will directly shape how states and communities anticipate risk, protect residents, and recover faster.

 
 


WHO WE ARE


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.



YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

 - Sell a solution that helps government organizations better prepare for, respond to, and recover from natural disasters, with a focus on emergency management agencies, public safety, and water resource and floodplain management organizations

 - Run consultative discovery conversations to understand each agency’s operational challenges, such as flood preparedness, response, and recovery, and map them to our solutions, applying outside-the-box thinking to complex sales processes

 - While you will work closely at ICEYE with sales development representatives, solution engineers, and customer success managers, you’ll also need to be able to lead the full sales cycle from first contact through close, including demos, technical discussions, proposals, pricing, and contract negotiation

 - Navigate government procurement, including RFIs, RFPs, RFQs, grant funding, and budget cycles

 - Translate geospatial and water resources concepts into clear, outcome-focused value for both technical users and executive decision makers

 - Develop key relationships with multiple stakeholders across state and local government, including emergency managers, GIS teams, floodplain managers, procurement officers, and elected or appointed officials

 - Work closely with the Head of North America to develop and execute short and long term sales strategy

 - Maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and account plans in the CRM

 - Travel occasionally to meet customers and prospects in person, attend state and regional emergency management events and industry conferences, and conduct on-site demos and workshops, while sharing market feedback with internal teams

 


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Must haves:

 - Proven experience selling complex, multi-stakeholder solutions to state and local government

 - Demonstrated consultative sales approach, with the ability to diagnose needs and tie solutions to operational outcomes

 - A track record of self-sourcing pipeline, closing your own deals and meeting or exceeding quota, working independently without close supervision

 - Working knowledge of geospatial concepts and technology (e.g., GIS, remote sensing, mapping, or spatial analytics)

 - Water resources background, in either engineering (e.g., hydrology, hydraulics, flood modeling, stormwater) or water resources sales

 - Familiarity with government procurement processes and funding mechanisms

 - Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills, with the ability to speak credibly to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Willingness and ability to travel to customer sites, agency meetings, and industry conferences

 

Nice to haves:

 - Direct experience working with or within emergency management, public safety, or disaster response organizations

 - Existing relationships with state and local emergency management agencies or associations

 - Familiarity with FEMA grant programs (e.g., BRIC, HMGP) and how agencies fund resilience and mitigation projects

 - Knowledge of flood risk, floodplain management, or earth observation data (e.g., satellite imagery, SAR)

 - Experience with CRM and sales tools such as Salesforce

 


APPLICATION PROCESS

 - TA Interview

 - Hiring Manager Interview

 - Take Home Task

 - Panel Interview

 - Raise the bar Interview

 - Final Interview with SVP of Solutions
   
   


WORKING AT ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.





HOW WE WORK (OUR VALUES)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

 - Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

 - See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

 - Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

 - Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

 - Have fun:  What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.
   
   


BENEFITS

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.



 


OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

• Mission Delivery Engineer

  • Department: Missions Line of Business

  • Location: ICEYE Espoo / Warsaw

  • Reports to: Mission Program Director

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Working type: Hybrid (3 days / week in office)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening

 

Why This Role Matters

As a Mission Delivery Engineer you will support the delivery of complex Satellite Mission programs end-to-end with deep technical ownership, ensuring customer success, on-time execution, and scalable delivery excellence.

You will work across the Portfolio focusing on the technical thread of customer missions—from requirements capture through system acceptance and delivery—acting as the technical authority/interface between the customer and ICEYE's engineering, product, and operations teams. Your role bridges program governance and system engineering: ensuring mission requirements are understood, flowed down, tracked, and validated, while maintaining configuration control and driving cross-functional technical alignment throughout the program lifecycle.

This role directly contributes to ICEYE's ambition to become the leading provider of space-based ISR infrastructure by scaling reliable, high-impact mission delivery globally.

The role will be based in Finland or Poland at the ICEYE facility. Travel to customer sites is required.

 

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 

Expected Outcomes & Requirements

Outcomes

• Customer technical requirements are accurately captured, baselined, and flowed down to engineering teams, ensuring all mission commitments are fully traceable from contract to delivery.

• Customers experience a consistent, high-trust technical partnership, with a single accountable interface that understands their systems and operational needs throughout the program lifecycle.

• System integration, verification, and validation activities are planned and executed rigorously, ensuring all delivered capabilities are compliant with mission and contractual requirements.

• Configuration and interface control is maintained across all mission segments—satellite, ground, networks, and user interfaces—minimising risk from upgrades, changes, and inter-system dependencies.

• Technical risks, discrepancies, and gaps are identified early, escalated effectively and resolved proactively through structured coordination across software, hardware, operations, and QA teams.

• Cross-functional technical teams operate in alignment, with clear ownership and system-level perspective maintained across all reviews, delivery milestones, and readiness checks.

• Technical documentation—including CONOPS, ICDs, verification matrices, mission analysis, and acceptance reports—is delivered on time and kept current with the actual system implementation.

Role-Specific Competencies

• 5+ years' experience delivering complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs in advanced technology environments (e.g. space, defence, telecom, automotive, IT)

• Proven ability to own the technical customer interface, managing senior stakeholders and translating operational requirements into engineering deliverables

• Hands-on experience with requirements management, traceability, and configuration control across hardware, software, and system-level domains

• Demonstrated involvement in system integration, verification and validation (V&V) planning and execution, including acceptance testing campaigns

• Strong cross-functional technical coordination skills across engineering, product, and operations disciplines

• Experience of carrying out analysis and mission design using software packages such as STK, SaVoir, MONTE or GMAT

• Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences, including formal reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR, DRR)

• Degree in engineering, systems engineering, computer science, or a related technical field

• Must have or be able to obtain required security clearances

Nice-to-have

• Experience in Earth Observation (EO), SAR, or remote sensing

• Background in space mission systems or satellite ground segment development

• Experience working with government or defence customers on classified or sovereign programs

• Knowledge of hardware/software integration, API control, and embedded systems

• Familiarity with ESA or equivalent program documentation frameworks

• Advanced degree (Master's) or relevant certifications (e.g. PMP, PgMP, INCOSE CSEP)

• Initial screening call with Talent Attraction

• Hiring Manager interview with Mission Program Director

• Case Study & Interview Sales Engineering Director

• Final interview with SVP Missions

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Total Rewards
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Senior Manager, Total Reward

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: People

  • Reports to: VP, People

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters

As Senior Manager, Total Rewards, you'll build the Total Rewards function at ICEYE from the ground up. Today we don't have a mature Total Rewards infrastructure, and we need someone who has done this before and knows how to take an organization from fragmented compensation and benefits practices to a clear, scalable, data-driven framework.

You will own the strategy, design, and implementation of Total Rewards across our global workforce in Finland, Europe, the US, and Asia-Pacific. Reporting to the VP, People, you'll be a strategic partner to executive leadership, People Business Partners, Finance, and business leaders, bringing structure and discipline to how we make reward decisions while keeping the employee experience at the center.

This is a builder role. You'll be comfortable in an environment where the answer isn't yet documented and the process doesn't yet exist, and the expectation is to figure it out, build it, and make it work.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Build the global Total Rewards framework: Define and implement ICEYE's Total Rewards philosophy, principles, governance, and operating model, including decision rights, so rewards are managed consistently across countries and employee populations.

  • Lead and develop the Total Rewards team: Manage, coach, and develop the Rewards Specialist reporting to you, setting clear priorities, building expertise, and fostering a high-performing team. Balance hands-on delivery with effective delegation and capability building as the Total Rewards function evolves and scales.

  • Build compensation infrastructure: Establish global salary benchmarking and market-pricing methodology, salary ranges and structures across relevant geographies, compa-ratio and market-positioning analysis, internal and pay equity analysis, and guidelines for new-hire pay, promotions, lateral moves, and out-of-cycle adjustments.

  • Design and run compensation cycles: Build and lead scalable global merit, promotion, and equity refresh cycles, including budgeting, scenario modelling, manager guidance, and communication, in partnership with People Business Partners, Finance, and leadership.

  • Create job architecture and career structures: Partner with People Operations and People Business Partners to build a practical global job architecture covering job families, career levels, leveling criteria, and role scope, with enough structure for consistency and without unnecessary bureaucracy.

  • Own equity and long-term incentives: Develop and govern ICEYE's global equity approach, including eligibility, grants and refreshes, pool planning, and executive and senior leadership equity, working with Finance, Legal, executive leadership, and the Board/Remuneration Committee while respecting country-specific constraints.

  • Design variable compensation and sales incentives: Work with Commercial, Sales Operations, Finance, and business leaders to build and govern sales incentive plans, commission structures, and bonus frameworks, balancing commercial outcomes with simplicity, transparency, and financial discipline.

  • Build the benefits strategy: Develop a coherent global benefits philosophy with local relevance. In Finland this includes oversight of occupational healthcare, insurance, pension arrangements, flexible benefits, ePassi, bike benefits, and other local programs, plus principles to harmonize benefits across our international locations.

  • Establish pay transparency and pay equity: Build the processes, data, and governance to prepare ICEYE for the EU Pay Transparency Directive, Finnish equal-pay requirements, and other relevant regulations, turning requirements into practical processes rather than only managing compliance.

  • Advise executives and the Board: Act as a trusted Total Rewards advisor to the VP People, executive leadership, and the Board/Remuneration Committee, with clear, data-driven recommendations on executive compensation, market positioning, equity allocation, incentives, budgets, and reward strategy.

What we're looking for

Must haves

  • You have built this before: you have personally built or materially transformed a Total Rewards function, taking an environment with incomplete or inconsistent processes, data, structures, and governance and making it scalable

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in HR/People, with significant specialization in Total Rewards

  • 3+ years in a senior Total Rewards leadership or ownership role

  • Experience in a fast-growing, international technology, aerospace, engineering, deep-tech, or similarly complex organization, including through significant growth and organizational change

  • Experience designing and operating compensation and benefits programs across multiple countries, particularly Europe and the US, with an understanding of how global frameworks differ from local market requirements

  • Strong understanding of Finnish employment, benefits, taxation, and compensation practices

  • Deep technical Total Rewards expertise: market benchmarking and survey data, salary structures and ranges, job architecture and leveling, compa-ratio and market positioning, pay equity analysis, equity and LTI, annual compensation cycles, variable compensation and sales incentives, benefits strategy, compensation modelling and analytics, and pay transparency

  • Builder mentality: comfortable starting with ambiguity and without an existing playbook, mature HRIS configuration, or perfectly clean data; able to set a practical roadmap and be pragmatic about where structure is needed

  • Executive presence and commercial acumen: able to translate complex reward topics into clear business decisions, challenge assumptions, model scenarios, and make recommendations to senior leadership and the Board

  • A human-centric approach: you think about how reward decisions are experienced by employees and managers, and you build clarity and trust rather than more process

  • Professional fluency in English

Nice to haves

  • Finnish language skills

  • Familiarity with Finnish collective agreements/TES environments

  • Experience with leading market data providers such as Radford, Mercer, WTW, or similar

  • Experience navigating international equity and compensation considerations

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the "why" behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us, and we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

  • Espoo, Finland

  • Reports to Manufacturing & QA Team Lead

  • Permanent

  • Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

The Mission of the Manufacturing Engineer

Your main focus will be to ensure that electronics prototypes are built correctly, efficiently, and on schedule, enabling ICEYE’s engineering teams to iterate quickly and with confidence.

This role acts as the bridge between design and manufacturing, translating engineering intent into manufacturable hardware by owning prototype execution, resolving issues early, and maintaining close technical collaboration with suppliers.

By enforcing high-quality documentation, proactively managing risks, and continuously improving prototype and NPI processes, the Manufacturing Engineer directly contributes to faster development cycles, higher build quality, and smoother transitions from prototype to production.

Who We Are


ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.


Expected Outcomes & Requirements

Outcomes:

  • Own the end-to-end execution of electronics prototype builds (PCB and PCBA), from design release to delivery.

  • Act as the primary technical interface to PCB/PCBA suppliers, resolving manufacturing, quality, and documentation issues.

  • Review and validate manufacturing documentation (BOMs, assembly data, drawings) to ensure completeness and manufacturability.

  • Track prototype orders, schedules, and priorities, ensuring on-time delivery across multiple concurrent builds.

  • Support material readiness and component management, including availability, alternates, and issue resolution.

  • Verify incoming prototypes and coordinate rework, fixes, or rebuilds when required.

  • Collaborate with R&D, ECAD, and Supply Chain to improve prototype and NPI processes.

  • Contribute to long-term initiatives such as supplier onboarding, process standardization, and in-house prototyping capability.


What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or similar.

  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in electronics manufacturing or design.

  • Solid practical knowledge of Altium Designer and Altium 365.

  • Understanding of PCB and PCBA manufacturing processes, DFM, and quality workflows.

  • Good understanding of general electronics design principles, ability to interpret schematics and fabrication/assembly data.

  • Familiarity with IPC, IEEE, JEDEC standards.

  • Experience working with external suppliers and EMS partners

  • Good organizational and documentation skills, attention to detail, and structured work style.

  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills in a cross-functional engineering environment.

  • Ability to organize workload, set priorities, and oversee both internal and outsourced ECAD library activities.

  • Strong problem-solving mindset and hands-on attitude.

  • Fluent written and spoken English.

Key Competences

In addition to the requirements above, we evaluate candidates on these key qualities throughout the hiring process:

  • Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.

  • Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.

  • Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Application Process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical Assignment

  • Stakeholder Interview

  • Director Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you will join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. We know that we will succeed only through exceptional people in our team, which is why your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority.
As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. You will benefit from continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and integrity. ICEYE is a place where your contributions have a visible impact, and where we celebrate success together.

Benefits (Finland)

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment

  • Occupational healthcare, occupational, and accident insurance

  • A yearly benefit budget to spend as you wish (sport, transport, bike benefit, wellness, lunch, etc.)

  • Phone subscription with iPhone of choice

  • Relocation support (flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support)

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes

  • Inspiring and collaborating offices and silent workspaces enable you to focus

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.title: Electronics Verification Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Manager, Logistics Management

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site (Cleanroom)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As an Electronics Verification Technician, you are a critical part of the highly international manufacturing team specifically responsible for ensuring every PCBA functions flawlessly before assembly. Reporting to the Electronics Verification Team Lead, embedded within the Logistics and QC Department, you will work in a clean area with ESD sensitive devices and classified information, operating test stations, high precision equipment, verifying electronic board assemblies, performing visual inspections, troubleshooting failed tests and providing immediate feedback to prevent defects from moving down the assembly line.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1,000 employees across Poland, Spain, Germany, the UK, Australia, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US.

Read more about our latest financial results and growth.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Conduct visual inspections, electrical verifications, and basic mechanical tests as well as quality checks during incoming operations of electronic parts, mechanical parts, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) items, and subsystems to ensure compliance with specifications;

  • Update material status in the ERP and MES system, Record inspection results and maintain accurate, audit-ready, documentation;

  • Report non-conformances, support root cause analysis activities, contribute to the implementation of corrective and preventive actions across production and the supply chain, communicate persistent assembly errors to the production lead;

  • Perform real-time visual and mechanical inspection of SMT and Through-Hole assemblies to IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 standards.

  • Flash firmware and bootloaders onto microcontrollers, troubleshoot test failures in real-time, identifying whether the issue is a component failure, soldering defect, or test fixture error.

  • Occasionally perform minor rework on non-conforming boards to keep production flowing.

  • Ensure inspection tools and equipment are properly calibrated and maintained;

  • Monitor inspection, logistics, production, storage, and laboratory environments to ensure compliance with safety and quality standards to support consistent manufacturing operations.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Strong background in Electronics, Mechatronics, Testing, or related fields, with computer literacy in Jira, Confluence, MES Systems, Linux, and with programming knowledge in Python, CSV, Bash, etc.

  • Direct hands-on experience in the use of complex electronic measurement tools, oscilloscopes, multimeters, bench power supplies, VNA, test jigs, etc.

  • Conversational level of spoken and written English.

  • Degree, diploma or applicable certifications: Master of Science in Engineering (MSc) recently graduated, Engineer, Advanced university student, Bachelor with a minimum of 2 years of experience in similar environments, or 5 years of proven enthusiastic experience, IPC-A-600, IPC-A-610, J-STD-001, ESA/ECSS.

  • Experience with basic hand-soldering rework tools.

  • Ability to coach peers constructively on the production floor.

Nice to haves:

  • Knowledge of industrial practices, non-conformance reporting, root cause analysis, calibration requirements, ESD, manufacturing workflows, .

  • Strong ability to read PCB assembly drawings, Bill of Materials (BOMs), schematics and trace circuits to find shorts or open connections and defect recognition (polarity, bridging, cold joints, missing components).

  • Experience in mechanical inspection of individual parts and assemblies.

  • Exposure to Assembly, Integration and Tests environments of Satellite Hardware.

Application Process

  • Recruiter call

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Technical task

  • Team interview

  • Final interview

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the why behind decisions.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: AIT Engineering Team Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As an AIT Mechanical Test Engineer, you own mechanical and environmental test readiness for ICEYE's satellite platform: vibration, shock, mass properties, and fastened or mechanism interfaces. You will personally set up, run, and troubleshoot vibration test campaigns end-to-end, working in close partnership with structural and mechanical designers to ensure every subsystem can be built and verified reliably as ICEYE scales GEN4 satellite production toward a weekly build cadence.

Who We Are
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own mechanical and environmental test readiness for vibration testing (random vibration, sine burst/sweep, sine-on-random/random-on-random, resonance search and dwell), shock, mass properties/CG verification, and fastener torque and thread-locking integrity testing

  • Personally set up, operate, and troubleshoot the vibration test system (electrodynamic shaker, slip table, head expander) and its control software, including electronic, hydraulic, and pneumatic sub-systems

  • Design or evaluate test fixtures, considering structural dynamics principles and force/overturning moment budgets, and coordinate fixture fabrication

  • Author test procedures and reports that are technically correct, version-controlled, and executable on the floor without interpretation

  • Act as the mechanical test point of contact for engineering and production when structural behaviour during test is unclear, unexpected, or blocking

  • Work in a "2-in-a-box" partnership with structures and mechanical designers to derive and verify test levels and assess testability of design changes

  • Own Tier-2 technical support for mechanical test non-conformances and anomalies -- triage, root cause, corrective action, and closure

  • Analyse test data and communicate results and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, while mentoring AIT technicians on mechanical test execution

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a closely related discipline

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in vibration, shock, or environmental test engineering in a hardware-intensive environment (aerospace, defence, automotive, or similar)

  • Direct, hands-on experience operating electrodynamic shaker systems and vibration test control software across sine, random, shock, and sine burst/sweep testing

  • Solid understanding of structural dynamics and environmental test methods, with working knowledge of relevant standards (RPUG, MIL-STD-1540/810, NASA GEVS, or ECSS)

  • Experience designing or evaluating test fixtures and deriving test levels from mass properties and force/OTM budgets

  • Ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, ICDs, and test specifications, translating them into executable test procedures

  • Excellent English communication skills, written and verbal, across engineering and production audiences

Nice to haves:

  • Hands-on experience with Vibration Research software (VibrationVIEW / ObserVIEW)

  • Experience in spacecraft, aerospace, defence, or other high-reliability mechanical test environments

  • Familiarity with satellite structural qualification or acceptance test campaigns

  • Exposure to HALT/HASS or other accelerated environmental test methods

  • Experience supporting new test equipment acquisition, FAT/SAT, and commissioning

  • Proficiency with Jira or equivalent engineering tracking and NC management systems

ROLE HIGHLIGHTS:

- Role: Power Electronics Engineer

- Department: HAPS

- Location: Valencia, Spain

- Reports to: HAPS Avionics Team Lead

- Working type: Hybrid

- Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

THE MISSION OF THE POWER ELECTRONICS ENGINEER

As Power Electronics Engineer on the HAPS program, you will contribute to the design of the power subsystem of ICEYE's stratospheric electric aircraft.

The role is hardware focused, spanning circuit design, lab bring-up, and test. The engineer will own defined subsystems end to end, from requirements definition through schematic design, hardware bring-up, verification testing, and documentation for readiness review.

WHO ARE WE?

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

DAY TO DAY RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Battery testing and characterization: cell and pack level testing, including capacity, impedance, and cycling measurements, and support for safety qualification testing (e.g. short circuit and thermal runaway testing)

- Solar array integration: defining and validating the electrical interface between the solar array and the power bus, including protection circuitry and bring-up testing

- Power electronics design: designing and validating protection and power conversion circuits, including the bus tie unit (an electronically controlled high current protection device with current sensing and MCU level telemetry and control) and DC-DC converters

- System verification: board level bring-up and system integration testing to confirm the power subsystem performs to specification under nominal and fault conditions

- Documentation: producing and maintaining design documentation, test reports, and requirement compliance records

REQUIREMENTS:

MUST HAVE SKILLS

- Demonstrated experience in power electronics design for battery powered and/or solar powered systems, including familiarity with DC-DC converter topologies

- Practical experience with hardware bring-up, debugging, and verification testing of power electronics using standard laboratory equipment (oscilloscopes, electronic loads, power supplies, battery cyclers)

- Experience with lithium-ion battery systems, including characterization, safety limits, and thermal behavior

- Technical grounding in solar/photovoltaic array integration, including electrical interfacing of a variable voltage source to a power bus

- Proficiency with schematic capture and PCB design tools, preferably Altium Designer

- Experience with embedded systems as applied to power electronics, including telemetry acquisition and control interfaces between power hardware and a microcontroller

- Strong technical writing ability, with experience producing design documentation, test reports, and requirement traceability records

- Ability to work independently against defined requirements while coordinating effectively within a small technical team

NICE TO HAVE SKILLS

- Experience with aerospace or other high reliability electronics programs

- Familiarity with component derating methodologies and EMI/EMC design practice

- Familiarity with embedded communication protocols relevant to power system telemetry and control (e.g. CAN, I2C)

- Experience with power delivery network (PDN) analysis, including reflection/impedance testing to validate transient response and stability under load

APPLICATION PROCESS

- Talent Acquisition Interview

- Hiring Manager Interview

- Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge

- Hiring Team Interview

- Offer Decision

Role Highlights:

  • Title: Stock & Logistics Manager

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics

  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

About the role

As a Stock Manager, you lead the flow of materials, components, and finished goods across ICEYE's manufacturing operations, ensuring the right parts are available at the right time to support production. You will own inventory management, warehousing, and inbound/outbound logistics across multiple sites, working closely with Procurement, Production Planning, Manufacturing, and Quality to keep materials moving efficiently through a fast-paced, rapidly scaling supply chain.

This is a hands-on leadership role: you will develop the warehouse and logistics team, manage relationships with freight providers and logistics partners, and drive continuous improvement to build the systems and processes that support ICEYE's growth.

  • Experience of managing a team, with clear background of developing and scaling

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights:

  • Title: Production Team Lead

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics

  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

ICEYE is seeking a Production Team Lead to lead the day-to-day execution of Manufacturing, Assembly, Integration and Testing activities, including spacecraft assembly and the integration of optical payloads.

This is an operational leadership role in an early-stage production environment, where production processes, teams, and operating routines are being established and scaled.

You will be responsible for translating production plans and engineering requirements into safe, high-quality, efficient, and predictable MAIT execution. This includes managing daily priorities, resources, production flow, readiness, schedule adherence, quality, productivity, and escalation of issues.

You will establish and maintain a structured production management system based on clear priorities, visual management, daily performance reviews, standard work, and continuous improvement, with a strong focus on safety, quality, delivery, and operational efficiency.

The role requires a strong presence on the production floor and in cleanroom environments, working closely with AIT Engineering, Quality, Planning, Logistics, Manufacturing Engineering, and other stakeholders to ensure successful spacecraft builds and payload integration.

You will play a key role in developing the production organization, establishing operational discipline, and building the capabilities required to scale satellite production.

This is a talent pool posting.

We are building our Lisbon manufacturing organisation ahead of site ramp-up. We expect this role to open formally in Q4 2026. Applying now registers your interest early and puts you at the front of the process when the req goes live.

What you will do

  • Lead the day-to-day execution of Manufacturing, Assembly, Integration and Testing (MAIT) activities, including spacecraft assembly and optical payload integration.

  • Lead and develop the production team, setting clear priorities, responsibilities, and performance expectations.

  • Manage daily production execution, including capacity, resources, production flow, schedule, and readiness.

  • Establish effective daily management routines, visual management, and performance tracking to drive safe, high-quality, and efficient execution.

  • Drive production ramp-up, readiness, and continuous improvement across processes, workstations, and production flow.

  • Apply Lean manufacturing principles to improve productivity, quality, flow, and repeatability, including 5S, Kaizen, standard work, and visual management.

  • Identify and resolve production issues through structured problem-solving and root cause analysis, working closely with Engineering and Quality.

  • Ensure production processes, work instructions, tooling, equipment, and resources are ready and properly implemented before execution.

  • Work closely with AIT Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, and Logistics to ensure successful spacecraft builds and payload integration.

  • Drive a strong culture of safety, quality, ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement on the production floor.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in manufacturing, production, assembly, integration, or testing of complex hardware.

  • Proven experience leading production or manufacturing teams, including people management.

  • Experience in aerospace, space, aircraft, defense, or other high-reliability manufacturing environments.

  • Experience supporting production ramp-up, new factory setup, or new production line introduction.

  • Experience with Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement methodologies, including tools such as 5S, Kaizen, standard work, or visual management.

  • Experience with capacity planning, takt time, line balancing, or production flow optimization.

  • Experience working with MES, ERP, test data management, or similar production systems.

  • Experience working with complex hardware in cleanroom or controlled manufacturing environments.

  • Strong problem-solving skills, including structured root cause analysis and corrective actions.

  • Understanding of production flow and push/pull production systems.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong written and spoken English.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with satellite assembly, integration, and testing.

  • Experience with optical payload integration or other high-precision hardware.

  • Experience with Value Stream Mapping (VSM) or other advanced Lean tools.

  • Experience with NPI, industrialization, or product ramp-up.

  • Experience working closely with Engineering teams during new product introduction or production industrialization.

  • Experience with manufacturing quality tools such as PFMEA, control plans, or process capability.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition interview

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Technical interview, including a technical challenge

  • Hiring team + director-level interview

  • Offer

Role Highlights:

  • Title: AIT Engineering Team Lead

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE, Optics

  • Location: Lisbon, Portugal

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

ICEYE is seeking a Team Lead, AIT Engineering to lead the AIT Engineering function responsible for the assembly, integration, and testing of satellite systems and optical payloads.

This is a technical leadership and people management role in an early-stage production environment, where products, processes, and manufacturing capabilities are continuously evolving. You will lead and develop the AIT Engineering team while acting as the technical focal point for AIT activities during spacecraft builds and integration campaigns.

The role sits at the interface between Engineering and Production. You will work closely with optical, mechanical, electrical, systems, quality, and production teams to translate design intent into robust, manufacturable, integrable, and testable processes, while ensuring that feedback and issues identified during production are effectively driven back into Engineering.

You will also support the integration and validation of externally supplied optical payloads, working with internal engineering teams and external suppliers to ensure successful integration into the satellite platform.

The role requires a strong background in spacecraft AIT, system integration, or complex hardware integration, combined with the ability to lead people, coordinate technical activities, develop robust processes, and drive execution in a fast-paced production environment.

What you will do

  • Lead and develop the AIT Engineering team, providing technical direction, mentoring, and clear priorities.

  • Support the integration and validation of externally supplied optical payloads into the spacecraft platform.

  • Combine technical leadership with hands-on involvement in spacecraft integration, testing, troubleshooting, and verification.

  • Ensure AIT readiness before builds, including tools, GSE, procedures, documentation, hardware, and engineering support.

  • Drive structured problem-solving and root cause analysis of integration and test issues, ensuring lessons learned are fed back into Engineering and production.

  • Act as the bridge between Production and Engineering, translating design requirements into practical, manufacturable, and testable integration processes.

  • Work closely with Systems, Mechanical, Electrical, Optical, Quality, Manufacturing, and external suppliers to resolve integration challenges.

  • Define and continuously improve AIT processes, procedures, test methods, tooling, fixtures, and technical documentation.

  • Support production ramp-up by improving integration efficiency, repeatability, reliability, and scalability.

  • Mentor engineers and build strong technical capabilities within the AIT organization.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in spacecraft AIT, system integration, testing, or production of complex hardware systems.

  • Strong experience with spacecraft integration and system-level testing across multiple engineering disciplines.

  • Experience with optical systems, optomechanics, optical payloads, or Earth Observation systems.

  • Experience working with complex precision hardware in cleanroom or controlled environments.

  • Strong system-level understanding across mechanical, electrical, optical, and systems engineering.

  • Experience with DFM / DFT principles and translating design requirements into manufacturable and testable solutions.

  • Experience with AIT processes, test procedures, verification, and technical documentation.

  • Experience with GSE, tooling, fixtures, or test setups used for integration and testing.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, including structured root cause analysis and corrective actions.

  • Experience working with MES, ERP, test data management, or similar production systems.

  • Experience with Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Strong understanding of configuration-controlled production and engineering environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Strong written and spoken English.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience with optical alignment and metrology, including focus, tilt, centering, boresight, interferometry, collimators, or MTF.

  • Experience supporting environmental testing, such as thermal vacuum, vibration, or EMC.

  • Experience working with external suppliers or partners, particularly payload suppliers.

  • Experience supporting products from prototype through production ramp-up.

  • Experience with PDR, CDR, PRR, or equivalent technical and production readiness reviews.

  • Experience with PFMEA, process capability, or other manufacturing engineering tools.

  • Experience in Lean manufacturing, industrialization, or production scale-up.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition interview

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Technical interview, including a technical challenge

  • Hiring team + director-level interview

  • Offer

Role highlights:

  • Senior Electronics Engineer

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Engineering

  • Reports to: Engineering Lead, AOCS Hardware

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office

Why this role matters:

You design and own the embedded electronics that give ICEYE’s spacecraft the ability to sense their environment, make decisions, and act, safely and reliably, in orbit. Working closely with firmware and systems engineers, you take hardware from first schematics through bring-up, verification, and on-orbit support, always looking for ways to make the next design more robust than the last.

Your job will be to work closely with production teams, operations teams, and software teams to ensure smooth and performant operation of our Attitude and Orbit Control Systems in development and deployed environments. Expect to be involved in the complete lifecycle of the system - from design phases of next-generation architectures to maintenance and optimization of existing systems we and our customers operate.

We move fast. At ICEYE, you are expected to understand the whole system - not just your slice of it - and to iterate quickly. Designs you work on today can be launched to orbit within months, not years. This is an environment where your decisions carry real weight and your work becomes tangible faster than almost anywhere else in the industry.

You will have a direct impact on mission success as the performance and reliability of our AOCS electronics directly affect the operational capabilities we deliver to our customers and the overall performance of our fleet.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Design and develop embedded electronics hardware (schematic and layout) for mission-critical onboard systems, using Altium Designer and/or Mentor Graphics PADS.

  • Design digital control and interface circuitry around microcontrollers and/or FPGAs, including sensor and actuator interfaces, protection circuits, and fault handling.

  • Own the complete lifecycle of the hardware you create, from development and testing through handover to the missions team, and troubleshooting of in-orbit issues.

  • Work closely with firmware, mechanical engineers, and systems engineers to define hardware interfaces and develop joint verification test cases.

  • Take ownership of your electronics, including verification testing and writing documentation.

  • Support on-orbit troubleshooting for hardware you have developed, as needed

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another relevant discipline.

  • 5+ years developing electronics (schematic and layout) using Altium Designer and/or Mentor Graphics PADS.

  • Strong experience in digital and embedded control electronics, including microcontroller/FPGA interfacing (ADC, PWM, GPIO), sensor and actuator interfaces, and protection circuitry (overcurrent/overvoltage detection, fault handling, safe-state transitions).

  • Experience designing serial communication hardware (e.g. I2C, SPI, UART, RS485, CAN), including proper isolation and protection.

  • Working knowledge of high-speed and low-speed parallel interfaces relevant to embedded systems (e.g. JTAG, Ethernet, DDR/SRAM, Spacewire), as needed for the platforms you support.

  • Ability to work closely with firmware engineers to define hardware interfaces and develop joint verification test cases.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience designing and testing high-reliability, safety-critical, and fault-tolerant systems.

  • Experience with power electronics design supporting embedded control systems.

  • Hardware debug experience, including familiarity with tools such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers (SPI, CAN, Ethernet, or similar), and spectrum analyzers.

  • Programming skills, including C/C++, Python, and MATLAB, for firmware integration or hardware characterization.

  • Experience with revision control tools such as Git or SVN; comfortable working in Linux.

  • Familiarity with high-speed SERDES interfaces (e.g. JESD204a/b/c) is a plus for engineers supporting higher-bandwidth payload electronics.

  • Creative approach to problem solving, and ability to work effectively in a dynamic, fast-changing environment.

Application Process

  • Technical Interview

  • (on-site) Technical Interview based on a task

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights

  • Title: Mechanical AIT Engineer

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Location: Athens, Greece

  • Reporting to: AIT Engineering Team Leader

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site (Occasional travel for environmental test and suppliers facility)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

  • Please note we can only accept applications in English

Why this role matters:

The Mechanical AIT Engineer transforms satellite designs into reliable, flight-ready hardware. You are the technical authority for mechanical and composite hardware in Athens: how satellites are assembled and aligned, what proves they will survive launch, and what evidence exists that every build was done correctly.

You define the AIT processes, tooling and ground support equipment the facilities need as they grow from subassembly production towards full satellite integration. You make sure the design, the processes and the tooling can carry production to high throughput, and you feed what you learn on the floor back into design, so that each build is more manufacturable, more testable and more reliable than the last.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Why should you work for us?

ICEYE is at the cutting edge of new technology and we are continuing to build and operate our commercial constellation of SAR satellites. Working with ICEYE, you will be part of making the impossible possible, whilst shaping the Earth Observation industry. You will work with varied, diverse and engaged colleagues to further the ICEYE mission. At ICEYE we realise that without great people we can not succeed, therefore you will be an integral, valued and appreciated colleague, with the ability to directly shape the vision and direction of the business.

We actively support Continuous Professional Development, and will provide access to a range of avenues to allow you to succeed, including courses, training and attendance at conferences. ICEYE is a place where your development, your growth and your success is a priority.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

AIT process definition and industrialisation

  • Define the MAITE processes for building sub-assemblies and satellites: integration flows, standard sequences, work packages and test strategy.

  • Qualify the critical assembly, integration and test processes, using PFMEA and control plans, and define the acceptance criteria and standardised procedures that go with them.

  • Specify the tooling, equipment and workstations each process needs, anticipating them ahead of programme milestones, and lead the transfer from prototype to series so that processes and tooling can carry production to high throughput.

Design maturity and co-engineering

  • Work with Engineering from the concept phase so that design and production constraints are aligned, applying design for manufacturing, assembly and testability (DFM, DFA, DFT) and bringing buildability, tolerance stack-up, tool access and test provisions into internal design iterations before the design is frozen.

  • Support internal and supplier design and readiness reviews (e.g. PDR, CDR, PRR, IRR, TRR), ensuring designs are mature and ready for transition into production, and identify industrial risks early with the action plans that close them.

Assembly and integration

  • Lead and execute structural, mechanical and thermal assembly and integration of satellites and sub-assemblies, acting as the technical point of contact for mechanical subsystem integration.

  • Own the mechanical build standard: torque and preload, locking methods, bonding, composite handling, cleanliness and ESD discipline.

  • Verify components before integration, perform precision alignment and dimensional verification of critical interfaces, and support the floor hands-on during assembly, harness routing and test setup.

Verification and environmental test

  • Plan, prepare and lead environmental test campaigns, including vibration, shock, thermal vacuum, acoustic and EMC, and guide system-level functional verification.

  • Design or evaluate test fixtures, derive test levels, and act as the technical point of contact towards internal and external test facilities.

  • Own mass properties: mass budget, centre of gravity, moment of inertia and launch vehicle interface data.


Ground support equipment

  • Specify, design, procure and validate Mechanical Ground Support Equipment for handling, transport, integration and test, from concept and CAD through structural analysis to fabrication oversight.

  • Verify structural margins, define proof load testing and recertification intervals, and certify equipment before use on flight hardware.

Supplier parts and materials

  • Act as the technical authority for mechanical and composite parts from suppliers, covering capability assessment, special process review and First Article Inspection.

  • Act as the technical reference for composite hardware (CFRP panels, honeycomb assemblies, bonded joints, potted inserts), defining handling, machining, acceptance and inspection criteria, including non-destructive inspection where needed.

Configuration, documentation and anomalies

  • Maintain as-built configuration and traceability, and apply engineering changes consistently to hardware and documentation.

  • Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues, and support root cause analysis and corrective actions, coordinating with the Engineering team, the production team and any other team needed to ensure schedule and quality adherence.

Facilities and process requirements

  • Define the AIT process requirements for the facilities and work with the Global Manufacturing Infrastructure team on the layout that supports them.

  • Define the contamination control, ESD and handling requirements that integration and test activities must meet, and propose improvements where the process or the environment falls short.

Standardization and continuous improvement

  • Capture lessons learned from the floor to improve procedures, tooling, test efficiency and build reliability as production volumes increase, and align with the Global AIT and Engineering teams on product standards and process updates.

  • Mentor and support local engineers and technicians, sharing AIT best practices and fostering a culture of quality and accountability.

What we're looking for

Must have

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in the development, integration, testing or production of complex hardware systems (e.g. aerospace, defense, automotive, semiconductors, satellites), including work on flight or equivalently critical hardware.

  • Demonstrated experience defining and qualifying assembly, integration and test processes, turning them into standardised work packages, and taking a product from first units towards series production.

  • Deep technical knowledge in mechanical engineering, with system-level understanding across full product architectures and the ability to spot issues across the interfaces between design, production and operations.

  • Demonstrated ownership of environmental test campaigns, from specification through execution to reporting.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

You will work with varied, diverse and engaged colleagues to further the ICEYE mission. At ICEYE we realise that without great people we can not succeed, therefore you will be an integral, valued and appreciated colleague, with the ability to directly shape the vision and direction of the business.



We actively support Continuous Professional Development, and will provide access to a range of avenues to allow you to succeed, including courses, training and attendance at conferences. ICEYE is a place where your development, your growth and your success is a priority.

 - Specify the tooling, equipment and workstations each process needs, anticipating them ahead of programme milestones, and lead the transfer from prototype to series so that processes and tooling can carry production to high throughput.

 - Work with Engineering from the concept phase so that design and production constraints are aligned, applying design for manufacturing, assembly and testability (DFM, DFA, DFT) and bringing buildability, tolerance stack-up, tool access and test provisions into internal design iterations before the design is frozen.

Role Highlights

  • Location: Athens, Greece

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: Director of MAITE

Why this role matters:

The mission of this role is to be the single planning point for the whole MAITE (Manufacturing, Assembly, Integration, Test and Execution) organisation in Greece: AIT Engineering, Production, Stock & Logistics, Procurement, Quality, and the Cleanroom & Lab. You will build and own one integrated schedule, from the master schedule down to daily work orders, that turns satellite demand into executable work across all of them.

You will work with the global planning team, which sets the master plan and component MRP, and turn it into a detailed, executable plan for the site. Unlike traditional satellite builds, LEO constellations demand industrial-scale throughput, modular design adaptability, and tight integration between production, engineering and supply chain.

Much of the value sits in the interfaces: sequencing a calibration campaign or a cleanroom intervention so it does not stop a build, holding a slot for a quality inspection, or flagging a long-lead component early enough for procurement to act.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity, works comfortably across departments, and improves the planning tools and workflows they inherit where off-the-shelf solutions fall short. You are the reliable source of truth for the site plan: when the plan and the floor disagree, you know first and say so.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil-spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 1000 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Build, maintain and optimise a single integrated schedule covering AIT Engineering, Production, Stock & Logistics, Procurement, Quality and the Cleanroom & Lab, from the master schedule down to daily work orders, against technical constraints, material availability, labour and facility capacity.

  • Translate the master plan and component MRP from the global planning team into a sequenced plan for each department, agreeing dates and capacity with the department owners rather than directing their work. Hold slots for cleanroom interventions, calibration campaigns, quality inspections and rework loops so that planned work lands where it costs least, and keep those slots when priorities move.

  • Run the daily and weekly planning cadence. Coordinate daily schedules with the site team leads, report actual people availability into the capacity plan, publish status, and raise deviations early and factually rather than sitting on them, then drive them to a decision.

  • Feed the planning cycle. Keep plan versus actuals, milestone status and people availability current and flowing to the global planning team on cadence, so the plan above the site reflects floor reality.

  • Produce and maintain the artefacts the organisation runs on: master schedule, critical path analysis, capacity plans, sprints and the visual management boards used in daily meetings.

  • Integrate new product introduction and engineering changes into the plan, including prototype and qualification builds, without disrupting series production. Keep the plan and work order BOMs aligned with the current approved configuration, coordinating with Configuration Management, who own the governed baseline.

  • Schedule planned downtime deliberately, including preventive maintenance, instrument calibration campaigns and cleanroom interventions, so that they land where they cost least.

  • Embed quality hold points, inspection windows and rework loops into the schedule rather than absorbing them as overruns, and flag long-lead and shortage risk to Procurement early enough to act.

  • Keep planning data in NetSuite, Manufacturo (MES), Jira and Smartsheet in sync with the floor: work orders released and closed on time, no phantom work in progress, no conflicting references, and material, WIP and stock status accurate enough to plan from.

  • Publish and track the organisation-level planning indicators: on-time delivery, schedule adherence and cycle time. Consolidate and report the department-level measures that explain them, including material availability at kit release, inspection turnaround, equipment availability and calibration compliance. These measures remain owned by the department that produces them. Where one moves against the plan, raise it in the planning cadence with its owner and drive it to a decision.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in production, industrial or operations planning in a technological environment (aerospace, defense, maritime, automotive, semiconductor, medical devices, etc.).

  • Proven scheduling capability across multiple departments or product lines, building and owning a master schedule fully.

  • Capacity planning across labour, equipment and facilities, with the judgement to state clearly what cannot be done as well as what can.

  • Deep understanding of manufacturing processes, supply chain logistics and systems engineering, sufficient to challenge a lead time or a routing.

  • Comfortable reading technical documentation: bills of materials, routings, work instructions and engineering change notices.

  • Inventory management experience: tracking materials, work in progress and stock accuracy against plan.

  • Ability to hold competing departmental priorities in balance and reach a decision without formal authority over the teams involved: influence and reliability over authority, and the instinct to raise a problem early rather than sit on it.

  • Analytical thinking with a data-driven approach to forecasting, problem-solving and decision-making, using Excel, Power BI or similar.

  • Adaptability to respond quickly to production changes, delays, or evolving technical requirements.

  • Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP/MES systems and scheduling tools, including responsibility for planning master data accuracy. We use NetSuite, Manufacturo (MES), Jira and Smartsheet, which are being implemented while in use; experience with equivalent systems is fine.

  • Experience producing visual management for daily operational meetings, and with project tooling such as Jira, Smartsheet or MS Project.

  • Strong communication skills in English (written & spoken).

Nice to haves:

  • A satellite, aerospace, or another regulated, low-volume / high-complexity manufacturing setting.

  • Foundational software development skills, such as Python or scripting, useful for automating planning tasks, integrating data sources, or building internal planning tools.

  • Exposure to Lean or continuous improvement, S&OP cycles, or APICS/ASCM certification.

Application Process

  • Hiring Manager General Interview

  • Technical Interview (onsite or virtual), including a Technical Challenge

  • Leadership & Hiring Team Interview
