Role highlights:

  • Job Title: Security Officer

  • Department: ICEYE Security Spain

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Reports to: CEO, ICEYE Spain

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Working type: On-Site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening and clearances

Why this role matters:

 

In this position you will build and own the classified information security posture that lets ICEYE Spain operate within the required classification, coordinating the efforts to achieve and maintain “Reservado Nacional” security clearance, and its NATO and EU equivalents.

You are the person who will build the defensible, audit-ready security framework for ICEYE Spain. You will design it, run it, and represent it to the appropriate authority. You are also the trusted advisor that will support the Spain CEO as the first point of contact for Security matters.

This is a role for a builder; someone that is confident in defining, maintaining and communicating the security framework that enables ICEYE’s continued growth and meeting our obligations to our customers.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap. Define and execute the twelve-month plan to take ICEYE Spain from current state to fully cleared operations at the required national classification levels — including facility security clearance, personnel clearances, IT accreditation, and the operational processes that sit underneath.

  • Be the appointed security officer. Act as the company's official security officer, representing ICEYE with relevant national authorities. Lead all interactions with the national industrial security / accreditation body and represent ICEYE Spain in front of regulators with credibility and precision.

  • Build the framework. Partner with the Global Security team to implement policies, SOPs, secure areas, accreditation pathways toward higher classifications and the audit trail that evidences this.

  • Run the clearance pipeline. Be the person coordinating Personnel Security Clearances across the local organisation in close coordination with Global Security to ensure the business is ahead

  • Enable the business. Translate security requirements and support appropriate handling of classified information for ICEYE Spain

What success looks like

  • Ensure ICEYE Spain holds and maintains a valid Facility Security Clearance and operates accredited environments at the required national level

  • ICEYE’s local team holds required personnel clearances to participate in our priority programmes.

  • ICEYE Spain are able to participate in classified procurements and requirements are clearly known and communicated to internal stakeholders

  • ICEYE Spain team are trained in all appropriate security processes required

  • You will have built the Audit-ready documentation, local procedures and SOPs, with rehearsed incident-response and Crisis handling measures in place

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 10+ years experience of working with a variety of security challenges and demands, from IT, to physical security elements.

  • Real world hands on experience is essential

  • Deep, hands-on knowledge of the national classified information regime: the governing legislation, regulations, and industrial security manual/handbook, and the practical workings of national security oversight for ICEYE Spain

  • Track record as a security officer (or directly equivalent) inside a defence, intelligence, aerospace, or critical-infrastructure organisation in Spain. Consulting experience is preferred.

  • Experience of scaling its classification level is necessary.

  • Working fluency in NATO and EU classification frameworks (e.g. NATO SECRET, EU SECRET) and how they interlock with national classification levels.

  • Credibility with national authorities. You have collaborated closely with the relevant National Security, MoD, defence-procurement, and cyber/IT-security authorities in Spain

  • Currently held Security Clearance is essential

  • In possession of (or eligible for) Reservado Nacional personal security clearance, and ideally the equivalent EU/ESA/EC Secret)

  • Strong grasp of IT security accreditation paths for classified systems — the national baseline security standards, approved classified-IT regime, and formal accreditation/approval process for higher classifications such as ISO 9001, NATO/APAQ PECAL

  • Fluent in English, with native Spanish, with the ability to brief at executive, authority, and working level.

 

Application Process

  • Intro conversation with Talent Acquisition (30 min)

  • Interview with Country Director of Operations (45 min)

  • Hiring manager interview with the CEO, ICEYE Spain (45 min)

  • Technical case: a take-home roadmap exercise. Demonstrate your vision to build from current state to the highest target classification level, including facility, personnel, and IT accreditation — presented and defended in person to a panel (90 min)

  • Interview with ICEYE’s Chief Security Officer (45 min)

  • Final conversation with the Global CEO of ICEYE

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible.   • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mechanical AIT Engineer - Japan

  • Team: Global Manufacturing Organization – AIT Engineering

  • Location: Tokyo, Japan

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

 

Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, revolutionizing Earth observation with real-time, all-weather, day-and-night imaging. As the owner and operator of the world's largest SAR satellite constellation, we provide critical insights that empower industries like defense, maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance to make informed decisions.

  • Lifting operations certification or experience with MGSE proof-load testing

  • Proficient Japanese (written and spoken)

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value — it's our greatest strength. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. jobs.title: Systems and Software Team Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Systems and Software Team Lead

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

We are looking for a Systems and Software Team Lead to own systems and software production and satellite-level testing for ICEYE's SAR satellites, from production integration through to proof that every onboard system performs reliably before a satellite ships.

Your team is responsible for onboard software loading, validation, and checkout during production, and full satellite-level functional and end-to-end system checkout, including RF testing in the anechoic chamber as part of that satellite-level test campaign. You will lead a multidisciplinary team of engineers and technicians across systems and software, and carry the ultimate responsibility for flight readiness on the systems and software side of the build.

This is a hands-on leadership role at the core of production. You'll spend time on the floor with your team, troubleshooting, unblocking issues, and improving processes, while working alongside the Integration and Mechanical team leads to keep the overall satellite build on schedule and to the highest quality standards. ICEYE's production volumes are scaling significantly, and this role is central to building the systems, tooling, and team needed to support that growth.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

Leading Systems & Software Production

  • Own systems and software production for ICEYE's SAR satellites, ensuring mission readiness from integration through launch

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute satellite build stages across production, from initial integration through flight readiness

  • Own end-to-end production flows for onboard software, avionics, and SAR payload system integration

  • Be hands-on: lead troubleshooting, unblock issues, keep production momentum


Owning Satellite-Level Verification

  • Drive execution of system-level functional testing, verification, and acceptance for SAR flight units, once integration is complete

  • Prove that all onboard systems (avionics, power, software) perform reliably in full configuration

  • Own planning, execution, and reporting of system-level functional tests and inspections, including RF testing of the full satellite in the anechoic chamber

  • Ensure anechoic chamber test setups are properly scheduled, maintained, and executed as part of the satellite-level test flow

Owning Software in Production

  • Own onboard software loading, validation, and checkout during production and verification

  • Maintain and improve test automation, scripts, and software-supported verification flows with keeping supporting stakeholders in loop.

  • Ensure robustness of SAR mission software, including payload control, data handling, and spacecraft operations

Driving Quality, Traceability & Compliance

  • Maintain configuration control, build discipline, and full traceability

  • Ensure compliance with aerospace quality standards

  • Manage technical risks, anomalies, and non-conformances through root cause analysis and corrective action, identifying and driving resolution of the issues most critical to the production line

Building Scalable, Repeatable Processes

  • Define and continuously improve scalable production workflows, work instructions, test procedures, and checklists together with AIT Engineering and Quality

  • Turn unclear inputs into clear, usable verification processes, reducing reliance on tribal knowledge

  • Drive throughput and reduce rework while protecting quality, as production volumes scale


Leading & Developing the Team

  • Lead, coach, and grow a multidisciplinary team across systems and software, including satellite-level test execution

  • Mentor and lead the team, fostering operational excellence, accountability, and a high-reliability spaceflight culture

  • Train and mentor on systems and software test best practices and fault diagnostics, including anechoic chamber test execution


Working Across Teams & Scaling

  • Act as the primary technical interface between AIT engineers, engineering, production, and mission operations for SAR missions

  • Coordinate closely with the Integration and Mechanical team leads to ensure a unified, on-schedule satellite build

  • Prepare verification and production processes for higher volumes; define and track KPIs


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Strong leadership experience, with the ability to manage and guide a multidisciplinary team of engineers and technicians, fostering collaboration and growth

  • Proven expertise in systems and/or software integration for complex hardware, ideally in satellite, aerospace, or a similarly regulated high-reliability environment

  • In-depth knowledge of onboard software, avionics, and payload systems, and how they interact with the broader satellite build

  • Comfort with software in test: flight software loading/validation, test automation, and scripting

  • Strong background in root cause analysis, anomaly management, and non-conformance resolution

  • Familiarity with satellite-level test methods, including exposure to RF/anechoic chamber testing (spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, signal generators, power meters)

  • Excellent organizational and planning skills, able to coordinate across multiple technical disciplines and manage competing priorities

  • Effective communicator, able to convey technical updates clearly to engineers, technicians, and senior management, including C-level executives

What Success Looks Like

  • Every satellite's systems and software performance is verified reliably, predictably, and to standard before it ships, including its RF/anechoic chamber test results

  • Systems and software verification processes are clear, structured, and scalable

  • Problems are isolated and solved at the root, not patched

  • The team takes full ownership of production and verification quality and traceability

  • Production and verification throughput keep pace with ICEYE's growth

Why This Role Is Interesting

  • You bring systems and software production and verification together under one scope, including the satellite's final anechoic chamber test

  • You own the moment of truth: proving that every satellite works end-to-end before it ships

  • You'll shape how production and verification are done, not just follow existing processes

  • You'll work at the intersection of engineering and production, where your decisions have immediate impact

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager General Interview

  • Technical Interview, including a Technical Challenge

  • Hiring Team Interview

  • Director Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is depends on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

As a Senior Targeting Analyst, you'll own the tasking systems and methodologies behind Wildfire, Earthquake, and Persistent Monitoring change detection. You'll work through satellite capacity, geometry, and scheduling trade-offs to make scalable, defensible decisions. You'll be the on-shift point of expertise when things go wrong, and you’ll help build the frameworks that move these perils toward automation, and shape how ICEYE monitors change across the planet as new products and methods take form.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 - Serve as the expert on tasking and monitoring methods, working with Solutions Product teams with input on concepts and programmatic approaches

  • Willingness and ability to work onsite in Espoo in production and integration environments.

  • Experience with satellite or spacecraft integration and MGSE.

  • Experience working across multiple production sites or in a global manufacturing context.

  • Knowledge of lean manufacturing and/or Six Sigma tools and practices.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Senior People Generalist

  • Location: Portugal, Lisbon

  • Department: Local subsidiary

  • Reports to: CEO, ICEYE Portugal & indirect line to Global Head of People Operations

  • Employment type: Permanent, full-time

  • Workplace model: hybrid (office-first)

Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

You are the face of People Operations for ICEYE in Portugal and the first line of defence for all country-specific people matters. ICEYE's Global HR Operations team (the second line) designs the global frameworks, tools and data standards; you own their local tailoring and practical execution — while ICEYE Portugal builds two very different organisations at once: a Lisbon Center of Excellence hiring software, AI and space engineers, and a satellite production facility ramping manufacturing, integration and test teams through 2027. Your mission: ICEYErs in Portugal are engaged and supported so they can deliver better business results.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. Your day-to-day responsibilities

Employee experience & local HR operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for local employees on benefits, policies and employee lifecycle events, providing timely and accurate responses in line with global standards.

  • Handle individual cases for relocation and onboarding, including preparation of local employment contracts and country-specific documentation.

  • Manage local third-party HR providers (payroll vendor, benefit brokers) and the local practicalities of off-boarding, meeting all legal requirements and exit procedures.

  • Act as the first point of contact for standard employee relations cases, handling practicalities locally and consulting Global HR Operations on complex issues.

Payroll, data & compliance

  • Audit payroll data in the HRIS and ensure accurate local processing in collaboration with the in-house team and the local payroll vendor.

  • Maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS and related systems: data integrity, confidentiality and compliance with local and global data privacy regulations.

  • Stay on top of Portuguese employment law — including the specifics of an industrial site (shifts, safety-adjacent policies, collective frameworks where applicable) — and keep all HR activity compliant, with clear documentation of local processes and policies.

  • Coordinate the personnel security clearance process with the local security officer for roles that require it.

Global alignment & people programmes

  • Act as the go-to person for the CEO on HR matters, escalating complex issues to the Global HR team when necessary.

  • Tailor and execute global frameworks locally — levels, salary bands, performance management, wellbeing, L&D — so they work for both the Center of Excellence and the factory population.

  • Identify opportunities to automate local HR tasks with Global HR Operations, adapting global ways of working to local legal standards while preserving ICEYE's culture.

  • Assist managers and leads as the organisation adds its first layers of management.

Talent Attraction

  • Act as the bridge between the global Talent Attraction team and local hiring needs in Portugal: oversee local TA processes, keep hiring moving at the right speed and step in with hands-on support when needed.

  • Support local employer brand building and the channels that feed it, including university partnerships and the local tech and industrial talent networks.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience covering both talent acquisition and HR generalist/business partner work.

  • Strong working knowledge of Portuguese labour law, local benefits and market HR practice, with a track record of creating compliant HR policy documentation.

  • A hands-on approach with high attention to detail in contract management, local onboarding and the management of local third-party providers.

  • Track record hiring technical/engineering profiles and industrial or manufacturing profiles; you personally source and close candidates.

  • Strong analytical skills and high emotional intelligence to handle sensitive individual employee relations cases, with the wisdom to escalate complex issues.

  • Comfort with HRIS (e.g., HiBob) and ticketing systems, using data to audit payroll and maintain source-of-truth records.

  • Exceptional communication in Portuguese and English, able to bridge global ICEYE standards with local needs and influence both local leadership and the global team.

  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset that stays effective in a fast-scaling environment, adapting global policies to local contexts without losing speed.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience taking a site from roughly 20 to 100+ people.

  • HR experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defence or another clearance-relevant industry.

  • Experience introducing or running HRIS and ATS tooling in a growing company.

  • AI-native sourcing, screening and HR-automation practices.

  • Experience in a subsidiary of an international group, balancing local ownership with global frameworks.

 

Application Process

  • TA Screening

  • HR interview

  • CEO interview (on-site)

Working at ICEYE

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Quality Control Technician - Mechanical

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Department: Stock Management

  • Reports to: Manager, Stock & Logistics Management

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

Customer Excellence Specialist

  • Location: Seoul, Korea OR Singapore OR New Delhi, India

  • Department: Customer Excellence – Data

  • Reports to: Customer Excellence Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Work model: Hybrid (shift-based including 1 weekend shift per month, no night shifts)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

 

Why this role matters

Deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order-to-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.

 

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. You will work closely with our satellite operations, product, and analytics teams to make sure every delivery meets ICEYE’s world-class standards and customer expectations.

 

Who We Are

 

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data-driven decisions.

 

Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

 

Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact.

 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management:

  • Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.

  • Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.

Satellite Resource Planning:

  • Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.

  • Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.

Customer Interaction:

  • Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.

  • Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.

Process Improvement:

  • Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.

  • Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.

Product Knowledge:

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:

  • Serve as the point of contact for APAC governmental contracts and commercial clients.

  • Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.

Relationship Building:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.

Training and Progress Monitoring:

  • Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.

  • Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues

Reporting:

  • Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

 

Requirements

Must haves:

  • Proven experience in customer excellence or account management roles.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Bachelor's degree or practical experience in geography, remote sensing, or aerospace domains.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindu/Mandarin/Korean (depending on the location).

 

Key Competences

  • Intellectual Firepower: Quickly grasps complex operational and technical information, translating it into clear customer communication.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Demonstrates consistent motivation, reliability, and ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Ownership & Action: Takes accountability for order performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Team Player: Collaborates effectively with global colleagues and cross-functional teams.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Acts transparently, learns from challenges, and seeks continuous improvement.

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

jobs.title: Harness Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Harness Engineer

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Engineering, Optical Systems

  • Reports to: Satellite Build Engineering Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Harness Engineer, you build the electrical backbone of ICEYE’s satellites. Every subsystem on the spacecraft, from power to command and data handling, depends on harnesses being manufactured, routed, and verified correctly. You will execute assigned harness manufacturing, installation, and verification tasks with high precision, following established procedures and work instructions.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own the harness build process from drawings and wire tables to finished, verified harness, including manufacturing, installation, routing, and test

  • Write and maintain work instructions, travelers, checklists, and build procedures that technicians can follow with confidence

  • Act as the bridge between harness design and production, giving design-for-manufacturing (DfM) feedback on wire tables, connector choices, routing, and harness layouts

  • Define and improve verification and acceptance testing, including continuity, insulation resistance, and pin retention, and design or specify test fixtures and tooling

  • Lead troubleshooting of build and process issues on the floor, own NCRs, drive root cause analysis, and put corrective actions in place with Quality

  • Support harness installation and integration on satellite assemblies together with the Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) team, making sure bend radii, strain relief, and routing standards are respected

  • Make sure work follows IPC/WHMA-A-620, ECSS, and internal standards, with full traceability and configuration control

  • Support and coach technicians, sharing best practices and helping the team build its harness capability

  • Keep a clean, organised, and audit-ready work environment that meets ESD, safety, and cleanliness standards

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • A degree in Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, or Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical discipline

  • At least 3 years of experience in cable and harness manufacturing, electromechanical assembly, or production engineering, ideally in aerospace, defence, or another high-reliability environment

  • Solid understanding of harness build techniques: crimping, soldering, shielding, lacing, connectorisation, and protective coverings

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, wire tables, schematics, and wiring diagrams, and to turn them into practical work instructions

  • Experience with electrical testing of harnesses and with defining acceptance criteria

  • Structured problem-solving skills and experience with NCRs and root cause analysis

  • Clear communication skills and proficient English (written and spoken) for cross-functional collaboration

Nice to haves:

  • IPC certifications, particularly IPC/WHMA-A-620 or IPC J-STD-001 (Space Addendum)

  • Familiarity with aerospace standards (ECSS, IPC) and configuration control

  • Experience with harness design tools (e.g. Zuken E3, Capital, SolidWorks Electrical) or 3D harness routing

  • Experience with coaxial, shielded, or high-speed cable assemblies

  • Exposure to satellite integration or environmental test campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum)

  • Previous work in a cleanroom or under formal ESD controls

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Business Development Manager

  • Location: Any Australian state capital city, Canberra preferred

  • Department: Data Sales

  • Reports to: Data Sales Director, Australia & New Zealand

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Remote first, frequent travel expected

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Business Development Manager, you’ll bridge the gap between ICEYE’s world-leading ISR satellite capability and the people who use space-based geospatial intelligence at the sharp end of Australian and New Zealand (ANZ) defence and national security. You will open doors, build credibility, and ensure the ANZ’s most important intelligence users understand what makes ICEYE genuinely different.

ICEYE is not the traditional defence prime. ICEYE is a different proposition entirely. We are one of the world’s fastest-growing space companies, and we are only at the beginning of what we intend to build in the ANZ region – not only in defence and intelligence, but across a range of industry verticals where geospatial intelligence is a critical need.
From day one, you'll own the full sales cycle for Data Sales business clients — identifying opportunities, shaping deals, and closing multi-year contracts — with the autonomy to move at pace and build the strategic relationships that expand ICEYE's presence across the ANZ market.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation, we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system as both a data and managed service business.

ICEYE serves customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance, mining, maritime and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

ICEYE is expanding both satellite technological capabilities and its advanced data processing product suite, and over time the range and breadth of data products will increase. This is a learning role that will span a range of industries and use cases.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1200 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Report to the ANZ Data Sales team

  • Build and maintain a trusted network of Intelligence and GEOINT practitioners across ANZ defence, intelligence and other industries: attending user engagements, demonstrations, and briefings to represent ICEYE credibly at the working level and stay close to user needs, priorities, and procurement timelines.

  • Advise internal ICEYE teams (Missions, Data and Solutions) on how ANZ military and intelligence users consume intelligence imagery, what tradecraft matters, and how to frame ICEYE’s products in language that resonates with analysts and collection managers.

  • Identify key decision-influencers across ANZ target organisations, and plan, host, and lead ICEYE engagements, from technical demonstrations to senior roundtables, to build trust and advance ICEYE’s standing.

  • Participate as needed in ANZ military exercises that incorporate ICEYE capability, representing ICEYE at the operational level and capturing lessons that feed back into product and service development.

  • Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making.

  • Produce responses to RFPs, proposals, inbound enquiries, assist with promotional material and attend relevant industry events.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • An established personal network within the ANZ geospatial community at the working and mid-senior level (people who will take your call)

  • 5+ years of strategic sales or enterprise business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector.

  • Proven experience selling to ANZ government, defence, or public sector organisations, with an existing network you can activate from day one

  • Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR.

  • Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure.

  • Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the ANZ region and to Europe.

Nice to haves:

  • Currently serving as a reservist, or recently transitioned from active duty within the last five years.

  • Familiarity with SAR (and other ISR) geospatial satellite products, or experience working with commercial SAR (and other ISR) providers.

  • Experience using Salesforce or another CRM.

  • Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley, or a similar methodology

  • Holds current ANZ Defence Security Clearance

Application Process

  • Recruiter interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Peer interview(s)

  • VP interview

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Salary range is dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

jobs.title: Satellite Systems Senior Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Title: Satellite Systems Senior Technician

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE Spain

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Satellite Systems Senior Technician, you play a vital role in bringing every satellite that reaches our Valencia production line to operational readiness. You will own the first power-on, initial software and firmware loading, and end-to-end systems verification of fully integrated SAR satellites, running automated functional, power, and bus test campaigns, diagnosing issues at the boundary between software, firmware, and electronics hardware, and ensuring configuration control on final activities. Your work lets test campaigns run independently on the line, without pulling engineers away from other teams.

 

Who We Are
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Execute initial satellite power-on, firmware flashing, and subsystem communication verifications.

  • Run, debug, and execute automated functional, power, and bus test scripts using Python, Shell, and Linux environments.

  • Work with Git repositories to manage test code, track updates, and verify software builds.

  • Operate mechanical and electrical ground support equipment (GSE), and troubleshoot electronic hardware, power distribution, and digital interface issues using lab instruments (oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters).

  • Diagnose whether an anomaly is a test setup issue or a genuine unit fault, and raise non-conformance reports (NCRs) in Jira.

  • Maintain detailed test logs and accurate documentation, and ensure configuration control on final activities.

  • Assist in managing activities related to satellite launch campaigns.

  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives - procedures, processes, tools, test automation, and 6S.

  • Assist in training and mentoring junior technicians, and communicate proactively with team members and supervisors regarding any challenges or obstacles.

  • Work closely with the RF Senior Technician, AIT Engineering, and Quality, ensuring clear communication so that satellite build-phase deadlines and technical specifications are met.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Relevant university degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Space Studies, Applied Physics, Electronics, or similar, or equivalent hands-on experience in a related role.

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience setting up, debugging, and running real test benches and satellite systems or interfaces, not just executing someone else’s scripts.

  • Proficient in a Linux environment, comfortable modifying and debugging Python scripts, and working with Git.

  • Systems thinking across avionics, power, and software, enough to tell a test setup fault from a genuine unit fault.

  • Experience using lab equipment such as power supplies, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.

  • Excellent communication skills, with particular attention to detail in procedures, preparation, and execution.

  • Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, assembly instructions, and schematics.

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross-functional environment.

Nice to haves:

  • ICEYE-specific test frameworks, satellite bus specifics, Jira and MES flow, and launch campaign procedures.

  • Space or satellite AIT (Assembly, Integration, and Testing) background.

  • Experience with environmental testing (e.g. vibration/shaker rigs, thermal testing).

  • Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence).

  • Lean & Six Sigma experience.

 

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager General Interview

  • Technical Interview, including a Technical Challenge

  • Final Interview

 

Working at ICEYE

Your work lets test campaigns run independently on the line, without pulling engineers away from other teams.

 - Work with Git repositories to manage test code, track updates, and verify software builds.

 - Operate mechanical and electrical ground support equipment (GSE), and troubleshoot electronic hardware, power distribution, and digital interface issues using lab instruments (oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters).

 - Diagnose whether an anomaly is a test setup issue or a genuine unit fault, and raise non-conformance reports (NCRs) in Jira.

 - Maintain detailed test logs and accurate documentation, and ensure configuration control on final activities.

 - Assist in managing activities related to satellite launch campaigns.

 - Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives - procedures, processes, tools, test automation, and 6S.

 - Assist in training and mentoring junior technicians, and communicate proactively with team members and supervisors regarding any challenges or obstacles.

 - Work closely with the RF Senior Technician, AIT Engineering, and Quality, ensuring clear communication so that satellite build-phase deadlines and technical specifications are met.

 - 4+ years of hands-on experience setting up, debugging, and running real test benches and satellite systems or interfaces, not just executing someone else’s scripts.

 - Proficient in a Linux environment, comfortable modifying and debugging Python scripts, and working with Git.

 - Systems thinking across avionics, power, and software, enough to tell a test setup fault from a genuine unit fault.

 - Experience using lab equipment such as power supplies, multimeters, and oscilloscopes.

 - Excellent communication skills, with particular attention to detail in procedures, preparation, and execution.

 - Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, assembly instructions, and schematics.

 - Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross-functional environment.

 - ICEYE-specific test frameworks, satellite bus specifics, Jira and MES flow, and launch campaign procedures.

 - Space or satellite AIT (Assembly, Integration, and Testing) background.

 - Experience with environmental testing (e.g. vibration/shaker rigs, thermal testing).

 - Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence).

 - Lean & Six Sigma experience.

Role highlights:

  • Role: Forward Deployed Backend/DevOps Engineer

  • Location: Portugal (Lisbon)

  • Reports to: VP, Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time)

  • Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances.

  • Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to.

 

Why this role matters

In this role, you are the backend and infrastructure backbone defence and intelligence customers rely on. You deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and design the high-performance backend systems that move satellite data at scale — fast APIs, resilient services, tuned databases, automated infrastructure. Our stack: Python and Go services on Kubernetes, PostgreSQL and MongoDB, Terraform and Ansible, CI/CD pipelines that also run offline, cloud (AWS) and on-premises air-gapped clusters, with AI-assisted development as the default.

This is a ship-daily role: systems you build run mission-critical workloads analysts use to protect nations.

What you'll own

Platform deployment & operations

  • Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centres).

  • Install, upgrade and operate Kubernetes clusters and containerised applications (Docker) in customer environments — cloud and on-premises.

  • Build infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD pipelines that work without external internet access, including offline registries and artifact mirroring.

  • Troubleshoot deployment and production issues in disconnected environments, from the application layer down to storage and networking.

High-performance backend systems

  • Design and build APIs, services and data pipelines that handle large volumes of SAR imagery and intelligence data with low latency.

  • Connect ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools through robust, well-designed integrations.

  • Own database design and performance at production scale (PostgreSQL, MongoDB): schemas, indexing, tuning, replication and backup.

  • Apply caching, queueing and horizontal scaling patterns deliberately — and capacity-plan for fixed on-premises hardware where you cannot simply scale out.

Reliability, security & observability

  • Build monitoring, logging and alerting that work in restricted environments, so problems are found before the customer finds them.

  • Harden deployments to meet customer security constraints; own backup, recovery and upgrade paths for systems that cannot go down.

  • Run the infrastructure behind AI workloads shipped by the team — model serving, vector databases, GPU nodes — reliably and repeatably.

Customer engagement & rapid delivery

  • Work embedded with intelligence analysts, operators and customer IT teams to understand operational and infrastructure requirements.

  • Rapidly prototype and iterate (working systems first, polish later) to address immediate operational needs.

  • Conduct hands-on training for customer administrators on platform operations.

  • Feed deployment experience back to ICEYE's product and engineering teams as concrete technical requirements.

What we're looking for

Must-haves

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering building and operating production systems at scale.

  • Strong programming skills in Python. You write typed, tested services and you are comfortable with async APIs. TypeScript is a plus.

  • Proven experience designing high-performance backend systems: APIs, distributed services, messaging, caching and databases under real load. Experience with spatial, search, or vector workloads in Postgres is a plus.

  • Production experience in both cloud (e.g., AWS) and on-premises environments — this role lives in both.

  • Deep Docker and Kubernetes: deploy, debug, and upgrade clusters — not only consume them. GitOps and infrastructure-as-code experience. Pipelines that can run offline or on an isolated network are a plus.

  • Observability as a habit: metrics, logs, and alerts are part of done.

  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible) and CI/CD experience, ideally including pipelines that run offline or in isolated networks.

  • PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB at production scale: schema design, tuning, replication, backup and recovery.

  • Observability as a habit: metrics, logging and alerting are part of done, not an afterthought.

  • Builder mindset: ship fast, iterate with feedback, and prioritise working solutions over perfect architecture.

  • Strong communication and customer engagement, able to work embedded with intelligence analysts / military operators.

  • Strong spoken and written English, able to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Willingness to travel 40–60% to customer sites within the region.

Nice to have

  • Experience in defence, intelligence, or government operational environments.

  • Deploying to on-prem data centres and/or air-gapped networks, including offline artifact and registry management.

  • Event streaming and high-throughput data systems (e.g., Kafka or similar) at production scale.

  • Deeper Kubernetes: operators, service mesh, multi-cluster, storage and networking internals.

  • Security hardening and accreditation experience (system hardening baselines, audit and compliance in classified environments).

  • Familiarity with geospatial data, satellite imagery, or remote sensing.

  • Experience running infrastructure for AI/LLM workloads: GPU scheduling, model serving, vector databases.

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools as part of your daily workflow.

  • Experience in defence tech (e.g., Palantir, Anduril, Scale AI, similar startups).

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one.   • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing—at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Customer Excellence Specialist

  • Location: Seoul, Korea OR Singapore OR New Delhi, India

  • Department: Customer Excellence – Data

  • Reports to: Customer Excellence Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Work model: Hybrid (shift-based including 1 weekend shift per month, no night shifts)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

Why this role matters

Deliver seamless, high-quality customer experiences across APAC region by managing the complete order-to-delivery process for ICEYE’s satellite radar data.

As a Customer Excellence Specialist, you will ensure customers receive timely and accurate Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery, balancing technical insight, proactive communication, and operational precision. You will work closely with our satellite operations, product, and analytics teams to make sure every delivery meets ICEYE’s world-class standards and customer expectations.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite operations for Earth Observation, persistent monitoring, and natural catastrophe solutions. We own and operate the world’s largest SAR constellation, acquiring images of Earth at any time — even through clouds or darkness — to help commercial and government partners make data-driven decisions.

Our satellites and analytics support critical sectors, including maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance. ICEYE’s mission is to improve life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates from offices in five international locations and employs over 600 people from nearly 60 countries, united by our passion for innovation, teamwork, and impact.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Regular Customer Excellence Responsibilities

Order Management:

  • Oversee the entire order process, from submission to the delivery of the final product.

  • Prepare comprehensive feasibility studies for satellite imagery, ensuring customer requirements are met.

Satellite Resource Planning:

  • Plan satellite resources for capturing Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) images.

  • Perform SAR image quality control to maintain high standards.

Customer Interaction:

  • Resolve customer inquiries and complaints promptly.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (satellite operators, sales, analytics, product software) to address project and customer-related issues.

  • Serve as a vital interface between clients and ICEYE, ensuring effective communication and interaction.

Process Improvement:

  • Contribute to the enhancement of existing processes and documentation.

  • Report to management on key performance metrics and anomalies.

Product Knowledge:

  • Maintain a thorough understanding of the company’s products, support, and services.

Governmental and Commercial Contracts:

  • Serve as the point of contact for APAC governmental contracts and commercial clients.

  • Conduct feasibility studies and effectively communicate results to customers.

Relationship Building:

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with customers, serving as a key contact for order-related queries.

Training and Progress Monitoring:

  • Coordinate and conduct service training for both internal and external customers.

  • Monitor order progress closely, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues

Reporting:

  • Satisfy internal and external reporting needs by providing accurate Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Requirements

Must haves:

  • Proven experience in customer excellence or account management roles.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Bachelor's degree or practical experience in geography, remote sensing, or aerospace domains.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English and Hindi/Mandarin/Korean (depending on the location).

Key Competences

  • Intellectual Firepower: Quickly grasps complex operational and technical information, translating it into clear customer communication.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Demonstrates consistent motivation, reliability, and ownership in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Ownership & Action: Takes accountability for order performance and customer satisfaction.

  • Team Player: Collaborates effectively with global colleagues and cross-functional teams.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Acts transparently, learns from challenges, and seeks continuous improvement.

• Title: Staff Structural Analysis Engineer

  • Location: Valencia

  • Department: Space Systems

  • Reports to: Mechanical Engineer

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site / Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

Why this role matters:

As a Staff Structural Analysis Engineer, you’ll lead structural analysis and engineering efforts to ensure ICEYE’s satellites meet demanding aerospace requirements for structural integrity, reliability, and manufacturability, enabling mission success from launch through on-orbit operations.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Define structural requirements from mission and launcher constraints down to system and subsystem levels

  • Lead and contribute to trade studies, design reviews, and verification and qualification documentation

  • Ensure smooth and timely product delivery from concept through qualification

  • Drive continuous improvement of structural design and analysis methods

  • Collaborate with hardware engineering, AIT, and quality teams to ensure compliance with launch and in-orbit environments

  • Work with system and subsystem engineers to define requirements for new products

  • Support integration, validation, and issue resolution across internal and external teams

What are we looking for

Must haves:

  • Master’s degree in Structural Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field

  • Experience leading and managing structural analysis

  • Experience designing satellite structures, subsystems, or complex electromechanical systems

  • Deep understanding of mechanical stress, vibration, and thermal effects on space structures

  • Strong expertise in finite element analysis, including structural dynamics and failure analysis

  • Experience with mechanical, hybrid, and bonded joints for load-carrying composite structures

  • Familiarity with aerospace standards such as ECSS, NASA, or MIL

  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with systems, electrical, and manufacturing teams

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with PLM or PDM systems for configuration control

  • Hands-on experience with mechanical assembly, integration, and testing

  • Experience with launch vehicle or spacecraft environments

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Technical task

  • Technical panel interview

  • Final interview

  • Manage local mobile phone subscriptions.

  • Set up, deploy, and physically maintain laptops, docking stations, monitors, printers, and meeting room AV equipment.

  • Support basic day-to-day hardware maintenance, workstation setups, and physical network patching on the manufacturing floor.

  • Assist with user onboarding and offboarding by imaging laptops and provisioning standard accounts using checklists.

  • Maintain accurate local hardware inventory, track asset movement, and help keep site IT documentation up to date.

  • 2+ years of practical IT support, desktop support, or service desk experience (or a completed vocational qualification / degree in IT or a related field).

  • Clear verbal and written English and German communication skills with a customer-focused, helpful attitude.

  • Initial exposure to ticketing platforms like Jira Service Management.

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Reports to: Head of MAITE Spain

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Type of Contract: Permanent

  • Working model: On-site

As a Satellite RF Senior Technician, you play a vital role in proving that every satellite’s radar payload meets aerospace quality standards before it leaves our Valencia production line. You will operate our Anechoic Chamber, execute RF payload verification and antenna characterization, and validate SAR radar performance using specialized high-frequency instrumentation. Your work gives ICEYE dedicated, high-quality RF test capability on the line, alongside our systems and software verification team.

  • Prepare, mount, and operate satellites inside the Anechoic Chamber for RF payload testing and antenna characterization.

  • Set up and operate high-frequency RF instrumentation, including spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, RF signal generators, and power meters.

  • Execute manual and automated RF test scripts to measure gain, phase, frequency response, power output, and link budgets.

  • Diagnose and troubleshoot RF path, signal integrity, and payload subsystem anomalies, distinguishing test/cabling setup issues from genuine unit faults.

  • Operate mechanical and electrical ground support equipment (GSE) to ensure smooth chamber test operations.

  • Actively contribute to continuous improvement initiatives — procedures, processes, tools, and 6S.

  • Maintain accurate records and documentation of work performed, and communicate proactively with team members and supervisors regarding any challenges or obstacles.

  • Practical experience executing RF tests, Anechoic Chamber operation, and RF cabling/setup debugging.

  • Solid understanding of RF fundamentals, radar or communications payloads, gain, phase, frequency response, and interference.

  • Basic proficiency in a Linux environment and running Python or Shell scripts for automated test procedures.

  • Excellent communication skills, with particular attention to detail in procedures, preparation, and execution.

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross-functional environment.

Nice to haves:

  • Background in synthetic aperture radar (SAR), space hardware, or defense electronics.

  • Knowledge of antenna alignment and chamber calibration.

  • Advanced Python scripting, ICEYE-specific test frameworks, and satellite bus specifics.

  • Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Sovereign Infrastructure Operations Engineer

  • Location: Espoo

  • Department: IT

  • Reports to: Head of IT

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Onsite

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As a Sovereign Infrastructure Operations Engineer, you'll take operational ownership of ICEYE's secure bare-metal infrastructure, virtualization platforms, and production Kubernetes environments, keeping the dedicated air gaped collaboration platform reliable, secure, and audit-ready under some of the strictest information security frameworks in Europe.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Manage configuration state across physical and virtual assets using GitOps with Infrastructure as Code tools (Git/Gitlab, Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet), removing manual configuration drift in secure environments in alignment with the strict change policies of the given security controls

  • Maintain and support production Kubernetes clusters in restricted environments, covering upgrades, storage integration, and registry management

  • Administer secure platform core services (Mattermost, Nextcloud, Keycloak, OpenBao), including deployment, upgrades, and integration with local IAM and storage

  • Run weekly meetings (change management, vulnerability management) with stakeholders on the infrastructure side

  • Maintain technical security controls to satisfy Finnish Katakri, German VS-NfD, and related European frameworks (e.g. NIS2, ISO 27001), including patch management, hardening, and access control

  • Maintain secure infrastructure networking (VLAN isolation, mTLS, PKI) and identity integrations, in coordination with network and security teams

  • Execute backup and disaster recovery procedures and routine hardware maintenance across air-gapped or high-security sites

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years hands-on experience in Systems Administration, IT Systems Engineering, or Infrastructure Operations, with a focus on Linux environments

  • Practical experience running and maintaining production Kubernetes clusters

  • Expert-level Linux administration (Debian/Ubuntu or RHEL/Rocky), including system hardening and vulnerability patching

  • Practical knowledge of Katakri, VS-NfD, or equivalent European security/compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, NIS2)

  • Solid understanding of enterprise networking fundamentals (VLAN segmentation, firewalls, DNS/DHCP, VPN protocols, PKI)

  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a high-level national security clearance in Finland

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with Ceph or ZFS storage systems

  • Experience with at least one Infrastructure as Code tool (Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet), with the ability to manage configurations

  • Experience with Keycloak, Vault, or internal PKI management

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes operations specifically in secure or air-gapped environments

 

Application Process

  • TA Screen (30 mins)

  • Interview with Hiring Manager (30 mins)

  • Technical Deep-Dive Interview with Team (60 mins)

  • Stakeholder & Security Alignment Interview (30 mins)

jobs.title: Senior HR Generalist, Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior HR Generalist, Japan


Department: Local subsidiary
Reports To: ICEYE Japan
Indirect Reporting Line: Global Head of HR/People Operations
Position: Permanent full-time role
Country: Japan

Role Overview: As a (Senior) HR Generalist, you are a key member of ICEYE’s local subsidiary in Japan and part of our globally distributed HR team, responsible for ensuring a seamless and positive employee experience across the entire employee lifecycle for ICEYErs in your designated location.

You are the face of HR for our local office and the "1st Line of Defense" for all country-specific people matters. While our Global HR Operations team (the "2nd Line of Defense") designs global frameworks, tools, and data standards, you are responsible for the local tailoring and practical execution of these standards.

You will handle high-touch, individual cases that require deep knowledge of local labor laws and office culture. You bridge the gap between global ICEYE standards and local needs, collaborating closely with the local CEO and departments like IT, Finance, and Office Management to drive operational excellence and employee satisfaction.

In short, your mission is to ensure that ICEYErs in your assigned country are happy and engaged so that they can deliver better business results!

Responsibilities:

● Serve as the primary point of contact for local employees via our ticketing system or other dedicated tools, addressing a wide range of HR inquiries and issues related to benefits, policies, and employee lifecycle events, providing timely and accurate responses in alignment with our global standards.

● Handle individual cases for relocation and onboarding, including the preparation of local employment contracts and country-specific documentation.

● Manage local third-party HR providers in your assigned country to effectively address employee needs.

● Manage the local practicalities of offboarding to ensure all legal requirements and exit procedures are met.

● Act as the first point of contact for standard ER cases, handling practicalities while consulting with HRBPs and Global HR Operations on complex issues.

● Audit payroll data in the HRIS and ensure accurate local processing in collaboration with our in-house team and local payroll vendor.

● Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records in HRIS and other relevant systems, ensuring data integrity, confidentiality, and compliance with local and global data privacy regulations.

● Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for all local HR processes and policies.

● Stay abreast of changing local employment laws, ensuring all HR activities remain compliant and sharing best practices with relevant stakeholders.

● Identify opportunities to automate local HR tasks in collaboration with the Global HR Operations team, ensuring global "ways of working" meet local legal standards whilst preserving ICEYE’s core culture.

● Act as the go-to person for the local CEO on HR matters, escalating complex issues to the Global HR team when necessary.

● Provide local logistics and individual support for global HR initiatives such as Wellbeing, Performance Management, and L&D.

● Actively participate in or lead the development and communication of local HR programs and policies in accordance with team priorities.

Requirements

● Strong working knowledge of Japanese labor law, local benefits and market HR best practices, with a track record of creating compliant HR policy documentation and internal knowledge base pages.

● A "hands-on" approach with high attention to detail in contract management, local onboarding experience, and the management of local third-party providers (e.g., benefit brokers).

● Exceptional communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between global standards and local needs, influencing both local leadership and the global HR team.

● Strong analytical skills and high emotional intelligence to act as the "1st Line of Defense," handling sensitive "individual case" employee relations with the wisdom to escalate complex issues to the Global HR Operations team.

● Exceptional communication skills in English and Japanese, with the ability to bridge global ICEYE standards with local needs while influencing both local leadership and the global team.

● Comfort with HRIS (e.g., HiBob) and ticketing systems, utilizing data to audit local payroll and maintain "source of truth" records.

● A proactive and service-oriented mindset and the ability to remain effective in a fast-scaling environment, adapting global policies to local contexts without losing speed.

  • Lead the planning and execution of strategic events, trade shows, customer workshops, and high-level engagement visits to ensure a strong brand presence.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to the India team on brand, reputation, and stakeholder communications, and to the global CMO on regional market intelligence and narrative consistency.

  • Ideally you have worked in B2G environment with campaigns in defense, aerospace, government, or the public sector in India

  • Demonstrated experience building and leading a marketing/communications function, including managing budgets, agencies, and, where applicable, direct reports.

  • Experience in trade and channel co-marketing, with the ability to build credibility with senior defense, government, and policy audiences.

  • Proven ability to collaborate and influence across diverse stakeholders, including global marketing, regional sales, executive leadership, and external agency partners.

  • Flexible, positive attitude with an entrepreneurial, hands-on drive, thriving in a fast-paced, agile growth environment.

  • Experience in marketing or PR engagement with India defense entities.

  • Expertise in end-to-end program management (planning, execution, governance across scope, schedule, budget, and risk)

  • Excellent communication skills across technical and non-technical audiences

  • Proven Customer Success capabilities

  • Degree in business, engineering, or a related field

  • Fluent Finnish language skills

  • Must have or be able to get Finnish security clearance

  • Experience with governmental or defense customers

  • Knowledge of hardware, software, or embedded systems development

  • Experience in product development environments

  • Master’s degree in business, engineering, or a relevant field

  • PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification
