jobs.title: Sales Engineer, Missions Business
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights:

  • Role: Sales Engineer

  • Department: Product Management - Missions Line of Business

  • Location: Espoo, Finland (preferred). Remote within the Europe possible.

  • Reports to: Director of Sales Engineering, Missions

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Working type: Hybrid (2-day remote policy)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

The Mission of the Senior Sales Engineer

Enable ICEYE to win mission opportunities by defining, validating, and clearly communicating tailored technical solutions to prospective customers.

You will provide technical leadership in proposals and customer interactions, working at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. You will shape EO mission concepts, craft high-quality responses to institutional and government tenders, and support customer engagements from early discussions through final proposals and contracts, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the tender lifecycle.

Who we are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra-high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring, and finance.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. More than 900 employees share the ambition of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Expected Outcomes

  • Delivered full technical solution for large proposals or institutional tenders (e.g. ESA, EDF EU), on-time and aligned ICEYE offering and buyer expectations.

  • Deliver high-quality technical proposals for mission opportunities, including complete, accurate responses to RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs.

  • Run and integrate mission analyses and simulations (coverage studies, payload performance scenarios, feasibility checks) to validate solutions.

  • Provide timely technical support to Missions Sales throughout the sales cycle, ensuring clear, consistent, and compelling solution narratives.

  • Strengthen customer engagement through well-structured technical presentations, clear communication, and professional handling of clarifications.

  • Be recognized as a reliable contributor within the Missions Sales Engineering team, enabling ICEYE to win critical global mission opportunities.

Core Competencies

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Physics, or a related field

  • 5+ years of experience in sales engineering, bid management, or pre-sales, ideally in a Newspace-sector setting

  • Proven ability to translate complex systems into customer-friendly value propositions, and navigate complexe procurement environments.

Technical & Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of space systems, EO missions, and space mission design

  • Ability to interpret and respond to complex technical requirements and/or statements of work in structured tender formats, and to craft compelling narratives that align ICEYE technology with structured technical requirements.

  • Familiarity with the ESA and EU tendering environment, terminology, and evaluation processes is a plus.

  • Knowledge of SAR and/or multi-sensor ISR (optical, SIGINT) is a plus

Skills & Attributes

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Strong customer focus and problem-solving mindset, with high attention to detail

  • Proactive, accountable, and comfortable working with ambiguity across teams in a fast-paced, global environment

  • Strong team player and collaborator

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (20-30%, plus regular time in Espoo if based remotely).

  • Eligible for national security screening

Key Competencies:

In addition to the requirements above, we evaluate candidates on these key qualities throughout the hiring process:

  • Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.

  • Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.

  • Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Application Process:

  1. Recruiter interview

  2. Hiring Manager interview

  3. Take home task + presentation

  4. Peer interview

  5. VP interview

What We Offer at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you will join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. We know that we will succeed only through exceptional people in our team — which is why your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority.

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. You will benefit from continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a ICEYE is a place where your contributions have a visible impact, and where we celebrate success together.

Benefits:

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes

  • Benefits vary by location. Your recruiter will provide a detailed overview for your specific country during the hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights

  • Title: Engineering Satellite Build Lead

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Department: Space Systems Testing Team, Engineering

  • Reports to: Testing Team Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid per company policy (up to 2 days/week remote); in practice, this hands-on, technical-managerial role requires being onsite at our Valencia office most of the time

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening

Why this role matters

You own the end-to-end build, integration, testing and delivery of the developmental satellites, starting with early preparation and alignment with designers, procurement and operations teams, through the Qualification Model (QM) and Flight Model (FM). You plan the AIT timeline, lead the build team, and keep build documentation, configuration tracking and lessons learned flowing back to designers, so every future unit is faster and easier to build.

This position sits within the Testing Team. It is important to note that this is developmental, prototype satellite work rather than repeat-production integration: requirements are not yet frozen, designs evolve frequently, and the Lead is expected to resolve novel problems rather than execute a fixed procedure.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations, including sovereign and turnkey ISR missions built on ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, alongside access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities let partners detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth, day or night and in any weather, with ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defence, intelligence, security and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Build, integration and delivery ownership (EC, Engineering Configuration)

  • Own end-to-end build, integration, testing and delivery of the R&D satellite system, across QM and FM units

  • Plan all AIT activities and the AIT timeline for R&D build

  • Manage the build team and actively participate in build execution

  • Own build documentation, including build records, configuration tracking (parts traceability) and high-level build procedures

  • Document lessons learned and give structured feedback to designers to improve build efficiency and testability

QM and FM build and system-level testing

  • Plan and own the QM system build and its system qualification activities

  • Own system-level integration and testing of FM satellites, verifying functional performance, capturing any required modifications, and maintaining close traceability to support knowledge transfer to the production line

  • Define system-level test blocks and flows with technical owners, and plan, schedule and coordinate execution of functional tests, SLC, Mock Ops and other required system-level test activities (FM)

  • Across both QM and FM: accountable for test execution readiness and progress, but do not define test cases, test scenarios or test acceptance criteria (owned by Test Engineering / relevant technical owners)

Scope boundaries

  • Does not own unit-level testing or qualification (owned by project leads / technical owners)

  • Does not own documentation updates resulting from future design changes (owned by designers); this role's build documentation, including Production documentation, reflects as-built execution only

  • Does not define system functional requirements or system test definitions, including test cases, scenarios or acceptance criteria (owned by systems engineers / test engineers)

What we're looking for

Must haves:

  • Broad, hands-on technical depth across mechanical, electronics, RF and software domains, with deep expertise in at least one area and the ability to engage effectively and make sound decisions in the others

  • Proven track record planning and executing hardware build, integration and test (AIT) campaigns for complex electromechanical or electronic systems, ideally satellites or other high-reliability aerospace/defence hardware

  • Strong understanding of configuration management and parts traceability, and comfort owning build documentation and build records end to end

  • Experience managing a build or AIT team, including day-to-day task planning and hands-on participation in build execution

  • Ability to plan and hold a realistic AIT schedule across build, qualification (QM) and flight (FM) units, coordinating with test engineering, and systems engineering

  • Systematic, first-principles approach to build and integration problems, comfortable working across mechanical, electrical and software interfaces

  • Clear written and verbal communication, able to turn build lessons learned into structured, actionable feedback for designers

  • Maintain strong interpersonal connections and a collaborative spirit, bringing a steady presence to fast-paced or high-pressure environments.

  • Excel at building positive workplace relationships and navigating high-stress situations with composure and a collaborative mindset.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with SIGINT, SAR or other RF/payload satellite systems

  • Prior people management experience, or clear readiness to grow into a team lead role

  • Familiarity with system-level test activities such as functional tests, SLC (System Level Checks) or Mock Ops

Growth path

This role starts hands-on. In the first phase, you'll share the responsibilities described above with the Testing Team Lead while you build context on our systems, processes and team.

As you grow into the role, you'll take it on more independently, owning AIT planning, build execution and team management end to end. Over time, the role is expected to evolve toward team leadership, potentially leading the build team directly. Even so, you'll stay hands-on with build execution and technical problem-solving rather than moving fully into management.

Application Process

  1. Talent Acquisition screening

  2. Hiring Manager interview

  3. Take-home task and panel interview

  4. (on-site) Technical / systems discussion with the SIGINT Testing Team

  5. (on-site) Behavioural interview to assess cultural fit

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully and think critically. Understand the "why" behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us, we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

Role highlights:

  • IT Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: IT Service & Operations

  • Reports to: IT Support and Assets Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As an IT Engineer you will provide critical IT support and administration for our global workforce, ensuring operational continuity with a specialized focus on endpoint management, access control, and our audiovisual solutions.

As a key member of our global IT team, your primary function is to support our worldwide operations. You will be responsible for ensuring the reliability of our daily IT systems, operating and maintaining our AV and meeting room solutions, and assisting users globally. You will have previous IT experience and be capable of handling a variety of technical challenges within our established systems.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

  • VIP & Executive Support: Act as a trusted point of contact for VIP and executive support requests, providing rapid response times and prioritized resolution to keep leadership productive and business-critical activities uninterrupted.

  • Maintain Secure Communications Uptime: Operate, support, and troubleshoot our secure communications platforms and associated endpoint configurations to ensure continuous, encrypted, and reliable communication for critical operations.

  • Meeting & AV Solutions: Operate, support, and troubleshoot our meeting room and audiovisual (AV) solutions to ensure reliable, high-quality collaboration for local and global meetings.

  • Endpoint & Lifecycle Operations: Execute device provisioning workflows, apply standard MDM configurations, and ensure patching compliance across our hardware fleet (Windows, macOS, Linux) using established procedures.

  • Identity & Access Management (IAM): Administer daily user access, SSO assignments, and permissions management for local and global operations, primarily utilizing Okta.

  • Site Documentation: Create and maintain clear operational documentation for secure communications procedures, MDM configurations, and common issue resolutions.

Must haves:

  • Previous experience in a hands-on IT support, systems administration, or IT engineering role.

  • Familiarity with identity and access management (IAM) platforms; specific experience with Okta is highly desirable.

  • Good understanding of networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, switching, VPNs) and experience troubleshooting secure network connectivity issues.

  • Experience working with an enterprise IT Service Desk ticketing system.

  • Ability to handle VIP support requests with urgency, discretion, and a strong service mindset, delivering speedy response times under pressure.

  • Ability to manage daily operational priorities and communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with ITSM tools such as Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or Freshservice, including working to SLAs.

  • ITIL Foundation certification or a good understanding of ITIL practices (incident, request, and problem management).

  • Experience running onboarding and offboarding for new and departing employees, including hardware setup and account handover.

  • Hands-on experience with hardware troubleshooting, repairs, and managing IT asset inventory.

  • TA Screen (30 mins)

  • Interview with hiring manager (60mins)

  • Interview with Stakeholder team (30 min)

  • Large-scale data processing for imagery (Dask, Ray, Spark, object storage).

  • Location: Berlin, Germany

  • Department: ISR Analytics

Our products run in secure, sovereign environments. We develop in the cloud for convenience, but customers run the product on their own servers, often in air-gapped networks.

This role is not about keeping one system running and tuning it. Here, every environment is temporary: you build the automation that creates, ships, upgrades and tears down complete deployments, reliably and repeatably, in places with no internet access. You work inside the product team, not beside it, and many of your changes will touch the application codebase.

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

  • Build and own the automation that packages our product and deploys it to on-prem and air-gapped customer environments.

  • Write tooling (mostly Python) that fills the gaps between off-the-shelf tools, rather than only configuring them.

  • Provision and manage infrastructure from bare metal and hypervisors up to Kubernetes, and make it reproducible from code.

  • Keep cloud development environments fast and disposable, so engineers can spin up a full stack on demand.

  • Build CI/CD pipelines that produce signed, versioned, offline-installable releases.

  • Set up observability that works when nobody can reach the system from outside.

  • Spot what the team needs next and raise it, without waiting to be asked.

Must haves:

  • Senior hands-on engineer (not an engineering manager or architect role).

  • Strong experience building infrastructure and deployment automation, not only operating existing systems.

  • Solid coding skills in Python, or deep experience in another language (for example Go) and willingness to work in Python.

  • Daily use of AI tools in engineering work, beyond chat: generating and reviewing code, configuration and tests (for example Claude Code, Cursor).

  • High autonomy: you find problems, propose fixes and drive them through.

  • Motivation to work in new defense: building technology used by defense forces.

 

Nice to haves:

  • On-prem or datacenter experience: bootstrapping servers, virtualization (VMware, Proxmox), storage and networking, not just public cloud.

  • Delivered to air-gapped or otherwise restricted environments.

  • Release engineering: shipping a packaged product to many customer environments on a fixed schedule.

  • Built internal tools and automation used by other engineers (a CLI, an operator, a provisioning service).

  • Operated PostgreSQL in production (upgrades, backups, migrations); PostGIS a plus.

  • Strong IC track record in a startup or a fast-changing company launching new products.

  • Comfortable in an environment where process and requirements change often and are not always fully defined.

  • Clear communicator who works well with experienced, opinionated engineers.

    • Continuous Improvement: Contributing to continuous improvement to promote the efficiency and effectiveness of the team’s mission.

    • Ensures ground segment systems reliably deliver satellite data and imagery to Mission customers.

    • Maintains uninterrupted operations by proactively supporting and upgrading customer on-premise environments.

    • Rapidly resolves technical issues to minimize downtime and protect mission-critical services.

    • Builds trust with customers through responsive technical support and seamless deployments.

    • Drives continuous improvement by collaborating across teams and refining operational processes.

Technical Expertise: A strong dual foundation in both software development and DevOps principles, at least 5 years of professional experience with a focus on deployment, configuration, and operational management of software services, particularly within Kubernetes. Role highlights:

  • Rotational Product Manager

  • Location: Espoo, Finland, with frequent travel

  • Working type: Hybrid (3 days / in office per week)

  • Department: Product Management

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role is different

ICEYE's Rotational Product Manager program develops early-career talent into product leaders in the space industry. You don't need product management experience to apply. We're looking for people with an outstanding academic record, ideally in a technical field, and a track record of standing out at work, who are deeply curious and learn fast.

Over 24 months, you'll work in two product teams on our hardware or software products. In each one, you'll own a product end to end, from understanding the customer's problem to deciding what gets built and shipping it. Your work will shape how our customers use satellite data to make decisions that matter.

A senior product leader will mentor you through each rotation, and you'll go through the program with a cohort of peers. You'll work closely with engineers, scientists and senior leaders, and you'll travel to meet customers and our local teams, working on some of their toughest problems.

This program is fast and demanding, and it will stretch you. It may also be the most rewarding experience of your early career. When the program ends, you will have the opportunity to move into a permanent product manager role, or to explore roles in other domains at ICEYE.

Spots are limited, and we review applications on a rolling basis, so apply today!

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own the roadmap for a product area in each rotation, and decide what the team builds next and why

  • Talk to customers, users and internal experts to understand their problems, and turn what you learn into clear requirements

  • Work with engineers and designers from defining a problem through to shipping and measuring the result

  • Use data to set priorities and make decisions, and explain the tradeoffs behind them

  • Work with sales, solutions, operations and other teams to get what you build into customers’ hands

  • Present your findings and plans to your team and to product leadership

  • Learn the technical domain of each team, from satellites and ground systems to the software customers run

Must haves:

  • An outstanding academic record, ideally in a technical field such as engineering, computer science or physics

  • Technical work experience through internships or a first full-time role, where you stood out

  • You can break down a problem, design an analysis and test your assumptions with data

  • You learn fast and are comfortable digging into how complex systems work with engineers

  • You take ownership and can move a team forward without formal authority

  • Fluent written and spoken English, and happy to travel frequently

Nice to haves:

  • Business exposure, for example an internship or short role in consulting, a startup or a product team

  • Some exposure to product work, for example as an engineer, analyst or designer working closely with a product team

  • Experience with SQL, Python or other data tools

  • Interest in space, defence or other mission-critical industries

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights

  • Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Supply Chain

  • Reports to: Engineering Operations Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office/On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

 
 

The Mission of the Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

As our Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics), you'll join our fast-moving Global Supply Chain organization and work closely with our hardware engineering teams as they design and build electronic systems on tight and shifting timelines.

You'll be an active part of our engineering projects, helping to execute them and staying ahead of supply. That means identifying long lead items and critical components as early as possible in the process, and securing them before they become bottlenecks for testing and builds. When lead times, allocation or a late design change threaten a prototype schedule, we need you to act. Our development cycles are fast and iterations are constantly occurring since we thrive on pushing the technology for the best.

You'll also be a key link between Engineering and Production. You'll communicate R&D supply chain risks and the critical components you've identified to Production, so nothing comes as a surprise at handover. Your work supports the success of every engineering prototype iteration and at the same time prepares Production for rollout and mass production.

This role suits someone who is proactive by nature, with a solution driven mindset and a deep understanding of electronics, PCB manufacturing and hardware prototyping, who is comfortable with ambiguity and acts before problems arrive rather than waiting for them. How quickly we get from concept to working hardware in orbit, and then into production, depends on how well this role is done.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 
 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

High-Velocity Engineering Support

  • Serve as the hands-on supply chain counterpart for fast-paced electronics engineering teams working on multiple, rapidly evolving hardware projects.

  • Be an active member of engineering project teams from kick-off, helping to execute the project plan and reviewing draft BOMs while the design can still be changed.

  • Identify long lead items and critical components as early as possible, and secure them proactively (early orders, allocation, buffer stock) before they can delay a project.

  • Translate early-stage concepts, evolving BOMs, and mid-design changes into actionable sourcing steps with minimal delay.

  • Advise engineers, in real time and in early design reviews, on how component choices affect availability, alternates, obsolescence, cost and lead time.

  • Identify supply issues before they become blockers and propose workaround paths immediately.

Rapid Sourcing & Procurement Execution

  • Own sourcing and procurement of electronic components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, connectors, harness, sensors, RF parts, embedded modules.

  • Run fast quoting and supplier selection so prototype and builds get their boards and parts on the dates engineering committed to.

  • Lead efforts to find alternative components or new supply paths within hours, not weeks, when shortages occur.

  • Set stock levels and material availability plans for development and prototype builds.

Supplier Interaction & Technical Engagement

  • Own relationships with PCB fabricators, electronics manufacturing partners and component distributors, and work with them to understand lead time constraints, manufacturing capabilities, DFM implications and fast-track build options.

  • Support technical capability assessments of PCB/PCBA vendors, machining partners, and component distributors.

  • Negotiate priority build slots, allocation and expedited shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.

Cross-Functional Start-Up Collaboration

  • Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, program management, and operations to remove obstacles and maintain build readiness.

  • Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.

  • Operate with a bias for action: if something is unclear, you chase it; if something breaks, you fix it; if something is missing, you find it.

Agility, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain a living view of supply risks across all active prjects, including obsolescence, allocation, single-source parts, counterfeit risk and export restrictions and qualify alternatives early.

  • Keep purchasing accurate in the ERP system, with clean traceability, cost visibility and build readiness status that the organisation can rely on, even under fast-moving conditions.

  • Bring an experimentation mindset: test new suppliers, new sourcing channels, new manufacturing partners, and new tools to reduce lead times and cost.

R&D to Production Readiness

  • Communicate R&D supply chain risks and identified critical components to Production early and clearly, so they are known well before handover.

  • Support the success and rapid iteration of engineering prototypes while preparing Production for rollout and mass production.

  • Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

  • Help build the sourcing foundations that will carry a design from prototype into repeatable production.

What we’re looking for


Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Supply Chain, or similar.

  • 5+ years of direct experience in electronics sourcing, component procurement or engineering supply chain roles in fast-moving hardware environments.

  • Strong technical understanding of semiconductors, passive components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, embedded electronics, and prototyping flows.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions, tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience interpreting electronic schematics, BOMs, AVL requirements, PCB stackups, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions: tight deadlines, shifting priorities, incomplete information, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience running purchasing and material management through an ERP system.

  • Confident negotiator, commercially and technically, able to influence engineers, program managers and suppliers without formal authority.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

Nice to haves:

  • Engineering Electronics Background, knowledge of the tools and technical understanding/background of designs.

  • Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

  • Exposure to taking a hardware design from prototype into series production.

  • Existing relationships with PCB/PCBA vendors, distributors and electronics manufacturing partners.

  • Certifications (APICS, PMP, Six Sigma) useful but not required.

  • Familiarity with rapid-prototyping suppliers, global component marketplaces, and digital sourcing tools.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

 - Negotiate priority build slots, allocation and expedited shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.
   


CROSS-FUNCTIONAL START-UP COLLABORATION

 - Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, program management, and operations to remove obstacles and maintain build readiness.
   

 - Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.
   

 - Operate with a bias for action: if something is unclear, you chase it; if something breaks, you fix it; if something is missing, you find it.
   


AGILITY, RISK MANAGEMENT & CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT

 - Build and maintain a living view of supply risks across all active prjects, including obsolescence, allocation, single-source parts, counterfeit risk and export restrictions and qualify alternatives early.
   

 - Keep purchasing accurate in the ERP system, with clean traceability, cost visibility and build readiness status that the organisation can rely on, even under fast-moving conditions.
   

 - Bring an experimentation mindset: test new suppliers, new sourcing channels, new manufacturing partners, and new tools to reduce lead times and cost.


R&D TO PRODUCTION READINESS

 - Communicate R&D supply chain risks and identified critical components to Production early and clearly, so they are known well before handover.
   

 - Support the success and rapid iteration of engineering prototypes while preparing Production for rollout and mass production.
   

 - Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

 - Help build the sourcing foundations that will carry a design from prototype into repeatable production.




WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



MUST HAVES:



 - Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Supply Chain, or similar.
   

 - 5+ years of direct experience in electronics sourcing, component procurement or engineering supply chain roles in fast-moving hardware environments.
   

 - Strong technical understanding of semiconductors, passive components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, embedded electronics, and prototyping flows.
   

 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions, tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and rapid cycles.
   

 - Hands-on experience interpreting electronic schematics, BOMs, AVL requirements, PCB stackups, and manufacturing documentation.
   

 - Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions: tight deadlines, shifting priorities, incomplete information, and rapid cycles.
   

 - Hands-on experience running purchasing and material management through an ERP system.
   

 - Confident negotiator, commercially and technically, able to influence engineers, program managers and suppliers without formal authority.
   

 - Professional English, written and spoken.
   


NICE TO HAVES:

 - Engineering Electronics Background, knowledge of the tools and technical understanding/background of designs.

 - Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

 - Exposure to taking a hardware design from prototype into series production.
   

 - Existing relationships with PCB/PCBA vendors, distributors and electronics manufacturing partners.
   

 - Certifications (APICS, PMP, Six Sigma) useful but not required.
   

 - Familiarity with rapid-prototyping suppliers, global component marketplaces, and digital sourcing tools.

 - Hiring Manager interview

 - Task Stage

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer, Missions Business
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Role: Senior Sales Engineer

  • Department: Product Management - Missions Line of Business

  • Location: Espoo, Finland (preferred). Remote within the Europe possible.

  • Reports to: Director of Sales Engineering, Missions

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Working type: Hybrid (2-day remote policy)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO)

The Mission of the Senior Sales Engineer

Enable ICEYE to win mission opportunities by defining, validating, and clearly communicating tailored technical solutions to prospective customers.

You will provide technical leadership in proposals and customer interactions, working at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering. You will shape EO mission concepts, craft high-quality responses to institutional and government tenders, and support customer engagements from early discussions through final proposals and contracts, acting as a trusted technical advisor throughout the tender lifecycle.

Who we are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra-high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring, and finance.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. More than 900 employees share the ambition of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Expected Outcomes

  • Lead full technical solution for large proposals or institutional tenders (e.g. ESA, EDF EU), on-time and aligned ICEYE offering and buyer expectations.

  • Deliver high-quality technical proposals for mission opportunities, including complete, accurate responses to RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs.

  • Run and integrate mission analyses and simulations (coverage studies, payload performance scenarios, feasibility checks) to validate solutions.

  • Provide timely technical support to Missions Sales throughout the sales cycle, ensuring clear, consistent, and compelling solution narratives.

  • Strengthen customer engagement through well-structured technical presentations, clear communication, and professional handling of clarifications.

  • Be recognised by Sales and BD as a go-to technical voice for institutional and complexe defence customers.

  • Raise proposal quality across the team through technical review and mentoring, and upskill sales teams through technical training.

Core Competencies

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Engineering, Aerospace, Physics, or a related field

  • 8+ years of experience in sales engineering, bid management, or pre-sales, ideally in a Newspace-sector setting

  • Proven ability to translate complex systems into customer-friendly value propositions, and navigate complexe procurement environments.

  • Track record of leading technical volumes end-to-end on multi-partner bids.

Technical & Industry Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of space systems, EO missions, and space mission design

  • Ability to interpret and respond to complex technical requirements and/or statements of work in structured tender formats, and to craft compelling narratives that align ICEYE technology with structured technical requirements.

  • Familiarity with the ESA and EU tendering environment, terminology, and evaluation processes is a plus.

  • Knowledge of SAR and/or multi-sensor ISR (optical, SIGINT) is a plus

Skills & Attributes

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

  • Strong customer focus and problem-solving mindset, with high attention to detail

  • Proactive, accountable, and comfortable working with ambiguity across teams in a fast-paced, global environment

  • Strong team player and collaborator

  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (20-30%, plus regular time in Espoo if based remotely).

  • Eligible for national security screening

Key Competencies:

In addition to the requirements above, we evaluate candidates on these key qualities throughout the hiring process:

  • Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.

  • Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.

  • Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.

  • Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.

  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Application Process:

  1. Recruiter interview

  2. Hiring Manager interview

  3. Take home task + presentation

  4. Peer interview

  5. VP interview

What We Offer at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you will join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. We know that we will succeed only through exceptional people in our team — which is why your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority.

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. You will benefit from continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a ICEYE is a place where your contributions have a visible impact, and where we celebrate success together.

Benefits:

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes

  • Benefits vary by location. Your recruiter will provide a detailed overview for your specific country during the hiring process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, we believe that diversity isn't just a buzzword – it's our greatest asset.

We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. We know that diverse perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we actively seek out individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and experiences.

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. Join us and be part of a team where differences are not only embraced but cherished, because together, we're stronger.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, including those who may need workplace adjustments. If you require any specific accommodations or assistance during the recruitment process for any reason, please let us know.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Simulation and Modeling
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Software Engineer, Simulation and Modeling

  • Location: Valencia

  • Reports to: Reports to: Laboratory Lead & Test Architect

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Software Engineer, Simulation and Modeling, you’ll build the software world the satellites live in (orbits, emitters, signals, truth and scoring) so the whole team can ask “what if” and get a number back. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.

Customers and our own engineers ask questions we currently answer by hand-waving: what revisit a cluster gives over an area, how many emitters we detect in a crowded scene, how geolocation accuracy moves with cluster spacing or timing error, and what a next-generation architecture choice buys. The answers need a simulation framework that models the constellation and the emitters end to end, generates the signals each satellite would see, and scores what comes out against a known truth. It doesn’t exist yet. You’ll build it, and it will become a tool used by engineers, analysts and customer-facing staff.

You’ll work daily with the lab, signal processing and ground segment teams, and you’ll have direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Model the constellation: orbit propagation, cluster geometry, attitude and pointing, antenna beams, access and contact windows, with spacing and timing as swept variables.

  • Model the emitters and the theatre: emitters as state machines with real antenna patterns, scan behaviour, modes and duty cycles, placed at order-of-battle density. Start from the lab’s real captures and extend synthetically.

  • Generate the signals: propagation and link modelling (path loss, delay, Doppler, ionosphere in the low band) and synthetic I/Q per satellite, at a fidelity the RF hardware and the processing chain can consume.

  • Own the truth together with the processing team: a truth ledger of every simulated emission, position and time, kept out of reach of the system under test, plus the association and scoring that turn a run into detection rate, false-alarm rate, geolocation accuracy and latency.

  • Drive the hardware together with the RF team: provide the geometry and timing the channel simulator and playback hardware need, so a recorded radar can be heard by three simulated satellites with the right delays and Doppler.

  • Make it a platform: versioned scenarios, seeded and reproducible runs, provenance on every result, tests, CI, documentation and an interface that non-authors can use.

  • Answer real questions: capacity, revisit and performance studies for the payload, product and sales teams, and architecture trades for future generations.


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Strong software engineering in Python (and ideally a compiled language): clean architecture, version control, testing, code review, packaging

  • Experience building a simulation or model of a physical system that others used, and validating it against measurement or real data

  • Numerical and scientific computing: NumPy/SciPy or equivalent, vectorisation, performance awareness

  • Working knowledge of at least one of orbital mechanics and access computation, RF link budgets and propagation, or signal processing

  • Habits that make results reproducible: seeds, configuration management, data provenance

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

  • Constellation, mission or system-level modeling and simulation (STK, Orekit, GMAT, Basilisk or in-house)

  • Radar, EW or emitter modeling; scenario or order-of-battle generation

  • TDOA/FDOA/AoA geolocation or estimation theory

  • Synthetic I/Q generation, GPU acceleration, or real-time and hardware-in-the-loop interfaces

  • Cloud-native deployment, containers, workflow orchestration, and data stores for large runs

  • A simulation framework of yours that outlived your involvement in it

  • Eligibility for national security clearance (an advantage)

What success looks like:

  • 6 months: a first end-to-end scenario (cluster geometry, a handful of emitters, synthetic I/Q per satellite, truth logged, a first score) is used to answer at least one real capacity or performance question.

  • 12 months: a reproducible, documented framework runs without you on the team; geometry drives the RF channel simulator; real captures enter scenarios alongside synthetic emitters.

  • 24 months: the simulation is part of the end-to-end loop with the flatsat and ground pipeline, runs in regression, and backs performance numbers we put in front of customers.

Application Process

  • Application Screening

  • TA call

  • Hiring Manager call

  • Onsite interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights

  • Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Mechanical)

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Supply Chain

  • Reports to: R&D Supply Chain Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office/On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

 
 

The Mission of the Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Mechanical)

As our Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Mechanical), you'll join our fast-moving Global Supply Chain organization and work closely with our hardware engineering teams as they design and build mechanical systems and structures on tight and shifting timelines.

You'll be an active part of our engineering projects, helping to execute them and staying ahead of supply. That means identifying long lead items, critical materials and complex parts as early as possible in the process, and securing them before they become bottlenecks for testing and builds. When machining capacity, material availability, special process queues or a late design change threaten a prototype schedule, we need you to act. Our development cycles are fast and iterations are constantly occurring since we thrive on pushing the technology for the best.

You'll also be a key link between Engineering and Production. You'll communicate R&D supply chain risks and the critical parts and materials you've identified to Production, so nothing comes as a surprise at handover. Your work supports the success of every engineering prototype iteration and at the same time prepares Production for rollout and mass production.

This role suits someone who is proactive by nature, with a solution driven mindset and a deep understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes, materials and hardware prototyping, who is comfortable with ambiguity and acts before problems arrive rather than waiting for them. How quickly we get from concept to working hardware in orbit, and then into production, depends on how well this role is done.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 
 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

High-Velocity Engineering Support

  • Serve as the hands-on supply chain counterpart for fast-paced mechanical engineering teams working on multiple, rapidly evolving hardware projects.

  • Identify long lead items, critical raw materials and complex parts as early as possible, and secure them proactively (early orders, material reservation, capacity booking, buffer stock, coating readiness, securing helicoils) before they can delay a project.

  • Translate early-stage concepts, evolving BOMs, and mid-design changes into actionable sourcing steps with minimal delay.

  • Provide engineers with real-time insights on material availability, components availability and quick-turn manufacturing options.

  • Identify supply issues before they become blockers and propose workaround paths immediately.

Rapid Sourcing & Procurement Execution

  • Own project procurement of CNC machined parts, structural elements and composite parts, mechanisms, motors, fasteners, bearings, thermal hardware and raw materials, including related special processes such as heat treatment, surface treatments and coatings.

  • Run fast quoting and supplier selection so prototype and builds get their parts and materials on the dates engineering committed to.

  • Lead efforts to find alternative suppliers, processes or materials within hours, not weeks, when capacity or material shortages occur.

  • Set stock levels and material availability plans for development and prototype builds.

Supplier Interaction & Technical Engagement

  • Worked closely with machine shops and composite fabricators, special process providers and material distributors, and worked with them to understand lead time constraints, manufacturing capabilities, DFM implications and fast-track build options.

  • Support technical capability assessments of machining, special process suppliers, and material distributors.

  • Negotiate priority machine time, expedited processing and shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.

Cross-Functional Start-Up Collaboration

  • Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, program management, and operations to remove obstacles and maintain build readiness.

  • Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.

  • Operate with a bias for action: if something is unclear, you chase it; if something breaks, you fix it; if something is missing, you find it.

Agility, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain a living view of supply risks across all active projects, including capacity constraints, raw material availability, single-source suppliers, special process bottlenecks and export restrictions and qualify alternatives early.

  • Keep purchasing details accurate in the ERP system, with clean traceability and build readiness status that the organisation can rely on, even under fast-moving conditions.

  • Bring an experimentation mindset: test new suppliers, new sourcing channels, new manufacturing partners, and new tools to reduce lead times and cost.

R&D to Production Readiness

  • Communicate R&D supply chain risks and identified critical parts and materials to Production early and clearly, so they are known well before handover.

  • Support the success and rapid iteration of engineering prototypes while preparing Production for rollout and mass production.

  • Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and special processes, and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

  • Help build the sourcing foundations that will carry a design from prototype into repeatable production.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of direct experience in mechanical sourcing, procurement or engineering supply chain roles in fast-moving hardware environments.

  • Strong procurement understanding of machined and composites parts, special processes, engineering materials and prototyping flows.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions: tight deadlines, shifting priorities, incomplete information, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience running purchasing and material management through an ERP system.

  • Confident negotiator, commercially and technically, able to influence engineers, program managers and suppliers without formal authority.

  • Strong communication, problem-solving, and negotiation abilities.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

  • Engineering Mechanical Background, knowledge of the tools (such as CAD) and technical understanding/background of designs.

  • Exposure to taking a hardware design from prototype into series production.

  • Existing relationships with machine shops, fabricators, special process providers and material distributors. Familiarity with rapid-prototyping suppliers and global component marketplaces

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

jobs.title: RF Test Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • RF Test Engineer

  • Location: Valencia

  • Reports to: Laboratory Lead & Test Architect

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As an RF Test Engineer, you’ll capture real signals from real hardware and build the system that plays them back through a channel simulator. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.

Our processing, on the ground today and on board from Gen 2, is only as good as the signals we test it against. Today we have some synthetic I/Q, a few captures and a lot of assumptions. You’ll help us build a library of real emitter signals with known truth, plus a way to replay them as a satellite would hear them, with LEO Doppler, delay, path loss and interference, coherently across several satellites at once.

You’ll be one of the first engineers in the lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Capture real emissions: bring emitters into the lab (marine radars, AIS and ADS-B transponders, satcom terminals, partner-supplied equipment), operate them in a controlled, screened setup, and record them at the right bandwidth, dynamic range and timing accuracy. Extend this to field and airborne collection.

  • Characterise captures: turn raw recordings into library entries with I/Q in a documented format (SigMF or equivalent), measured parameters (PRI, pulse width, scan, chirp, hopping, modulation), metadata and truth, so someone who wasn’t there can reuse them.

  • Build the generate and playback chain: specify, integrate and calibrate the RF record and playback system (SDRs, vector signal generators, arbitrary waveform generators and multi-channel playback), from a single emitter up to a dense scene.

  • Build the channel simulator path: apply per-satellite delay, Doppler, Doppler rate, path loss, multipath and interference to recorded and synthetic signals, phase-coherently across channels and driven by geometry from the simulation software.

  • Support campaigns in the field and in the air, customer and partner demonstrations, and the reproduction of on-orbit anomalies on the ground.

  • Run the lab safely: RF safety, ESD, equipment handling, access control and the handling rules for controlled material.

jobs.title: Software AIT Engineer - Japan
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Software AIT Engineer - Japan

  • Team: Global Manufacturing Organization – AIT Engineering

  • Location: Tokyo, Japan

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

 
 

Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, revolutionizing Earth observation with real-time, all-weather, day-and-night imaging. As the owner and operator of the world's largest SAR satellite constellation, we provide critical insights that empower industries like defense, maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance to make informed decisions.

Headquartered in Finland and operating internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US, our diverse team of more than 900 experts from nearly 60 countries shares a bold mission: to enhance life on Earth by delivering reliable, data-driven solutions. At ICEYE, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and collaboration, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in space technology to solve the world's toughest challenges.

 
 

Why Join ICEYE?

At ICEYE, we're not just launching satellites — we're redefining what's possible with SAR technology. Join a team of passionate innovators solving real-world challenges and making a tangible impact. We foster a dynamic and inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly matter. With continuous learning opportunities, cutting-edge projects, and collaboration with industry-leading experts, you'll have the chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of Earth Observation.

 
 

What will you do in this role?

ICEYE is seeking a Software AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) Engineer to build the test software backbone of our satellite production in Japan. You will design and develop, from scratch, the test framework used by all AIT activities, own the simulators that enable hardware-in-the-loop testing, and debug flight software behavior during integration. Working closely with Electrical and Mechanical AIT engineers, you will turn manual procedures into automated, repeatable test sequences and give the team the data and dashboards they need to verify every spacecraft. The framework you build is intended to become the reference for ICEYE AIT globally.

 
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and maintain the AIT test framework from scratch, including architecture, test execution, sequencing, logging and result reporting

  • Define the software stack, tooling and development practices for AIT test software (version control, code review, CI/CD, testing of the test code itself)

  • Develop and own satellite and subsystem simulators used for hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop testing

  • Debug flight software behavior during integration and test, including on-board software loading, telemetry and telecommand anomalies, and OBC-driven subsystem responses, coordinating with Flight Software Engineering on root cause and fixes

  • Build data pipelines from test equipment and satellite telemetry into InfluxDB, and create Grafana dashboards for test monitoring, trending and system health

  • Support Electrical and Mechanical AIT engineers by turning their test procedures into automated, repeatable test sequences and providing tools for their test campaigns

  • Ensure the framework is designed for global reuse: documented, modular, and adoptable by AIT teams in other ICEYE sites

  • Contribute to production readiness and design reviews (PRR, CDR) by providing feedback on software testability, simulator and test automation requirements

  • Interface with Global AIT, Flight Software Engineering, Ground Software and Mission Operations teams to ensure alignment on test standards, interfaces and lessons learned

     

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on test automation, test frameworks or tooling for hardware systems, preferably in aerospace, automotive, robotics or other high-reliability industries

  • Strong proficiency in Python, including designing maintainable, modular software architectures (not only scripting)

  • Experience building or significantly extending a test automation framework from the ground up

  • Experience testing embedded systems or hardware, including communication protocols and interfaces (e.g. UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet)

  • Experience debugging embedded or real-time software in a hardware context

  • Solid software engineering practices: Git, code review, CI/CD, unit and integration testing

  • Experience with time-series data and visualization (InfluxDB, Grafana or similar)

  • Proficient English (written and spoken) for cross-functional collaboration

 
 

Nice to Have

  • Experience with spacecraft software or ground segment tools (e.g. CCSDS / PUS telemetry and telecommand, YAMCS, OpenC3 COSMOS)

  • Experience developing simulators or digital twins for hardware-in-the-loop testing

  • Experience with instrument control and EGSE automation (SCPI, VISA, programmable power supplies, data acquisition)

  • Knowledge of C or C++ for reading and debugging embedded flight software

  • Experience with Linux, Docker and infrastructure as code

  • Experience with Atlassian Cloud tools (Jira, Confluence)

  • Proficient Japanese (written and spoken)

 
 

What's In It for You?

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach.

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment.

  • Health insurance.

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes.

  • Relocation support, where applicable (e.g., flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support).

  • Inspiring, collaborative offices and silent workspaces that enable you to focus.

 
 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value — it's our greatest strength. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. Diverse perspectives drive innovation and creativity, so we actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.

No matter your background, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to the team. Join us and be part of a workplace where differences are embraced and valued, because together, we're stronger. Apply now to begin your ICEYE journey and help us make the impossible possible. Learn more about ICEYE and life at our company at iceye.com.

Ready to launch your career? Apply now and help us build the future of Space Tech! 🚀
