As the owner and operator of the world's largest SAR satellite constellation, we provide critical insights that empower industries like defense, maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance to make informed decisions.

Headquartered in Finland and operating internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US, our diverse team of more than 900 experts from nearly 60 countries shares a bold mission: to enhance life on Earth by delivering reliable, data-driven solutions. At ICEYE, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and collaboration, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in space technology to solve the world's toughest challenges.

 
 


WHY JOIN ICEYE?

At ICEYE, we're not just launching satellites — we're redefining what's possible with SAR technology. Join a team of passionate innovators solving real-world challenges and making a tangible impact. We foster a dynamic and inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly matter. With continuous learning opportunities, cutting-edge projects, and collaboration with industry-leading experts, you'll have the chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of Earth Observation.

 
 


WHAT WILL YOU DO IN THIS ROLE?

ICEYE is seeking a Software AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) Engineer to build the test software backbone of our satellite production in Japan. You will design and develop, from scratch, the test framework used by all AIT activities, own the simulators that enable hardware-in-the-loop testing, and debug flight software behavior during integration. Working closely with Electrical and Mechanical AIT engineers, you will turn manual procedures into automated, repeatable test sequences and give the team the data and dashboards they need to verify every spacecraft. The framework you build is intended to become the reference for ICEYE AIT globally.

 
 


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Design, develop and maintain the AIT test framework from scratch, including architecture, test execution, sequencing, logging and result reporting

 - Define the software stack, tooling and development practices for AIT test software (version control, code review, CI/CD, testing of the test code itself)

 - Develop and own satellite and subsystem simulators used for hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop testing

 - Debug flight software behavior during integration and test, including on-board software loading, telemetry and telecommand anomalies, and OBC-driven subsystem responses, coordinating with Flight Software Engineering on root cause and fixes

 - Build data pipelines from test equipment and satellite telemetry into InfluxDB, and create Grafana dashboards for test monitoring, trending and system health

 - Support Electrical and Mechanical AIT engineers by turning their test procedures into automated, repeatable test sequences and providing tools for their test campaigns

 - Ensure the framework is designed for global reuse: documented, modular, and adoptable by AIT teams in other ICEYE sites

 - Contribute to production readiness and design reviews (PRR, CDR) by providing feedback on software testability, simulator and test automation requirements

 - Interface with Global AIT, Flight Software Engineering, Ground Software and Mission Operations teams to ensure alignment on test standards, interfaces and lessons learned
   
    


REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of professional software development experience, with a focus on test automation, test frameworks or tooling for hardware systems, preferably in aerospace, automotive, robotics or other high-reliability industries

 - Strong proficiency in Python, including designing maintainable, modular software architectures (not only scripting)

 - Experience building or significantly extending a test automation framework from the ground up

 - Experience testing embedded systems or hardware, including communication protocols and interfaces (e.g. UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet)

 - Experience debugging embedded or real-time software in a hardware context

 - Solid software engineering practices: Git, code review, CI/CD, unit and integration testing

 - Experience with time-series data and visualization (InfluxDB, Grafana or similar)

 - Proficient English (written and spoken) for cross-functional collaboration

 
 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience with spacecraft software or ground segment tools (e.g. CCSDS / PUS telemetry and telecommand, YAMCS, OpenC3 COSMOS)

 - Experience developing simulators or digital twins for hardware-in-the-loop testing

 - Experience with instrument control and EGSE automation (SCPI, VISA, programmable power supplies, data acquisition)

 - Knowledge of C or C++ for reading and debugging embedded flight software

 - Experience with Linux, Docker and infrastructure as code

 - Experience with Atlassian Cloud tools (Jira, Confluence)

 - Proficient Japanese (written and spoken)

 
 


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

 - A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach.

 - An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment.

 - Health insurance.

 - Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes.

 - Relocation support, where applicable (e.g., flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support).

 - Inspiring, collaborative offices and silent workspaces that enable you to focus.

 
 


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value — it's our greatest strength. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. Diverse perspectives drive innovation and creativity, so we actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.

No matter your background, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to the team. Join us and be part of a workplace where differences are embraced and valued, because together, we're stronger. Apply now to begin your ICEYE journey and help us make the impossible possible. Learn more about ICEYE and life at our company at iceye.com http://iceye.com.

Ready to launch your career? Apply now and help us build the future of Space Tech! 🚀

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • RF Test Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Spacecraft Hardware

  • Reports to: Electronics and RF Test Team Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site / Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

In this role, you will play a key part in supporting the company's continued growth as we expand our Engineering team. We are looking for an RF Test Engineer to join our office in Espoo. In this position, you will be responsible for supporting the qualification of new satellite hardware, developing test equipment, and contributing to the Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) activities for next-generation satellite platforms.


Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Develop qualification plans that verify our latest RADAR components, along with other RF-related satellite hardware, against their design requirements.

  • Prepare and maintain documentation for internal reviews, including test procedures, test reports, assembly procedures, and other supporting records.

  • Carry out a wide range of qualification tests.

  • Analyze test data, investigate the root cause of any failures, and present findings to key stakeholders.

  • Give clear, actionable feedback to the design teams.

  • Design and build EGSE, data acquisition systems, and custom test hardware and software.

  • Support the transition of new hardware components into production.


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • BSc/MSc in Telecommunications Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field

  • 3+ years of experience in testing, test automation, electronics, and RF

  • Background as an RF test engineer and/or RF design engineer

  • Hands-on experience testing custom electronics systems with a wide range of lab equipment, such as digital oscilloscopes, vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, RF signal generators, RF power sensors, and thermal chambers

  • Proven experience performing root-cause analysis on failures

  • A positive attitude and a drive to learn new things

  • Ability to thrive in a multicultural environment

  • Strong written and spoken English

Nice to haves:

  • Aerospace industry experience

  • Hands on experience in satellite assembly

  • Experience with linux operating systems

  • Experience in programming with python

  • PCB design with Altium or a similar electronics design (EDA) tool.

  • Experience with revision control tools (like Git or SVN)


Application Process

  • Recruiter screening

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Technical task

  • Technical panel interview

  • Director interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Senior Smart Manufacturing Engineer, Electronics

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organization, Smart Manufacturing Engineering

  • Reports to: Team Lead, Smart Manufacturing Engineering

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Senior Smart Manufacturing Engineer, Electronics, you’ll own the test systems that every ICEYE satellite passes through before it reaches orbit. You’ll design and standardize the production and integration test equipment used across our manufacturing sites, find the bottlenecks that would otherwise cap how fast we can scale, and set the technical standard for the engineers around you. This is a hands-on design role with organization-wide influence: what you build and document becomes how we manufacture.

Who We Are
ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.



Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Design, build and own the production and integration test systems used on the line, including the electrical ground support equipment.

  • Drive standardization of test equipment across products and sites, so designs and interfaces are reused rather than rebuilt each time.

  • Define test strategies: coverage, test limits, guard bands, failure modes and diagnostics.

  • Produce and maintain the design documentation other engineers execute from, including schematics, test requirements, procedures and interface definitions.

  • Use production and test data to find yield issues, bottlenecks and systemic weaknesses, then implement the fixes before they limit the ramp.

  • Review designs from other teams and set the requirements they must meet to integrate cleanly into our production workflow.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers through design reviews, feedback and knowledge sharing.


What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Several years of electronics design and test system development experience, ideally on high-reliability or high-complexity products (space, defence, telecom, automotive, industrial or similar).

  • Strong analog and digital electronics design, including high-speed digital work (signal integrity, impedance control, power integrity) and PCBA design for manufacturability and testability.

  • A track record of designing, implementing and maintaining automated test systems or electrical ground support equipment, taken from concept through to stable production.

  • Hands-on RF and mixed-signal test and characterization, including S-parameters, matching networks and filters, with the instruments that go with them (spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, signal generators).

  • Test automation in Python and embedded development in C/C++ on common microcontrollers such as STM32, TI or MSP430.

  • Experience mentoring engineers and running design reviews, with documentation quality to match.

Nice to haves:

  • Altium Designer or KiCad, and RF simulation in CST or AWR.

  • Lean or Six Sigma background, and quality methods such as FMEA, 8D or fault tree analysis applied to production problems.

  • Experience scaling a manufacturing line: ramp-up, multi-site rollout and continuous improvement.

  • Real-time operating systems such as FreeRTOS, and serial interfaces including USB, CAN and RS-485.

  • Confident use of AI tools in day-to-day engineering work.

Application Process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Technical assessment

  • Final Interview

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Workplace Manager

  • Location: Berlin, Germany

  • Department: Operations

  • Reports to: CEO ICEYE Germany

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office

  • Reporting & Visibility: Prepare regular reports and evaluations on office usage, supply metrics, and ongoing workplace projects to keep team progress transparent.

  • Fluent in both German and English.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously and prioritize effectively.

  • Prior experience in office management, hospitality, or a fast-paced tech/start-up environment is a strong plus.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with colleagues and external partners.

  • A proactive mindset with resourceful problem-solving abilities.

  • Proficiency with digital communication tools and office software (e.g., google Mail, Slack, jira).

  • Location: Athens, Greece

  • Department: Local subsidiary

  • Reports to: CEO, ICEYE Greece & indirect line to Global Head of People Operations

  • Employment type: Permanent, full-time

  • Workplace model: hybrid (office-first)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

 

Why this role matters:

You are the face of People Operations for ICEYE in Greece and the first line of defence for all country-specific people matters. ICEYE's Global HR Operations team (the second line) designs the global frameworks, tools and data standards; you own their local tailoring and practical execution — Your mission: ICEYErs in Greece are engaged and supported so they can deliver better business results.

Employee experience & local HR operations

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for local employees on benefits, policies and employee lifecycle events, providing timely and accurate responses in line with global standards.

  • Handle individual cases for relocation and onboarding, including preparation of local employment contracts and country-specific documentation.

  • Manage local third-party HR providers (payroll vendor, benefit brokers) and the local practicalities of off-boarding, meeting all legal requirements and exit procedures.

  • Act as the first point of contact for standard employee relations cases, handling practicalities locally and consulting Global HR Operations on complex issues.

Payroll, data & compliance

  • Audit payroll data in the HRIS and ensure accurate local processing in collaboration with the in-house team and the local payroll vendor.

  • Maintain accurate employee records in the HRIS and related systems: data integrity, confidentiality and compliance with local and global data privacy regulations.

  • Stay on top of Greek employment law — and keep all HR activity compliant, with clear documentation of local processes and policies.

  • Coordinate the personnel security clearance process with the local security officer for roles that require it.

Global alignment & people programmes

  • Act as the go-to person for the CEO on HR matters, escalating complex issues to the Global HR team when necessary.

  • Tailor and execute global frameworks locally — levels, salary bands, performance management, wellbeing, L&D — so they work for both the Center of Excellence and the factory population.

  • Identify opportunities to automate local HR tasks with Global HR Operations, adapting global ways of working to local legal standards while preserving ICEYE's culture.

  • Assist managers and leads as the organisation adds its first layers of management.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 8+ years of progressive HR experience covering both talent acquisition and HR generalist/business partner work.

  • Strong working knowledge of Greek labour law, local benefits and market HR practice, with a track record of creating compliant HR policy documentation.

  • A hands-on approach with high attention to detail in contract management, local onboarding and the management of local third-party providers.

  • Track record hiring technical/engineering profiles and industrial or manufacturing profiles; you personally source and close candidates.

  • Strong analytical skills and high emotional intelligence to handle sensitive individual employee relations cases, with the wisdom to escalate complex issues.

  • Comfort with HRIS (e.g., HiBob) and ticketing systems, using data to audit payroll and maintain source-of-truth records.

  • Exceptional communication in Greek and English, able to bridge global ICEYE standards with local needs and influence both local leadership and the global team.

  • A proactive, service-oriented mindset that stays effective in a fast-scaling environment, adapting global policies to local contexts without losing speed.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience taking a site from roughly 20 to 100+ people.

  • HR experience in manufacturing, aerospace, defence or another clearance-relevant industry.

  • Experience introducing or running HRIS and ATS tooling in a growing company.

  • AI-native sourcing, screening and HR-automation practices.

  • Experience in a subsidiary of an international group, balancing local ownership with global frameworks.

 

Application Process

  • Introductory call with TA Partner

  • Global HR interview

  • CEO interview (on-site)

  • Location: Espoo, Finland or Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Finance

  • Workplace model: Hybrid (office-first)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

  • Managing the company’s cash and liquidity across countries, entities, and currencies and maximizing interest income on idle cash

  • Originating and managing the company’s debt financings

  • Issuing performance and financial guarantees and letters of credit (“LCs”) to support contracts and business growth

  • Managing financial risks – mainly FX – and leading hedging for the organization

  • Owning and maintaining existing and prospective corporate banking relationships

  • Originating and maintaining corporate insurances

  • Administering ICEYE’s global cards program and online bank platforms

  • Leading financing discussions and opportunities for suppliers and customers on an ad hoc basis

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Lead the implementation and ongoing administration of the new global cards program, spanning 15 countries and more than 1,500 users

  • Lead user administration across all online banking platforms

  • Partner closely with the Accounts Payable team to execute payments and disbursements processes on behalf of the global organization

  • Support the implementation of ICEYE’s first Treasury Management System

  • Support the global bank account opening process and own ongoing bank AML and KYC compliance requirements

  • Support the issuance of global performance guarantees and letters of credit

  • Collaborate with teams within and outside of Finance on ad hoc projects at the direction of the CFO and/or Global Head of Treasury

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance or a related field; master’s degree in finance or an MBA is preferred

  • Minimum of 4 years of relevant professional experience in internal finance or financial operations

  • Experience implementing and/or administering a global cards program (required)

  • Experience with payment processing (required)

  • Experience working in a scale-up environment (highly preferred)

  • Experience opening and maintaining global bank accounts (preferred)

  • Experience administrating bank online platforms and systems (preferred)

  • Naturally gravitates to and is comfortable leveraging AI to improve productivity

  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

  • Curious, proactive, driven and ambitious, and operates with a sense of urgency

  • Confidence and comfort presenting to senior audiences

  • Advanced proficiency in written and spoken English

  • Detail-oriented, organized, and meticulous

Application Process

  • On-site interview with the Global Head of Treasury

  • On-site interview with the Senior Treasury Manager and/or Treasury Specialist

  • Video interview with the CFO

  • Department: Space Systems

  • Location: Valencia, Spain

  • Reports to: Engineering Manager, Space Systems

  • Working type: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


The Mission of the Radio Frequency Engineer

As an RF Engineer, you will be at the heart of designing and advancing the next generation of ICEYE's satellites — pushing the boundaries of what small sensing satellites can achieve. Working closely with cross-functional engineering teams, you will own the design, testing, and continuous improvement of satellite RF and microwave hardware, from PCB design and component selection to link budget analysis and advanced measurements. When things go wrong, you will be the one to diagnose why — conducting root-cause analysis and providing hands-on technical support for an ever-expanding fleet of operational satellites in orbit.

 

Who are we?

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy – day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, Germany, and the US. The company has more than 1000 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

  • You will work closely with engineers from other domains to design a new generation of satellites and ensure continuous improvements of them.

  • Master's degree in Radio/RF/Communications/Signal/Electrical engineering.

  • 5 years + of experience in RF and microwave engineering (including PCB board design, link budget, component selection).

  • Suits well in a multicultural environment.

  • Capability to drive a new project from the technical side, facing unknown issues and collaborating with people from different domains to solve it.

  • Willingness to be involved in the whole life cycle of the satellite

 

Nice to have skills

  • Prior experience in aerospace systems.

  • Prior experience with high frequency (5+ GHz) systems.

  • Capability to manage basic projects.

  • Prior experience in Altium, CST, Python.

jobs.title: Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights

  • Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

  • Location: Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: Global Supply Chain

  • Reports to: Engineering Operations Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office/On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

 
 

The Mission of the Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

As our Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics), you'll join our fast-moving Global Supply Chain organization and work closely with our hardware engineering teams as they design and build electronic systems on tight and shifting timelines.

You'll be an active part of our engineering projects, helping to execute them and staying ahead of supply. That means identifying long lead items and critical components as early as possible in the process, and securing them before they become bottlenecks for testing and builds. When lead times, allocation or a late design change threaten a prototype schedule, we need you to act. Our development cycles are fast and iterations are constantly occurring since we thrive on pushing the technology for the best.

You'll also be a key link between Engineering and Production. You'll communicate R&D supply chain risks and the critical components you've identified to Production, so nothing comes as a surprise at handover. Your work supports the success of every engineering prototype iteration and at the same time prepares Production for rollout and mass production.

This role suits someone who is proactive by nature, with a solution driven mindset and a deep understanding of electronics, PCB manufacturing and hardware prototyping, who is comfortable with ambiguity and acts before problems arrive rather than waiting for them. How quickly we get from concept to working hardware in orbit, and then into production, depends on how well this role is done.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 
 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

High-Velocity Engineering Support

  • Serve as the hands-on supply chain counterpart for fast-paced electronics engineering teams working on multiple, rapidly evolving hardware projects.

  • Be an active member of engineering project teams from kick-off, helping to execute the project plan and reviewing draft BOMs while the design can still be changed.

  • Identify long lead items and critical components as early as possible, and secure them proactively (early orders, allocation, buffer stock) before they can delay a project.

  • Translate early-stage concepts, evolving BOMs, and mid-design changes into actionable sourcing steps with minimal delay.

  • Advise engineers, in real time and in early design reviews, on how component choices affect availability, alternates, obsolescence, cost and lead time.

  • Identify supply issues before they become blockers and propose workaround paths immediately.

Rapid Sourcing & Procurement Execution

  • Own sourcing and procurement of electronic components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, connectors, harness, sensors, RF parts, embedded modules.

  • Run fast quoting and supplier selection so prototype and builds get their boards and parts on the dates engineering committed to.

  • Lead efforts to find alternative components or new supply paths within hours, not weeks, when shortages occur.

  • Set stock levels and material availability plans for development and prototype builds.

Supplier Interaction & Technical Engagement

  • Own relationships with PCB fabricators, electronics manufacturing partners and component distributors, and work with them to understand lead time constraints, manufacturing capabilities, DFM implications and fast-track build options.

  • Support technical capability assessments of PCB/PCBA vendors, machining partners, and component distributors.

  • Negotiate priority build slots, allocation and expedited shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.

Cross-Functional Start-Up Collaboration

  • Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, program management, and operations to remove obstacles and maintain build readiness.

  • Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.

  • Operate with a bias for action: if something is unclear, you chase it; if something breaks, you fix it; if something is missing, you find it.

Agility, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain a living view of supply risks across all active prjects, including obsolescence, allocation, single-source parts, counterfeit risk and export restrictions and qualify alternatives early.

  • Keep purchasing accurate in the ERP system, with clean traceability, cost visibility and build readiness status that the organisation can rely on, even under fast-moving conditions.

  • Bring an experimentation mindset: test new suppliers, new sourcing channels, new manufacturing partners, and new tools to reduce lead times and cost.

R&D to Production Readiness

  • Communicate R&D supply chain risks and identified critical components to Production early and clearly, so they are known well before handover.

  • Support the success and rapid iteration of engineering prototypes while preparing Production for rollout and mass production.

  • Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

  • Help build the sourcing foundations that will carry a design from prototype into repeatable production.

What we’re looking for


Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Supply Chain, or similar.

  • 5+ years of direct experience in electronics sourcing, component procurement or engineering supply chain roles in fast-moving hardware environments.

  • Strong technical understanding of semiconductors, passive components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, embedded electronics, and prototyping flows.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions, tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience interpreting electronic schematics, BOMs, AVL requirements, PCB stackups, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions: tight deadlines, shifting priorities, incomplete information, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience running purchasing and material management through an ERP system.

  • Confident negotiator, commercially and technically, able to influence engineers, program managers and suppliers without formal authority.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

Nice to haves:

  • Engineering Electronics Background, knowledge of the tools and technical understanding/background of designs.

  • Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

  • Exposure to taking a hardware design from prototype into series production.

  • Existing relationships with PCB/PCBA vendors, distributors and electronics manufacturing partners.

  • Certifications (APICS, PMP, Six Sigma) useful but not required.

  • Familiarity with rapid-prototyping suppliers, global component marketplaces, and digital sourcing tools.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

jobs.title: Production Team Lead, Satellite Electronics Subsystems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Production Team Lead, Satellite Electronics Subsystems

Role highlights

  • Title: Production Team Lead, Satellite Subsystems (Electronics, Battery and Software Integration)

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Reports to: Head of Subassemblies

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (including SUPO, where required)

Lead Today's Production. Engineer Tomorrow's Systems.

Before launch, ICEYE satellites rely on complex electronics, battery packs, and flight software. Today, these critical workflows depend heavily on manual assembly and verification.

To support our rapid growth, we are seeking a Production Team Lead to modernize, scale, and own this end-to-end area, enabling exponential output while ensuring quality, cost efficiency, and operational simplicity.

Leading teams across electronics, batteries, software, and testing, you will utilize dedicated capital resources to build an automated, data-driven production environment.

What you will own

  • Daily Operations: Lead manufacturing across electronics assembly, battery fabrication, software loading, integration, and functional testing while upholding safety, quality, cost, and throughput standards.

  • Production Architecture: Standardize workflows, takt times, line layouts, and kitting to deliver predictable, repeatable cycle times.

  • New Product Introduction (NPI): Scale new subsystem designs and next-gen satellite platforms from R&D to high-rate production, ensuring tooling, test, and workforce readiness.

  • Automation & Digital Manufacturing: Champion automated functional testing, scripted software deployment, unit-level data logging, and full electronic revision traceability.

  • Hardware-Software Integration: Optimize workflows spanning assembly, functional testing, firmware flashing, and systemic validation to ensure flawless alignment between software releases and hardware revisions.

  • DFM/DFT & Continuous Improvement: Participate in design reviews, translating floor-level yield and test metrics into continuous design and manufacturing enhancements.

  • Risk & Quality Controls: Embed best practices for battery handling, state-of-charge management, ESD protection, FOD control, and cleanroom disciplines directly into daily operations.

Role highlights

  • Quality Management System Specialist

  • Location: Spain

  • Department: GMO – Manufacturing Assurance

  • Reports to: Global QMS Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)


Why this role matters

The Quality Management System (QMS) Specialist/engineer is responsible for implementation of the ICEYEs Quality Management System in our Valencia production unit to ensure consistent delivery of products and services that meet customer, regulatory, and industry standards. In this role you will partner closely with production, supply chain, Health and safety teams to ensure that our processes are aligned with business goals and embedded into daily practices.

This role will report to the Global Quality Management System (QMS) manager and operate as a standalone position within the Spain facility.

Who We Are

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE’s world-leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world’s largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy, day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high-resolution imagery and high-frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE’s near real-time data creates a tactical advantage for mission-critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural-catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring including oil-spill detection, and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE is headquartered in Finland and operates globally across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. We have more than 900 employees, united by a shared vision: improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Ensure ICEYE Quality Management System is fully implemented in our Valencia facility

  • Drive ICEYE production framework maturity increase in Valencia - be the subject matter expert for QMS, QA, Support Health and safety and environmental topics.

  • Ensure compliance with regulatory, customer, and industry requirements, serve as the main point of contact for auditors and certification bodies.

  • Act as an internal auditor in our internal process audits covering quality and supporting EHS topics.

  • Ensure controlled documentation rigor in Valencia operations

  • Define and track quality KPIs; prepare and present regular performance reports to leadership.

  • Provide training and coaching on QMS processes, standards, and quality tools; promote a culture of quality throughout the organization.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years in quality, engineering, operations, compliance, or process improvement roles.

  • Strong experience with digital QMS systems and data-driven improvement methods.

  • Strong knowledge of QMS standards (ISO 9001 required; AS9100, AQAP2110, PECAL or similar beneficial)

  • Experience with quality tools and risk management (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments).

  • Audit experience, either as an internal auditor or supporting external certification

  • Adaptability and a real willingness to learn; comfortable in a fast-paced, agile production environment where processes are still taking shape

  • Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to drive cross-functional alignment and work independently with minimal supervision

  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish

 

Nice to haves:

  • Degree in Engineering, Quality, Business, or related field.

  • Knowledge of AS9100, AQAP 2110, PECAL, or ISO 27001

  • Multi-site or international corporate experience

  • Background in defence tech, aerospace, advanced manufacturing, or automotive

  • Experience with quality tools and risk management methods (RCA, CAPA, FMEA, PDCA, risk assessments). If you bring the right mindset, we can build these with you.

Application Process

  • TA interview

  • Hiring Manager video interview

  • Home task + task review interview

  • Final onsite interviews

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

Working at ICEYE

 

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

 

How We Work (Our Values)

 

  • Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

     

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

     

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

     

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

     

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

     

  • Have fun: What we do matters - and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

 

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

 

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

 

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.title: Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Highlights

  • Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

  • Location: Netherlands

  • Department: Global Supply Chain

  • Reports to: Engineering Operations Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Office/On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

 
 

The Mission of the Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics)

As our Engineering Supply Chain Manager (Electronics), you'll join our fast-moving Global Supply Chain organization and work closely with our hardware engineering teams as they design and build electronic systems on tight and shifting timelines.

You'll be an active part of our engineering projects, helping to execute them and staying ahead of supply. That means identifying long lead items and critical components as early as possible in the process, and securing them before they become bottlenecks for testing and builds. When lead times, allocation or a late design change threaten a prototype schedule, we need you to act. Our development cycles are fast and iterations are constantly occurring since we thrive on pushing the technology for the best.

You'll also be a key link between Engineering and Production. You'll communicate R&D supply chain risks and the critical components you've identified to Production, so nothing comes as a surprise at handover. Your work supports the success of every engineering prototype iteration and at the same time prepares Production for rollout and mass production.

This role suits someone who is proactive by nature, with a solution driven mindset and a deep understanding of electronics, PCB manufacturing and hardware prototyping, who is comfortable with ambiguity and acts before problems arrive rather than waiting for them. How quickly we get from concept to working hardware in orbit, and then into production, depends on how well this role is done.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 
 

Your day-to-day responsibilities

High-Velocity Engineering Support

  • Serve as the hands-on supply chain counterpart for fast-paced electronics engineering teams working on multiple, rapidly evolving hardware projects.

  • Be an active member of engineering project teams from kick-off, helping to execute the project plan and reviewing draft BOMs while the design can still be changed.

  • Identify long lead items and critical components as early as possible, and secure them proactively (early orders, allocation, buffer stock) before they can delay a project.

  • Translate early-stage concepts, evolving BOMs, and mid-design changes into actionable sourcing steps with minimal delay.

  • Advise engineers, in real time and in early design reviews, on how component choices affect availability, alternates, obsolescence, cost and lead time.

  • Identify supply issues before they become blockers and propose workaround paths immediately.

Rapid Sourcing & Procurement Execution

  • Own sourcing and procurement of electronic components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, connectors, harness, sensors, RF parts, embedded modules.

  • Run fast quoting and supplier selection so prototype and builds get their boards and parts on the dates engineering committed to.

  • Lead efforts to find alternative components or new supply paths within hours, not weeks, when shortages occur.

  • Set stock levels and material availability plans for development and prototype builds.

Supplier Interaction & Technical Engagement

  • Own relationships with PCB fabricators, electronics manufacturing partners and component distributors, and work with them to understand lead time constraints, manufacturing capabilities, DFM implications and fast-track build options.

  • Support technical capability assessments of PCB/PCBA vendors, machining partners, and component distributors.

  • Negotiate priority build slots, allocation and expedited shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.

Cross-Functional Start-Up Collaboration

  • Coordinate across engineering, manufacturing, program management, and operations to remove obstacles and maintain build readiness.

  • Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.

  • Operate with a bias for action: if something is unclear, you chase it; if something breaks, you fix it; if something is missing, you find it.

Agility, Risk Management & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain a living view of supply risks across all active prjects, including obsolescence, allocation, single-source parts, counterfeit risk and export restrictions and qualify alternatives early.

  • Keep purchasing accurate in the ERP system, with clean traceability, cost visibility and build readiness status that the organisation can rely on, even under fast-moving conditions.

  • Bring an experimentation mindset: test new suppliers, new sourcing channels, new manufacturing partners, and new tools to reduce lead times and cost.

R&D to Production Readiness

  • Communicate R&D supply chain risks and identified critical components to Production early and clearly, so they are known well before handover.

  • Support the success and rapid iteration of engineering prototypes while preparing Production for rollout and mass production.

  • Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

  • Help build the sourcing foundations that will carry a design from prototype into repeatable production.

What we’re looking for


Must haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Electronic Engineering, Mechatronics, Supply Chain, or similar.

  • 5+ years of direct experience in electronics sourcing, component procurement or engineering supply chain roles in fast-moving hardware environments.

  • Strong technical understanding of semiconductors, passive components, PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, embedded electronics, and prototyping flows.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions, tight deadlines, shifting priorities, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience interpreting electronic schematics, BOMs, AVL requirements, PCB stackups, and manufacturing documentation.

  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in startup-like conditions: tight deadlines, shifting priorities, incomplete information, and rapid cycles.

  • Hands-on experience running purchasing and material management through an ERP system.

  • Confident negotiator, commercially and technically, able to influence engineers, program managers and suppliers without formal authority.

  • Professional English, written and spoken.

Nice to haves:

  • Engineering Electronics Background, knowledge of the tools and technical understanding/background of designs.

  • Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

  • Exposure to taking a hardware design from prototype into series production.

  • Existing relationships with PCB/PCBA vendors, distributors and electronics manufacturing partners.

  • Certifications (APICS, PMP, Six Sigma) useful but not required.

  • Familiarity with rapid-prototyping suppliers, global component marketplaces, and digital sourcing tools.

Application Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Task Stage

  • Task-based interview

  • Final Interview

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Base salary range for this position is dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us—we’ll do our best to help.

That means identifying long lead items, critical materials and complex parts as early as possible in the process, and securing them before they become bottlenecks for testing and builds. When machining capacity, material availability, special process queues or a late design change threaten a prototype schedule, we need you to act. You'll also be a key link between Engineering and Production. You'll communicate R&D supply chain risks and the critical parts and materials you've identified to Production, so nothing comes as a surprise at handover. Your work supports the success of every engineering prototype iteration and at the same time prepares Production for rollout and mass production.

This role suits someone who is proactive by nature, with a solution driven mindset and a deep understanding of mechanical manufacturing processes, materials and hardware prototyping, who is comfortable with ambiguity and acts before problems arrive rather than waiting for them. How quickly we get from concept to working hardware in orbit, and then into production, depends on how well this role is done.




WHO WE ARE


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.



ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

HIGH-VELOCITY ENGINEERING SUPPORT

 - Serve as the hands-on supply chain counterpart for fast-paced mechanical engineering teams working on multiple, rapidly evolving hardware projects.
   

 - Identify long lead items, critical raw materials and complex parts as early as possible, and secure them proactively (early orders, material reservation, capacity booking, buffer stock, coating readiness, securing helicoils) before they can delay a project.



 - Translate early-stage concepts, evolving BOMs, and mid-design changes into actionable sourcing steps with minimal delay.
   

 - Provide engineers with real-time insights on material availability, components availability and quick-turn manufacturing options.
   

 - Identify supply issues before they become blockers and propose workaround paths immediately.
   


RAPID SOURCING & PROCUREMENT EXECUTION

 - Own project procurement of CNC machined parts, structural elements and composite parts, mechanisms, motors,  fasteners, bearings, thermal hardware and raw materials, including related special processes such as heat treatment, surface treatments and coatings.
   

 - Run fast quoting and supplier selection so prototype and builds get their parts and materials on the dates engineering committed to.
   

 - Lead efforts to find alternative suppliers, processes or materials within hours, not weeks, when capacity or material shortages occur.
   

 - Set stock levels and material availability plans for development and prototype builds.

 - Support technical capability assessments of machining, special process suppliers, and material distributors.



 - Negotiate priority machine time, expedited processing and shipments, and secure prototypes under compressed timelines.

 - Maintain complete visibility into prototype schedules, engineering changes, and material risks, communicating clearly and frequently.

 - Make sure critical and long lead parts, qualified suppliers and special processes, and realistic lead times and capacity are in place before a design moves into series production.

 - Experience in space, aerospace, defence, hardware startups or other deep-tech R&D environments.

This role enables customers, particularly in the Defence and Intelligence (D&I) sector, to effectively understand and apply ICEYE’s SAR capabilities, products, and services to support mission-critical objectives.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Develop, maintain and tailor training programs covering remote sensing principles, SAR fundamentals, and the practical application of ICEYE’s technology across operational use cases.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Staff Engineer - Satellite Communications

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Fleet Control and Satellite Communications

  • Reports to: Director, Fleet Control and Satellite Communications

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid. 3 days a week at the office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Staff Engineer in Satellite Communications, you will own the satellite-to-ground link, the core communications protocols, and the end-to-end transmission of data from ground stations to customers. Trend is that our constellation produces an increasing volume of data and we want it down faster and more reliably. As we scale, the communications link sets the limit on what we deliver and how fast customers receive it.

You'll own the end-to-end communication stack: the satellite-to-ground link (X-band, Ka-band and S-band), the underlying protocols used, and the transmission of data from ground stations to customers. Today these decisions are spread across several teams. This role brings them under one technical owner.

The work sits where software meets physics. On one side are link budgets, modulation and coding, and spectrum constraints; on the other are schedulers, distributed systems and production operations. The hardest problems live where the two meet.

You own what you build, from design to production, across a stack that combines cloud, on-prem and real hardware. Our engineering culture is AI-positive, with active use of copilots and LLMs to improve speed, code quality and productivity.


Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Own the architecture of the satellite-to-ground link acrossX-band and Ka-band payload downlink and S-band command and control

  • Measure what the constellation delivers against its theoretical capacity, and lead the work that closes the gap

  • Design how data moves from ground station to customer, including latency tiers and delivery accounting

  • Build alongside software engineers, contributing code and reviews, not only architecture documents

  • Lead technical initiatives across team boundaries and align teams on link and data path decisions

  • Grow satellite communications expertise across the domain through mentoring, design reviews and shared standards

What we're looking for



Must haves:

  • Communications engineering on at least one flown mission, including personally diagnosing an anomaly on a live satellite.

  • High-rate payload downlink experience in X-band or Ka-band, beyond S-band command and control

  • Ability to build and defend a link budget: EIRP, G/T, Eb/N0, margin, rain fade, elevation constraints

  • Practical CCSDS knowledge: transfer frames, virtual channels, synchronisation and channel coding, file delivery

  • Experience owning how data moves from a ground station to where it is consumed, with latency and completeness guarantees

  • Hands-on coding in Python, Go, C++ or similar; you ship code, not just designs.

Nice to haves:

  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., copilots, LLMs) to improve productivity, code quality, and problem-solving

  • Fleet-scale contact planning and scheduling across commercial ground station networks, especially leased third-party capacity

  • DVB-S2/S2X with adaptive coding and modulation

  • Delay-tolerant networking, or other store-and-forward file delivery with completeness accounting

  • SDR and DSP work: GNU Radio, FPGA or RFSoC, including personal or open-source projects

  • Awareness of spectrum regulation and coordination. We have a separate spectrum licensing team, so this is a plus rather than a requirement


Application Process

  • TA Partner Screen Call (30 min)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (90 min)

  • Technical Interview (120 min)

  • Values and Fit Interview (60 min)

  • Final interview with SVP of Engineering (60min)

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

  • Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.



Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Attraction will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.


Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us, and we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • AI Solutions Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Business Applications

  • Reports to: AI Platform Lead / Head of Business Applications

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid / Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

The Business Applications team focuses on high-impact internal use cases to help the company grow, building internal solutions and facilitating new processes as we scale our data infrastructure, tooling, and operations. As an AI Solutions Engineer, you bridge the gap between rapid AI-assisted product delivery and scalable, governed platform engineering. You will spend roughly 50% of your time taking high-value internal use cases from business needs to reliable, production-grade applications, and 50% of your time collaborating with the AI Platform Lead on our shared internal applications platform, DevOps workflows, and governance guardrails. You think ahead: instead of solving problems with brittle one-off fixes, you turn recurring needs into clean, reusable platform capabilities and help guide our Junior AI Solutions Engineers to do the same.

Who We Are

Your day-to-day responsibilities

Build and ship internal applications & AI-enabled solutions (~50%)

  • Partner directly with stakeholders across the business to translate operational bottlenecks into clear technical designs and working, scalable applications.

  • Build, iterate on, and productionize full-stack internal applications and automations (primarily Python/FastAPI, TypeScript/React, and PostgreSQL) using modern AI-first coding workflows (Cursor, Claude Code) and LLM APIs where they add real value.

  • Design and maintain reliable, governed integrations with core enterprise systems and data sources (e.g., HiBob/HRIS, Salesforce, Databricks, Slack, Jira, Google Workspace, Okta).

  • Own the full lifecycle of the solutions you build. All the way from rapid prototyping and stakeholder validation to production rollout, documentation, and long-term maintainability.

Collaborate on the Internal Tools Platform, DevOps & governance (~50%)

  • Collaborate with the AI Platform Lead to develop, operate, and scale our AWS-based internal applications platform (ECS/Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, ALB/CloudFront, ECR, Secrets Manager, EventBridge) managed via Terraform.

  • Build for scale rather than one-offs: when an application needs a new integration pattern, infrastructure capability, or deployment workflow, design it as a reusable, self-service platform pattern that benefits the entire fleet of internal apps.

  • Maintain and improve GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines (OIDC, automated security and IaC scanning, plan/apply workflows) and shared platform libraries (authentication, IAM database access, service-to-service communication).

  • Uphold strong governance, security-by-default, and auditability across the platform by ensuring strict access controls, clear audit trails for sensitive data access and write-backs, least-privilege IAM, and traceable change management.

  • Help triage and resolve platform-level operational issues, including deployment pipelines, container health, database migrations, network/egress rules, and observability/log forwarding (Splunk, CloudWatch).

Elevate team engineering quality & unblock delivery

  • Act as a day-to-day technical sounding board and mentor for the Junior AI Solutions Engineers on the team by reviewing PRs, guiding data modeling and API design, and helping troubleshoot tricky deployment or integration issues.

  • Contribute to shared templates, runbooks, and architecture decision records (ADRs) so the team moves fast without accumulating technical or security debt.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 4–6 years of hands-on experience in software engineering, full-stack development, or platform/DevOps engineering, with a track record of shipping and operating production web applications end to end.

  • Systems and platform mindset: you naturally look past the immediate ticket to see how a solution will behave across 30+ apps in a year's time, and you strongly prefer reusable patterns, clean abstractions, and automation over ad-hoc, one-off workarounds.

  • Strong appreciation for governance, security, and auditability: comfortable working in an environment where data isolation, least-privilege access, approval gates, and verifiable audit trails are non-negotiable.

  • Strong proficiency in Python (e.g., FastAPI) and/or TypeScript/React, plus solid relational database skills (PostgreSQL, schema isolation, migrations).

  • Practical Cloud & DevOps experience on AWS (e.g., ECS/Fargate or containers, IAM, networking/ALB, RDS/Aurora) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Docker, automated testing and security checks) and AI-assisted engineering tools (Cursor, Claude Code) plus practical LLM API integration.

  • Pragmatic communicator: comfortable working directly with business stakeholders to scope ambiguous problems, while holding a high bar for engineering quality under the hood.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems and APIs such as HRIS/ATS (HiBob, Ashby), CRM (Salesforce), data platforms (Databricks), or Slack/GitHub Apps.

  • Hands-on familiarity with security and compliance controls in cloud environments (OIDC/OAuth2, IAM database authentication, KMS encryption, Checkov/IaC scanning, Splunk/audit logging).

  • Prior experience mentoring junior engineers and reviewing code/architecture on a fast-moving team.

Application Process

  • Introductory call with TA

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Technical & Platform case interview

  • Skip level interview

Working at ICEYE

As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
