jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain Strategy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Director, Supply Chain Strategy

  • Location: FInland, Germany or Spain

  • Department: Global Supply Chain

  • Reports to: Global Director Supply Chain

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters - The mission

We are seeking a strategic, commercially and legally strong Director, Supply Chain Strategy to shape how ICEYE secures, de-risks and scales the supply base behind the world's largest multisensor satellite constellation.

You will own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy: how we assess and manage supplier risk, which suppliers we develop as long-term partners, and where we vertically integrate through partnerships, licensing, joint ventures or acquisitions. You will also define and own our supplier portal landscape, the digital backbone of how we collaborate with suppliers. Finally, you will own how ICEYE meets local content requirements, supporting our local entities as they select and onboard in-country suppliers.

This role is for a leader who moves comfortably between the boardroom and the engineering bench: credible with executives, investors and partners, and equally credible with electrical, mechanical, manufacturing and supplier engineers.

Who we are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defense and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

1. Global supply chain strategy

  • Define and own ICEYE's global supply chain strategy, aligned with company, program and production roadmaps, and translate it into a multi-year plan with clear priorities, targets and KPIs.

  • Establish and run a structured supplier risk assessment framework covering financial health, capacity, single and sole sourcing, geopolitical and export control exposure, security and compliance.

  • Build and maintain a supplier risk heat-map across all critical commodities and suppliers, and use it to drive mitigation plans, dual sourcing and inventory strategies.

  • Own supplier due diligence for new and strategic suppliers, including ownership and security screening, ESG and compliance checks, in close cooperation with Legal, Security and Quality.

  • Lead supplier development programs that lift capability, quality and capacity of strategic suppliers, and grow a resilient, sovereign-capable supply base for defense and dual-use customers.

2. Strategic partnerships & ventures

  • Identify, evaluate and execute vertical integration opportunities where owning or controlling critical technologies, processes or capacity creates strategic advantage.

  • Support the negotiation of long-term and strategic supply agreements, including pricing, capacity reservation, IP, liability, security and exit terms.

  • Structure and negotiate license agreements and joint venture agreements with industrial and technology partners.

  • Act as the M&A lead in the vertical integration domain: build the target pipeline, lead technical and operational due diligence, shape business cases and drive post-merger integration of acquired capabilities into the supply chain.

  • Work closely with Corporate Development, Finance and Legal, and present recommendations to the executive team and board.

3. Supplier portals

  • Define and own ICEYE's supplier portal strategy, roadmap and architecture.

  • Lead the selection, implementation and continuous improvement of supplier portals for onboarding, qualification, forecasting, order collaboration, document exchange and performance scorecards.

  • Ensure portals integrate with ERP and PLM, and meet ICEYE's information security and export control requirements.

  • Drive supplier adoption and use portal data to improve visibility, risk monitoring and decision making.

4. Local content & local supply

  • Own ICEYE's approach to local content, industrial participation and offset requirements in customer programs and sovereign missions.

  • Assess local content obligations early in bids and contracts, and translate them into sourcing plans with clear targets and tracking.

  • Support ICEYE's local entities in identifying, assessing, selecting and onboarding local suppliers, applying ICEYE's risk assessment, due diligence and qualification standards.

  • Develop local suppliers so they can meet ICEYE's technical, quality and security requirements, and integrate them into the global supply base and supplier portals.

  • Report on local content performance and compliance to program teams, local entity leadership and customers.

5. Leadership & organization development

  • Build, lead and develop a team of supply chain strategy, strategic sourcing and supplier management professionals, including managers.

  • Define the operating model, workflows and governance for strategic sourcing and supply continuity across electronics, mechanical, electromechanical and specialty process categories.

  • Develop hiring profiles, succession plans and long-term talent strategies to scale the organization.

  • Foster a culture of urgency, technical rigor, proactive risk management and high accountability.

6. Securing serial supply continuity

  • Partner with the Supply Chain Category Managers, who own category strategies and day-to-day supply continuity for serial production, and ensure the supply chain strategy actively supports their goals.

  • Identify structural supply risks that category management alone cannot resolve, such as single and sole sources, capacity bottlenecks, obsolescence, technology dependencies and geopolitical exposure.

  • Propose and execute structural solutions that secure continuous supply: strategic partnerships, long-term supply agreements, licensing, joint ventures, vertical integration and M&A.

  • Build business cases with Category Management, Finance and Engineering that compare make, buy, partner and acquire options.

  • Track how these initiatives improve supply security, lead-times and cost at rate.

7. Supporting supplier engagement

  • Support the Supply Chain Category Managers, who own the relationships with suppliers in their categories, including executive-level engagement with strategic suppliers where needed.

  • Bring the strategic view into supplier relationships: risk heat-map findings, due diligence results, supplier development needs and partnership or integration opportunities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Geospatial Image Analyst (GEOINT)

  • Location: EU

  • Department: Data

  • Reports to: Senior SAR Image Analyst

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As a Geospatial Image Analyst within ICEYE’s Data line of business, you will play a central role in the exploitation and interpretation of Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery - with a primary focus on Defence & Intelligence (D&I) applications and use cases.

This position is suited for an individual with several years of hands-on experience in geospatial data analysis and image interpretation, who is ready to deepen their expertise in SAR exploitation and operational delivery. You will contribute directly to mission-critical insights by transforming complex radar data into actionable intelligence products.

Working closely with our Image Analysis, Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product and Sales teams, you will combine your analytical acumen with advanced geospatial tools - including AI workflows - to provide stakeholders with timely, accurate, and operationally relevant geospatial intelligence.

 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Conduct advanced SAR image exploitation and analysis to support D&I use cases such as activity monitoring, change detection and pattern-of-life analysis.

  • Develop and deliver analytic reports, visualizations, and geospatial products that meet customer requirements and operational standards.

  • Collaborate with product and delivery teams to define analysis specifications, interpret results, and ensure technical outputs align with needs.

  • Apply geospatial, remote sensing, and SAR science expertise to enhance ICEYE’s analytical capabilities and data value proposition.

  • Engage with customers and partners, when required, to explain methodologies, interpret outputs, and support the operational use of ICEYE data.

  • Stay current with advances in SAR technology, geospatial tools, and D&I analytic tradecraft, incorporating new techniques and insights into daily work.

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 3-5+ years of experience in geospatial analysis, SAR/satellite imagery (electro-optical, thermal, hyperspectral etc) exploitation, or related D&I analytical functions, in defense environment.

  • Proficient in SAR interpretation, with working knowledge of common geospatial software e.g. QGIS, SOCET GXP, ArcGIS.

  • Strong understanding of remote sensing and related geospatial principles.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex analytical findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Ability to adapt quickly, manage multiple tasks, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

 

Application Process

  • TA Screen;

  • Hiring Manager Interview;

  • Practical Task + presentation;

  • Final Interview with Senior Management.

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

jobs.title: Electrical AIT Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Electrical AIT Engineer

  • Team: Global Manufacturing Organization – AIT Engineering

  • Location: Tokyo, Japan

  • Working model: On-site

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required).

 

Who are we?

ICEYE is the global leader in synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, revolutionizing Earth observation with real-time, all-weather, day-and-night imaging. As the owner and operator of the world's largest SAR satellite constellation, we provide critical insights that empower industries like defense, maritime, disaster management, insurance, and finance to make informed decisions.

Headquartered in Finland and operating internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US, our diverse team of more than 900 experts from nearly 60 countries shares a bold mission: to enhance life on Earth by delivering reliable, data-driven solutions. At ICEYE, we foster a culture of curiosity, innovation, and collaboration, pushing the boundaries of what's possible in space technology to solve the world's toughest challenges.

 

Why Join ICEYE?

At ICEYE, we're not just launching satellites — we're redefining what's possible with SAR technology. Join a team of passionate innovators solving real-world challenges and making a tangible impact. We foster a dynamic and inclusive environment where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly matter. With continuous learning opportunities, cutting-edge projects, and collaboration with industry-leading experts, you'll have the chance to grow, innovate, and shape the future of Earth Observation.

 

What will you do in this role?

ICEYE is seeking an Electrical AIT (Assembly, Integration & Testing) Engineer to own the electrical/avionics side of production end to end -- integration, debugging, continuous improvement, and adapting processes as new designs come through. In this role, you will be the technical expert responsible for satellite-level testing, system validation, and electrical functional performance. You will ensure that the satellite's power, propulsion, GNC, GPS, and CDH/OBC systems perform as a cohesive, flight-ready unit, ensuring the spacecraft meets ICEYE's high standards for reliability and mission success.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute unit-level and satellite-level verification and validation (V&V) campaigns, focusing on power, propulsion, GNC, GPS, and CDH/OBC functional performance and system health.

  • Lead the integration of electrical/avionics hardware with satellite subsystems (power, propulsion, GNC, GPS, CDH/OBC, thermal), ensuring seamless interoperability.

  • Test and validate the hardware/software interface -- telemetry and telecommand behavior, CDH bus interfaces, and OBC-driven subsystem responses -- without owning flight software development or debugging, which sits with the Software AIT team.

  • Develop and maintain test scripts and automation (Python) to enhance the efficiency, repeatability, and coverage of functional and environmental test campaigns.

  • Act as a primary technical contact for electrical-related integration issues; perform root cause analysis (RCA) and coordinate with power/propulsion/GNC engineering to resolve anomalies.

  • Support production readiness and design reviews (e.g., PRR, CDR) by providing feedback on electrical testability, HIL and EGSE requirements, and system configuration.

  • Contribute to and improve AIT documentation, including electrical test procedures, integration plans, and configuration records.

  • Interface with Global AIT, Power/Propulsion/GNC Engineering, and Mission Operations teams to ensure alignment on product standards and lessons learned.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives in electrical integration methods, test efficiency, and build reliability.

 

Requirements & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in electrical/avionics integration, testing, or production of complex systems, preferably in aerospace or high-reliability hardware industries.

  • Working proficiency in scripting and automation (Python preferred) for test development and data analysis.

  • Deep technical understanding of satellite electrical architectures, including power systems, propulsion, GNC, GPS, and/or CDH/OBC.

  • Proven experience in multidisciplinary engineering environments with a focus on system-level validation.

  • Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, environmental testing (EMC, vibration, thermal), and configuration management processes.

  • A systems engineering mindset, capable of anticipating integration risks and connecting the dots between software logic, hardware interfaces, and mission operations.

  • Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross-functional environment.

 

Nice to Have

  • Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence)

  • Lean & Six Sigma experience

  • Experience with power system EGSE, propulsion functional testing, or GNC/GPS calibration beyond routine test execution

  • Ability to improve and/or write test scripts in Python

  • Strong track record of enabling design-for-testability (DFT) and design-for-manufacturing (DFM)

  • Proficient in Japanese, both written and spoken

 

What's In It for You?

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach.

  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment.

  • Health insurance.

  • Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes.

  • Relocation support, where applicable (e.g., flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support).

  • Inspiring, collaborative offices and silent workspaces that enable you to focus.

 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value — it's our greatest strength. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. Diverse perspectives drive innovation and creativity, so we actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.

No matter your background, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to the team. Join us and be part of a workplace where differences are embraced and valued, because together, we're stronger.

Apply now to begin your ICEYE journey and help us make the impossible possible.

Learn more about ICEYE and life at our company at iceye.com.

Ready to launch your career? Apply now and help us build the future of Space Tech! 🚀

 - Act as a primary technical contact for electrical-related integration issues; perform root cause analysis (RCA) and coordinate with power/propulsion/GNC engineering to resolve anomalies.

 - Support production readiness and design reviews (e.g., PRR, CDR) by providing feedback on electrical testability, HIL and EGSE requirements, and system configuration.

 - Contribute to and improve AIT documentation, including electrical test procedures, integration plans, and configuration records.

 - Interface with Global AIT, Power/Propulsion/GNC Engineering, and Mission Operations teams to ensure alignment on product standards and lessons learned.

 - Drive continuous improvement initiatives in electrical integration methods, test efficiency, and build reliability.



 


REQUIREMENTS & QUALIFICATIONS

 - 3+ years of hands-on experience in electrical/avionics integration, testing, or production of complex systems, preferably in aerospace or high-reliability hardware industries.

 - Working proficiency in scripting and automation (Python preferred) for test development and data analysis.

 - Deep technical understanding of satellite electrical architectures, including power systems, propulsion, GNC, GPS, and/or CDH/OBC.

 - Proven experience in multidisciplinary engineering environments with a focus on system-level validation.

 - Familiarity with hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, environmental testing (EMC, vibration, thermal), and configuration management processes.

 - A systems engineering mindset, capable of anticipating integration risks and connecting the dots between software logic, hardware interfaces, and mission operations.

 - Proficient in English, both written and spoken, to ensure clear communication in a cross-functional environment.

 


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience using Atlassian Cloud (Jira, Confluence)

 - Lean & Six Sigma experience

 - Experience with power system EGSE, propulsion functional testing, or GNC/GPS calibration beyond routine test execution

 - Ability to improve and/or write test scripts in Python

 - Strong track record of enabling design-for-testability (DFT) and design-for-manufacturing (DFM)

 - Proficient in Japanese, both written and spoken

 


WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

 - A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale-up approach.

 - An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment.

 - Health insurance.

 - Time for self-development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes.

 - Relocation support, where applicable (e.g., flight tickets, accommodation, relocation agency support).

 - Inspiring, collaborative offices and silent workspaces that enable you to focus.

 


DIVERSITY, EQUITY, AND INCLUSION

At ICEYE, diversity is more than just a value — it's our greatest strength. We're dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. Diverse perspectives drive innovation and creativity, so we actively seek individuals from all backgrounds and experiences.

No matter your background, we encourage you to bring your authentic self to the team. Join us and be part of a workplace where differences are embraced and valued, because together, we're stronger.

Apply now to begin your ICEYE journey and help us make the impossible possible.

Learn more about ICEYE and life at our company at iceye.com http://iceye.com.

Ready to launch your career? Apply now and help us build the future of Space Tech! 🚀

jobs.title: Buyer (Electronics & Comms)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Global Manufacturing Organisation (GMO) - Supply Chain

  • Reports to: Supply Chain Manager

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters

Every satellite we build depends on the right components arriving on time, in the right quantity and quality. As our Electronics Buyer, you turn the production plan into purchase orders and keep material flowing to our EMS partners and production lines, so builds start on time and shortages are caught before they stop the line. You'll work daily with suppliers, Planning, Production, Engineering and Quality, and play a key part in scaling satellite production.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defense and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Review and release planned orders from ERP/MRP for PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components and related services (EMS assembly, testing, coating) in line with the production plan

  • Secure order confirmations and manage confirmed dates against need dates; expedite, pull in or push out orders as demand changes

  • Monitor open orders and shortages, flag risks to builds early, and drive recovery with suppliers and the Team Lead

  • Work with engineering teams where needed to resolve manufacturing issues and shortages, including finding alternative parts and sources for engineering approval

  • Coordinate material for EMS partners: kit readiness, turnkey and consigned material, and on-time delivery of free-issue components

  • Place spot buys through approved distributors when shortages occur, within approved supplier and quality rules

  • Keep purchasing data accurate in ERP: prices, lead times, MOQs, packaging (reels, trays), supplier part numbers and approved sources

  • Handle PO changes, goods receipt issues, invoice mismatches and returns with Finance, Logistics and Quality

  • Process supplier PCN and end-of-life notices and route them to the Team Lead and Engineering

  • Prepare RFQs for repeat buys and price updates, and support the Team Lead and specialists with quotes and supplier data

  • Report open orders, on-time delivery, shortages and spend for category and management reviews

What we're looking for

Must haves

  • 2+ years as an operational buyer, purchaser or material planner in electronics manufacturing, EMS or hardware production

  • Hands-on experience buying PCBs, PCBAs and electronic components

  • Daily use of an ERP/MRP system: releasing planned orders, managing the full PO lifecycle and keeping master data clean

  • Experience expediting and resolving shortages with distributors and manufacturers in a production environment

  • Able to read a BOM and match manufacturer part numbers to supplier offers

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail across many orders and suppliers in parallel

  • Clear communicator with suppliers, Planning, Production and Quality; escalates early

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, deadline-driven production environment with an international supplier base

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Business or similar, or equivalent experience

Nice to haves

  • Familiarity with electronics supply chains, including PCB fabrication, PCBA assembly, EMS partners and electronic components

  • Exposure to scaling production in a fast-growing, technology-driven company

  • Experience with NetSuite, Silicon Expert or Arena PLM

  • Knowledge of authorized distribution channels and counterfeit avoidance

  • Basic understanding of export control and end-use statement (EUS) handling

Application Process

  • Recruiter Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Task Assignment

  • Final onsite team/department interview (2 hours)

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you'll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.

How We Work (Our Values)

Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.

  • Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the "why" behind decisions.

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what's happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters, and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

We're committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us; we'll do our best to help.

Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

  • A structured, calm way of working when priorities shift and several reviews run in parallel

jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Portugal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Role: Forward Deployed AI Engineer

  • Department: Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Location: Portugal (Lisbon)

  • Reports to: VP, Forward Deployed Engineering

  • Working type: Hybrid (On-site at customer locations approx. 50% of time)

  • Must be eligible and able to attain relevant national and NATO security clearances.

  • Must be based in-country and native level speaker of the country you're deploying to.

The Mission of the Forward Deployed AI Engineer

In this role, you'll be the hands-on AI builder defense and intelligence customers rely on. You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

Day to day responsibilities:

Platform Deployment & Integration

  • Deploy ICEYE's intelligence platform into customer secure environments (on-premise, air-gapped networks, classified data centers).

  • Build and maintain containerized applications (Docker) and manage deployments in customer Kubernetes clusters.

  • Develop APIs and data pipelines connecting ICEYE systems to customer C4ISR infrastructure and intelligence tools.

  • Troubleshoot deployment issues in disconnected environments without external internet access.

AI Solution Development & Customization

  • Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that combine ICEYE SAR data with customer intelligence documents for context-aware analysis.

  • Develop AI agents and workflows using frameworks like LangChain, LangGraph, or similar tools to automate analytical tasks.

  • Implement prompt engineering strategies and conversational AI interfaces that enable analysts to query satellite data using natural language.

  • Create Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations connecting AI systems with customer data sources.

Data Fusion & Intelligence Workflows

  • Build data fusion pipelines combining SAR imagery with additional intelligence sources (AIS, RF signals, optical imagery, SIGINT).

  • Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities.

  • Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.

Customer Engagement & Rapid Prototyping

  • Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems.

  • Rapidly prototype AI-powered solutions (code first, polish later) that address immediate operational requirements.

  • Conduct hands-on training sessions on platform capabilities and AI workflow usage.

  • Gather customer feedback and translate it into technical requirements for ICEYE's product and engineering teams.

What we are looking for

Must have skills:

  • 3+ years hands-on software engineering building and deploying production systems.

  • Strong Python programming skills (required) plus one of: Go, TypeScript, or Rust.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and RAG systems.

  • Working knowledge of agent frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, pydantic-ai) and vector databases.

  • Experience with Docker and deploying in secure / isolated / air-gapped environments.

  • Practical experience with APIs, data pipelines, and integrating systems in production,

THE MISSION OF THE FORWARD DEPLOYED AI ENGINEER

You’ll deploy ICEYE’s intelligence platform into secure (often air-gapped) environments and rapidly ship AI-powered workflows on top of it—everything from Docker-based deployments to RAG systems fusing SAR imagery with intelligence reports. This is a ship-code-daily role: turning raw satellite data into mission-critical tools analysts use to protect nations.

To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 - Develop automated workflows that correlate and cross-reference information across different data modalities.

 - Create lightweight tools, dashboards, and alerting systems tailored to customer operational needs.

 - Work embedded with intelligence analysts, data scientists, and military operators to understand mission-critical problems.

Role highlights:

  • Engineering Team Lead (Geospatial Analytics)

  • Location: Espoo, Finland. Relocation to Finland required

  • Department: Product Engineering, Solutions

  • Reports to: Engineering Manager, Geospatial Product Engineering

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

 

As Engineering Team Lead (Geospatial Analytics), you'll own a product engineering team that turns remote sensing and auxiliary data into fast, reliable insight when natural catastrophes happen. The team currently supports our Wind, Earthquake and Landslide products and brings together analytics (SAR, Machine learning / Data Science) and software engineers.

You will work in tandem with the Product Manager to decide what to build and why, and closely with Operations to make sure the products perform during live events.Your decisions shape how several products work, so you'll own the product’s engineering domain end to end: analytics that serve several products at once, built to the level the problem needs and no further. You will be hands-on, which keeps your technical judgement credible and your feedback specific.

 
 

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

 

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

 

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

 

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Lead and own the product engineering team: hiring, growth, performance and wellbeing of the team members

  • Own the team's technical direction across analytics and engineering, taking work from research prototype to production systems that run reliably against customer commitments.

  • Work in tandem with the Product Manager on roadmap and priorities, turning customer needs into analytics capability.

  • Design shared change detection analytics that serve multiple products in the team’s portfolio

  • Collaborate closely with Operations on event response, so that delivery workflows, latency and quality hold up when it matters.

  • Contribute directly to analytical development (SAR, geospatial data science / ML), validation and code.

  • Set and maintain scientific and engineering standards across the team, including review practice, validation rigour, testing and documentation.

  • Stakeholder management - including Product Engineering leadership and different product stakeholders

 

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Master’s or PhD in Remote Sensing, Machine Learning, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Geoscience, Physics, Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Experience in hands-on leadership as a line manager or tech lead, with a track record of delivery and examples of people who grew under your leadership.

  • Experience working closely with product and operations teams in a flow-based, outcome-focused way, including giving direct feedback constructively and explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders.

  • A record of taking analytics from prototype to reliable production against latency, accuracy and uptime targets, with sound judgement on when a solution is good enough.

  • Experience building, validating and deploying ML models or analytical pipelines based on SAR or other remote sensing imagery for tasks such as damage assessment, change detection or object detection. This includes working with noisy or sparse labels, validating against ground truth such as field surveys or claims data, and monitoring model performance in production.

  • A solid grasp of SAR principles, including how backscatter responds to structural change in built environments, and applied experience in change detection using amplitude, coherence or interferometric (InSAR) methods.

  • Strong Python skills and experience applying modern engineering practice (Git, code review, testing, CI, documentation), deployed with Docker on AWS. Ability to lead cross-functional teams.

 

Nice to haves:

  • Experience fusing remote sensing imagery with auxiliary data, such as weather, terrain models or building attributes, to improve model performance.

  • Experience using geospatial foundation models and embeddings (e.g. AlphaEarth Foundations) for tasks such as classification, similarity search or change detection.

  • Experience with natural hazards, disaster response, insurance or emergency management use cases.

  • Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools in your daily engineering work.

  • A publication or patent record, or other evidence of sustained technical contribution.

 

Application Process

  • TA Interview

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Take Home Task

  • Panel Interview

  • Department Lead Interview

  • Final Interview with SVP of Solutions

Working at ICEYE

At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one.   • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process.

 

Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table.

jobs.title: ICEYE Engineering Intern Lab 2027
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ICEYE Engineering Intern Lab 2027


Get paid to build the future of space.

Join ICEYE, the company operating the world’s largest Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) satellite constellation, for a fully paid, onsite internship where AI meets real-world engineering. The ICEYE Engineering Internship Program (“The ICEYE Intern Lab”) is designed for talented students in computer science, engineering, hardware, data science, and AI who want to apply their skills to meaningful challenges in earth observation, sensor technology, and intelligent systems.

With a flexible term of 3–6 months, interns work onsite at ICEYE’s engineering offices (Finland, Spain or Poland), collaborating directly with hardware, software, and operations teams on mission-driven projects. We seek Master’s and Bachelor’s students with strong AI tool fluency, curiosity, and a hands-on builder mindset.

You’ll be embedded in one of ICEYE’s engineering teams as a contributing team member for the duration of the program, contributing to real satellite and analytics projects (not simulations) that advance ICEYE’s mission to make the world safer and more resilient through persistent monitoring.

This second cohort officially launches in May 2027, with opportunities for early placement available.

Application Deadline: December 21, 2026
Decision Timeline: Offers to be made on a rolling basis with final decisions made by February 15, 2027

Cohort start date: May 2027



Qualifications:

Education

  • Currently enrolled as a Bachelor's student (3rd year or later) or Master's student in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace, or a closely related field.

  • Recent university graduates are also eligible.

  • Must be eligible to work onsite in Finland, Spain or Poland (EU/EEA citizen, or able to secure an appropriate visa with the support of ICEYE).

Technical Skills

Our teams and projects span many different disciplines, but they are all highly technical and hands-on. Here is an example of technical skills needed in certain areas:

  • For software engineering roles: strong programming proficiency in Python, Go, Rust, and/or C++

  • For data science roles: computer vision, LLM, and/or classical machine learning experience. Python as a key programming language; data processing, analysis, or visualization tools (e.g., NumPy, Pandas, Matplotlib)

  • All: Deep experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, etc.) to enhance productivity, especially learning how to use agentic workflows.

  • All: Understanding of software development practices: version control (Git), testing, debugging, and documentation.


AI Mindset

  • AI development tool literacy (e.g. AI IDE or coding agents)

  • Demonstrated curiosity about how AI can accelerate real-world engineering.

  • Comfortable experimenting with AI-first workflows and prompt-based problem solving.

  • Willingness to learn new tools quickly and apply them to open-ended technical challenges



You …

  • have strong communication skills and ability to work in multidisciplinary teams (hardware, software, operations).

  • are not afraid to ask a lot of questions.

  • are proactive, resourceful, and a hands-on problem solver.

  • are able to manage time effectively in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

  • are comfortable giving and receiving feedback, and presenting work during weekly reviews and demo days.

ICEYE Gives …

  • Salary 1 000 - 3 300€ /month based on location and years of study

  • Flights/transportation to your ICEYE office location

  • Housing

  • Work visa (if needed)


Recruitment process

  1. Application: Submit your CV and answer a few short questions instead of a cover letter (about 30 minutes).

  2. Peer Interview (30 min): A conversation with a former ICEYE intern about how you work, learn and collaborate.

  3. Team matching: We match you with the engineering team that best fits your skills and interests.

  4. Technical Interview with your future team (60 min): A short problem-solving exercise and a conversation with the team lead. We care more about how you approach the problem than about getting a perfect answer.

  5. Decisions and offer

Role highlights:

  • Senior Electric Propulsion Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland / Warsaw, Poland

  • Department: AOCS Hardware

  • Reports to: Engineering Manager AOCS Hardware

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid (3 days in the office)

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

ICEYE needs a senior, hands-on Hall Effect Thruster engineer in the AOCS Hardware team to own the maturation and qualification of the propulsion subsystem around the thruster (FCU, feed system, tanks, PPU, valves, harness). The role runs from early trade-offs through ground test facilities, qualification, production handoff and on-orbit anomaly work. Success at 12 months looks like a qualified, production-ready peripheral architecture with a working test flow and suppliers handing over repeatable builds.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Design and trade-offs: Lead design and performance trade-offs for the propulsion subsystem, and mature the supporting hardware (FCU, feed/tank systems, PPUs, valves, cabling) with clear architectures, requirements and verification paths.

  • Modeling and analysis: Run analytical modeling and simulation of propulsion system behavior (thermal, plume, and spacecraft interaction effects) to support design decisions.

  • Test and qualification: Set up and operate ground test facilities and testbeds, and plan and run functional, environmental and lifetime test campaigns, including acceptance criteria and procedures.

  • Production readiness and suppliers: Work with vendors, research institutions and integrators on co-development and supply chain coordination, and define production-readiness criteria, test/inspection flows and supplier handoffs.

  • On-orbit performance and documentation: Monitor in-flight propulsion performance, lead anomaly investigations and corrective actions, and keep test reports, technical rationale and qualification records up to date.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Educational background in Aerospace Engineering, Plasma Physics, Electrical Engineering, or related field.

  • At least 6 years of experience working with electric propulsion systems, preferably Hall Effect Thrusters, in design, test, or operation.

  • Proven background in plasma physics, electric propulsion modeling, or space system engineering.

  • Experience with designing or evaluating PPUs and power interfaces for propulsion systems.

  • Strong analytical skills and experience using numerical tools for thermal, plasma, or fluid simulations (e.g. COMSOL, ANSYS, SPIS, MATLAB).

  • Hands-on experience with laboratory plasma diagnostics, test setup and electrical test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, thrust stands, HV instrumentation).

  • Experience designing or commissioning ground test facilities, with good understanding of vacuum systems, contamination control and safe HV testing practices.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work across disciplines (mechanical, avionics, GNC, systems).

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with qualification, flight-certification or qualification test campaigns for propulsion subsystems.

  • Familiarity with high-voltage system design, thermal vacuum testing, lifetime/erosion testing and spacecraft contamination considerations.

  • Proficiency with Python and Git for data analysis, tooling or automation; C/C++ experience to liaise with flight software teams is a plus.

  • Experience managing suppliers, procurement and technical deliverables for critical spacecraft subsystems.

Application Process

  • Recruiter Interview (30 mins online)

  • Hiring Manager Interview (30 mins online)

  • Technical Interview (60 mins online)

  • Technical Workshop (90 mins onsite)

  • Director Interview (60 mins onsite)

  • See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.

  • Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.

  • Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.

  • Have fun: What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Spacecraft Analysis Engineer

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Spacecraft Hardware

  • Reports to: Spacecraft Analysis Team lead

  • Employment type: Permanent

  • Workplace model: Hybrid / Office

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

The Spacecraft Analysis team plays a key role in the development of the next generation of ICEYE’s SAR satellites and constellations, as well as the optimization and continuous improvement of the existing fleet.

As a Spacecraft analysis engineer you’ll be involved in all stages of the satellite and constellation design, CONOPs definition, and fleet operation optimization, through rigorous, physics-grounded analysis, working closely with engineers across all disciplines to make sure the spacecraft performs as intended, from the drawing board through to operations.

Coming up with creative ways to find answers to challenging engineering questions while working along a multidisciplinary team is part of daily life. As we control almost every aspect of our technology from hardware to software, you will work with world-renowned experts in a highly collaborative environment.

Who We Are

ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.


Your day-to-day responsibilities

  • Feasibility and performance analysis during the all stages of the spacecraft design, including budgets, CONOPs, space and ground segment interfaces.

  • Analyze, model, and optimize the performance of integrated SAR satellite systems.

  • Support launch, early operations and commissioning activities, ensuring successful deployment and operation of the spacecraft.

  • Perform mission analysis and develop flying rules to support system design.

  • Lead initiatives to enhance reliability and performance for on-orbit operations.

  • Support customers and program management with mission analysis, system documentation and on-orbit validation and verification.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • Degree in Space Engineering, Physics, Electrical Engineering or other relevant discipline.

  • Understanding of fundamentals of physics in terms of space environment, attitude control, RF propagation, heat exchange, orbital dynamics etc.

  • Ability to work along with multidisciplinary teams including all sorts of engineering, operations, project management and sales engineering.

  • Great communication skills.

  • Experience in systems engineering processes, requirements management, and verification methodologies.

  • Ability to plan, perform and properly analyze results of an experiment, simulation, or test.

  • Critical and analytical thinking,

  • Coding and data analysis skills in Python and/or Matlab.

  • Positive and proactive attitude.

  • Regardless of the level of experience, the desire to learn new things and new ways to do engineering is a must.

Nice to haves:

  • Ability to work with Linux operating systems.

  • Proficiency with digital mission engineering in STK, Python.

  • Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment.

  • Experience with mission critical systems design and troubleshooting.

  • Relevant experience with complex systems design, implementation and operations.

  • AI is quickly becoming a very relevant tool, the understanding of its capabilities and limitations, and the ability to use it as an analysis tool to obtain reliable data is also a plus.

  • Task Assignment

To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 



Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Support daily stock management by receiving, storing and picking materials correctly

  • Raise issues early and clearly

  • Learn our inbound and outbound processes and support them as part of ICEYE logistics operations

  • Take part in continuous improvement projects and, over the internship, start suggesting and driving improvements

No previous experience is required. If you are precise, service minded and curious about how material flows in a space company, we will train you and help you get started.

Must haves:

  • Current studies or recent graduation in logistics, supply chain, engineering or a related field

  • Readiness for hands-on work, such as moving light to medium items, printing labels and organising shelves

  • High attention to detail

  • Fluent spoken and written English

jobs.title: Satellite Production Senior Technician , Power & Electronics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role highlights:

  • Senior Production Technician (Power & Electronics)

  • Location: Espoo, Finland

  • Department: Production Finland

  • Reports to: Power & Electronics Team Lead

  • Employment type: Permanent, full time

  • Workplace model: Onsite

  • Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)

Why this role matters:

As a Senior Production Technician, you’ll build the electronics inside every ICEYE satellite.

Our Power & Electronics team in Espoo builds and tests the avionics, RF units and batteries for every ICEYE satellite. We are moving from low-volume builds to standard, repeatable production.

We need a senior technician who builds flight hardware to standard without supervision, keeps the work area ready, solves build and test problems together with engineers, and helps other technicians grow. You will work daily with Assembly, Integration and Test Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain and the satellite integration line.

Who We Are


ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.

ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.

ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.

Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

 



Your day-to-day responsibilities

 

  • Build and test avionics, RF and battery units to flight standard, following controlled work instructions and lithium-ion handling rules.

  • Run bench tests: power-up, continuity and isolation checks, functional tests with unit test setups, and RF measurements where needed.

  • Be the first point of contact for build and test problems: lead fault-finding with engineering and Quality, and close non-conformances through root cause and corrective action.

  • Keep your production area ready and every build traceable: tools, fixtures, test equipment and kits, plus work orders, Jira tickets, as-built records, labels and photos.

  • Coach and cross-train technicians in soldering, connectors and coax, ESD and FOD rules, and test execution.

  • Improve how we build: redline work instructions, non-conformance reports and checklists, remove bottlenecks and repeat defects using Lean and 6S, and support new unit variants and new product introduction from first-article build to lessons learned.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

  • 5+ years of hands-on electronics or electro-mechanical assembly, integration and test in a quality-critical environment such as space, aerospace, defence, medical devices, telecom or automotive electronics.

  • Soldering and rework to IPC Class 3 (IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001) or ECSS standard, certified or able to certify during probation, plus experience with connectors, coax assemblies and harness termination.

  • Confident use of bench test equipment (multimeter, power supplies, electronic load, oscilloscope), and able to work from schematics, wiring diagrams, assembly drawings and test procedures.

  • Strong ESD, FOD and cleanroom discipline.

  • A track record of owning a work area or technical problem and seeing it through.

  • Experience coaching technicians, with clear and practical communication.

  • Working knowledge of Lean and 6S.

  • Proficient English. Onsite in Espoo, with occasional travel to other ICEYE sites in Europe.

Nice to haves:

  • Satellite or spacecraft hardware build or test experience, for example avionics such as on-board computers, power units, reaction wheels, star trackers or IMUs.

  • RF experience: network or spectrum analyzer measurements, RF cable assembly, X-band equipment.

  • Lithium-ion battery pack assembly and test, or environmental testing (thermal cycling, thermal vacuum, vibration).

  • Scripted or automated test tools (Python, LabVIEW) and Linux basics.

Application Process

  • Recruiter interview

  • Hiring manager interview

  • Practical task (onsite, at the bench)

  • Final interview
